title: 06 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 03
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Diplomacy on Borite and Terror in the Void PCs present Nemo / Captain James Hondo (Leader / Face) Juan / Fomega (Security / Soldier) Jimmy Mendoza (Security / Operations) Rocío / Tía (Engineer / Gunner) Paloma / Honor / Jane (Pilot / Sensors) Emilio / Pika (Engineer / Sensors) NPCs present Margaret Blaine (Flight Instructor / Ship's Assistant) Aboinenan Atalaya (Officer of the Borite Continuity Authority) Administrator Ura (Leader of the local bureaucracy on Borite) Oghma Raiders (Nighttime attackers) Insectoid Creature (Monster on the space station) Main developments in the campaign The group has split up to optimize time: one team goes down to the planet Borite to seek information and supplies, while the other takes the ship to refuel at the gas giant. On Borite, the PCs have established a diplomatic relationship with the Continuity Authority by repairing a vital mining atmospheric plant, earning 5,000 credits and improving the planet's political status regarding travelers. In space, they have discovered an ancient space station of the Sindal Empire orbiting the gas giant, which is emitting a strange distress signal. Loose ends The station survivor: Sensors detected a heat signature (possibly a Vargr) on the space station, but they have not yet made visual contact. The hull breach: The insectoid creature has spat acid against the pressurized station hull, causing progressive decompression that threatens Paloma's life. Oghma Raiders: The "boogeymen" of Oghma are confirmed to be active in the system and have attempted to assassinate the PCs on the planet. Interference: An unknown jamming signal blocked communications between Paloma and Emilio at a critical moment. Scene 1: Arrival and Division PCs present: All. NPCs present: Margaret Blaine (Onboard instructor). Location: Borite System Space (Jump arrival). Ship: Banshee (Harrier Class). Scene summary After a week of jumping and training with Margaret Blaine, the crew arrives in the Borite system. Scanners show little activity and confirm that the planet has a low technological level and lacks a real spaceport (Class E). With fuel depleted, the group decides to split up to optimize the remaining time of their main mission: 1.  Ground Group: Nemo, Juan, Jimmy, and Rocío will disembark on the ship, land to investigate, and search for spare parts or information about the pirates they are pursuing. 2.  Space Group: Paloma and Emilio (along with Margaret) will take the ship to the gas giant to refuel with refined fuel, a task that will take several days. Scene 2: Welcome to the Bureaucracy PCs present: Nemo, Juan, Jimmy, Rocío. NPCs present: Aboinenan Atalaya (Local police/bureaucracy officer, constantly taking notes). Location: Capital City and Hotel (Planet Borite). Scene summary The ship drops the ground team off and departs. They are met by a security delegation from the Borite Continuity Authority, led by Aboinenan Atalaya. Although the atmosphere is oppressive and bureaucratic, they are not hostile. Nemo introduces himself as Captain Jameson, a "bounty hunter" or terrorist seeker. Atalaya escorts them by van to the city, questioning them gently. It is revealed that Borite was an old Drinax colony and they fear the slavers of Oghma. The PCs are lodged in a hotel under surveillance. At night they try to gather information in local bars, but the population is closed off and distrustful of foreigners. Scene 3: The Signal in the Giant PCs present: Paloma, Emilio. NPCs present: Margaret Blaine. Location: Approach to the Gas Giant (Borite System). Ship: Banshee (Harrier Class). Scene summary As they head to refuel, Emilio detects a distress signal. Upon approaching, they discover it originates from a derelict space station orbiting the gas giant. The station appears to be a relic of the Sindal Empire, patched up over the centuries but on the verge of falling into the atmosphere in the distant future. The distress signal is, strangely, a spacesuit beacon attached to the main antenna to amplify it. Thermal sensors detect a single life form (possibly a wounded or weak Vargr) inside. They decide to investigate and dock before refueling, fearing a trap but wanting to rescue the survivor or capture them if they are an enemy. Scene 4: Deal in the Mines PCs present: Nemo, Juan, Jimmy, Rocío. NPCs present: Administrator Ura (Local leader, pragmatic), Aboinenan Atalaya. Location: Administration Office and Boro Mine (Planet Borite). Scene summary The ground group meets with Administrator Ura. She confirms they haven't seen other ships recently but offers a deal: if the "technicians" of the crew can repair a vital atmospheric plant in one of their mines that has been failing for months, Borite will pay them and establish good relations. They accept the deal. They travel several hours to a remote mine. Rocío, with the physical assistance of Juan, works for hours in harsh conditions (heat and boro vapors) and manages to repair the machinery, earning the favor of the local authorities. Scene 5: Night Assault PCs present: Nemo, Juan, Jimmy, Rocío. NPCs present: Oghma Raiders (Poorly equipped but stealthy assassins). Location: Mine Barracks (Planet Borite). Scene summary While they sleep in the mine barracks, they are attacked. Juan and Nemo wake up just before their doors are kicked open. Juan reacts instinctively and destroys his attacker with a burst from his automatic shotgun. Nemo is shot in the shoulder but retaliates with his laser pistol, severing his assailant's arm and killing him. Jimmy secures the perimeter with his shotgun. Rocío stays in cover. The attackers turn out to be Oghma scouts who were likely watching the area. The rest of the attackers flee into the darkness. Scene 6: Terror on the Sindalite Station PCs present: Paloma, Emilio. NPCs present: Insectoid Creature (Hostile, spits acid). Location: Interior of the Space Station (Orbit of the Gas Giant). Ship: Banshee (Docked). Scene summary Paloma boards the pressurized section of the station while Emilio monitors from the ship and prepares to disembark. Suddenly, interference blocks communications. Paloma finds herself alone and in the dark when an insectoid creature attacks her from the ceiling. Paloma manages to dodge the bites and shoots the monster, wounding it but not killing it. She runs towards the airlock to escape. Emilio tries to open the airlocks manually from the other side to help her, but the mechanism is slow and heavy. The creature spits a stream of acid. Paloma dodges it, but the acid hits the door and the ancient station hull. The session ends with the hull beginning to give way from the acid, causing a depressurization of the room where Paloma is trapped, as Emilio struggles to open the door.

title: 06 - The Flight to Vallaki
content: Here is the translation of the provided text into English, without any additions or inventions: Session Title: The Flight to Vallaki and the Awakening of Bones PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Pulgar, Ceres, Feyre, Ladril Gabriel (Sir Gabriel), Nacho (Renoir of the Woods). NPCs present: Irena, Sergeant Andre, Urrich, Burgomaster's Guard, Yelena and Gunter Arasek. Main Developments and Loose Ends: The group has split up. Feyre, Pulgar, Ceres, and Sir Gabriel have managed to reach the walled city (palisade) of Vallaki and reunite at the Blue Water Inn. They have reached level 4. Broseph, Erdan, and Nacho are trapped in Castle Ravenloft. They have discovered secret passages, sent a distress message, and barely survived an ambush by undead. They have leveled up to 4 after resting in the banquet hall. Irena is under the "hospitality" of the Burgomaster of Vallaki, guarded by beast-like guards. Unexplained or Loose Ends Requiring Follow-up: Will Erdan's messenger crow reach its allies, or will it be intercepted by the giant bats that were following it? Who recently destroyed the stone cabin in the mountains? (It smelled of recent smoke and destruction). Why does the Burgomaster of Vallaki's guard have a disproportionately large hand that looks like a claw with sharp nails? What does Strahd plan now that Irena is in Vallaki and part of the group is in his castle? Rictavio's traveling circus wagon in the Vallaki stables, which is heavily chained shut. Session Gag: The best gag arose organically during the wagon's escape. When the horse pulling the wagon was bitten by a wolf and fell to the ground, nearly dead, Ceres (Paloma) had to make an Animal Handling roll to avoid running it over. With a high roll, aided by her proficiency, the GM (Nemo) described how she made a spectacular skid to avoid it, dubbing her "the Carlos Sainz of swamps and dungeons." The table joked about her "drifting" ability with a heavy wagon in the middle of mud and rain. Scene 1: The Organ and the Messenger PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Nacho. NPCs present: None physically. Locations: Castle Ravenloft (Banquet Hall K10, Corridor K11, Mirror Room). Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: Broseph, Erdan, and Nacho find themselves trapped in Strahd's banquet hall after his departure. While investigating the room, Broseph notices claw marks on the floor next to the grand organ. Nacho, using his Bardic Inspiration, plays a few keys and discovers a pedal that moves the organ, revealing a secret passage. The passage leads to a defensive corridor with arrow slits and a multitude of mirrors of various sizes. Erdan uses one of the arrow slits to send his familiar (a raven) with a message tied to its leg, warning his companions that they are trapped and will attempt to escape. Nacho warns that the raven is being followed by giant bats in the night. Scene 2: Refuge in Vallaki and the Claw Guard PCs present: Feyre. NPCs present: Irena (Adopted, knows nothing of her origins, lived in confinement. Archetype: Survivor/Persecuted Damsel). Sergeant Andre (Disciplined. Archetype: Loyal Guard). Urrich (Kind, empathetic. Archetype: Welcoming Innkeeper). Burgomaster's Guard (Nearly 2 meters tall, plate armor, wolf skin cloak, bald, dark circles under eyes, huge claw-shaped gloved hand. Archetype: Intimidating Thug/Hidden Monster). Locations: Vallaki (Streets, Blue Water Inn, Burgomaster's Mansion). Loot obtained: A free room for one night. Scene Summary: Feyre (in horse form and then human) arrives at the gates of Vallaki with Irena. They enter just as the city closes its massive iron gates for the night. Irena confesses to Feyre that her father died 8 days ago, that she is adopted, and that Strahd bit her twice after using mental powers. They are taken to the Blue Water Inn, where they observe a tense but lively atmosphere with wolf hunters and locals. Soon, Sergeant Andre returns and escorts Irena to the Burgomaster's mansion. Feyre tries to accompany her but is left waiting in a reception room filled with strange bundles of twigs. A huge and terrifying guard, whose hand resembles a claw, informs Feyre that her services are no longer required. Feyre returns to the inn, where the innkeeper Urrich takes pity on her when he sees she has no money and gives her a free bed. Scene 3: Drifts, Wolves, and Closed Gates PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel (Alvaro). NPCs present: Vallaki Guards. Locations: Barovian Forest and Road, Smoldering Ruins, Vallaki Gates. Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: Pulgar's group, Ceres and Sir Gabriel, desperately flee in their wagon from Strahd's horde of bats. Although they elude the bats, they fall into an ambush by terrible wolves. A wolf attacks one of the horses, leaving it at 1 hit point and knocking it down. Sir Gabriel cuts the reins, and Ceres executes a masterful driving maneuver to avoid overturning the wagon. They escape on foot in the torrential rain, passing by the smoldering ruins of a recently destroyed stone cabin. Upon reaching the gates of Vallaki at night, the guards, with dozens of wolf heads impaled around them, deny them entry due to strict orders from the Burgomaster. They spend the night taking refuge in the wagon outside the palisade. At dawn, they enter the city, negotiate at the Arasek stables, and reunite with Feyre at the inn. Scene 4: The Barracks Trap PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Nacho. NPCs present: Skeletons (Clean bones imbued with residual necromancy. Archetype: Undead Minions). Locations: Castle Ravenloft (Spiral Staircase and Underground Barracks K68/K69). Loot obtained: A rusty shortsword (Erdan). Scene Summary: Searching for an exit, those trapped in Ravenloft burn some cobwebs and descend a spiral staircase into ancient, frigid barracks filled with rotten cots and old bones. While Erdan distractedly investigates the remains of a small skeleton in a cubicle, the castle's necromantic magic activates. Eight skeletons rise suddenly, surrounding Erdan. A tactical combat erupts in the narrow corridor. Erdan falls unconscious and bleeds profusely under the blows of the undead. Broseph uses his accelerated magic missiles and fire bolts, while Nacho tanks in the front with his silvered rapier and manages to heal Erdan just in time to prevent his death. After destroying the last skeleton with necrotic damage and projectiles, the battered group decides to flee the barracks back to the banquet hall to rest. After the night, they reach level 4.

title: 06.5 - Castle Spiders
content: Here is the translation of the provided text into English, without adding or inventing anything: Session Summary: Exploration, Accounting, and Spiders in the Castle PCs present: Broseph (Juan Maldonado), Erdan (Marcos), and Renoir (Nacho - mentioned/passively played). NPCs present: Lief, Dasha, Strahd (mentioned). Locations: Strahd's Castle in Barovia (Rooms K-19, K-25, K-30, K-8, K-9, K-10, K-11, K-64, K-68). Main Developments and Loose Ends Main Developments: The group has successfully navigated several traps on the castle stairs and discovered Strahd's accounting room. After looting some of the vampire's treasure, they obtained vital information about a portal room on the lower levels that could serve as their escape. Additionally, they rescued Dasha, a young woman who had been enchanted by Strahd and imprisoned by a spider. Loose Ends: Will Broseph fulfill his promise to return to free Lief the accountant from his magical chains? What terrible creature will appear if someone pulls the rope in room K-30? Where exactly is the portal room with the two iron statues that Lief spoke of? The group finds themselves in the middle of an ambush by a giant spider on the stairs, just as the connection was lost. Session Joke "My junk is like a turtle poking its head out" While deciding how to approach Lief (the chained accountant), Erdan (played by Marcos) made a very graphic joke saying he urgently needed to use the bathroom: "my junk is already like a turtle when it pokes its head out". The Master (Nemo) did not understand this was an out-of-character comment and genuinely believed the player wanted Erdan to defecate in the middle of the room in front of the NPC. This led to a surreal and very comical discussion of several minutes trying to clarify whether the elf was actually pooping or not. Scene 1: The Trap Stairs and the Living Ceiling PCs present: Broseph, Erdan. NPCs present: None. Location: Armor Landing (K-19) and Throne Room (K-25). Loot obtained: None. Summary: The group reaches a dusty landing with two alcoves containing armors and maces shaped like dragon heads. Broseph, with Erdan's help, searches for traps and detects pressure plates connected to the armors. Walking very carefully, they manage to avoid them and ascend to a huge, dark throne room. Upon illuminating the ceiling, they discover with horror that the darkness is moving: it is infested with hundreds of thousands of spiders. They decide not to cross through the center of the room and walk along the wall to a double door. Scene 2: Hanging Skeletons and the Accounting Room PCs present: Broseph, Erdan. NPCs present: Lief (Elderly human, hunched, yellow teeth, and mustache; chained to a desk. Archetype: The captive servant/resigned bureaucrat). Location: Hall of Skeletons and Accounting Room (K-30). Loot obtained: Iron key from K-30, Transmutation spellbook (Bodyweight training manual/Constitution), 500 platinum coins. Summary: After peering into a hallway where sinister skeletons hang from wires, they decide to retreat and open another smaller door. They arrive at Strahd's accounting room, filled with ledgers and four chests. There they meet Lief, a man chained to his desk who has been doing the vampire's accounts for decades. Broseph earns his trust by offering him a plum. Lief warns them not to pull the rope hanging from the ceiling, as it summons a punishing monster. While they talk, Broseph investigates the chests. He pretends to ignore the thousands of copper and gold coins but secretly pockets a spellbook and 500 platinum coins. Erdan tries to break Lief's chain with a metal torch, but Broseph stops him after detecting an "Alarm" spell on the ring. Lief begs them to free him; in return, he reveals the existence of a room with magical portals and iron statues on the crypt level. Broseph promises to find a way to dispel the magic and return for him. Scene 3: The Rescue in the Web PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Renoir (mentioned/bot). NPCs present: Dasha (Young Romani/Vistani, confused, with bite marks on her neck. Archetype: Damsel in distress / Survivor). Location: Dining Hall (K-10) and Hidden Mirror Room (K-11). Loot obtained: None. Summary: On their way to the lower levels, a spectral cat gives them a fright by hissing at them from the shadows. Upon reaching the dining hall, they notice that someone or something has eaten the leftovers from the feast. They enter the mirror room (K-11) and discover a large, hidden spiderweb cocoon. After tearing it open, they free an unconscious woman who has a vampire bite on her neck. Renoir heals her, and she wakes up very scared. She introduces herself as Dasha, from the Vistani camp of Bialoqui. She explains that Strahd bewitched her, she woke up in a room, fled by activating the statues on the stairs (K-19), fell, and something dragged her away and wrapped her in spiderwebs. She also mentions that Erdan reminds her of "dusk elves." They give her a torch and decide to take her with them towards the exit. Scene 4: Ambush on the Spiral Stairs PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Renoir. NPCs present: Dasha, Giant Spider. Location: Spiral Stairs (K-64 to K-68). Loot obtained: None. Summary: The group decides to descend the long spiral stairs to the lower levels in search of the portal room. They advance stealthily, but the Master rolls for a random encounter. Suddenly, an immense giant spider emerges from nowhere, exceeding the group's passive perception, and lands a terrible bite on Renoir, inflicting necrotic damage. Just as they are about to roll for his Constitution save, the programs (Discord and Fantasy Grounds) suffer a general crash, leaving the battle (and Renoir) in full suspense until the next session.

title: 07 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 04
content: Here is the session summary following the requested pattern and in Spanish from Spain: Rescue in the Darkness and the First Loot PJs present: Onor, Pika, Emilio, Nemo (Captain Jameson Doe), Paloma, Jimmy, Fomega. NPCs present: Krrsh, Margaret Blaine, Captain Bogan Erwin, Rocío. Main events in the PJs' lives or the campaign: Rescue of Captain Vargr Krrsh, gaining a loyal ally and potential gunner.    Obtaining critical information on Ferric Resten's whereabouts and the location of Black Sun City* in the Theev system. Successful execution of the crew's first organized piracy act in the Marduk system. Acquisition of a valuable cargo of illegal drugs and spices to fund ship repairs. Loose ends: The relationship with the noblewoman in Borite (possibly Lady Hil) and the proposal to deliver captured ships to her in exchange for political influence.    The sale of the stolen merchandise in Marduk (at 10% of its value) and the hull repairs for the Banshee*. The pursuit of the remaining pirate ships and the pending confrontation with Ferric Resten before he can gain protection from Admiral Darokin. Scene 1: Escape from the Ghost Station PJs present: Onor, Pika, Emilio (on sensors). NPCs present: Krrsh (Vargr, abandoned pirate captain, starving and wounded - Archetype: The Betrayed Castaway). Location(s): Sindalite Station "Allseed Dalyan" (Deep Space/Near Drinax). Ships mentioned: The Banshee (Harrier, Captain Nemo). Scene summary: Onor and Pika explore a ruined ancient Sindalite station searching for a sign of life. Onor is attacked by an insectoid creature (Hunter Chamax) and manages to drive it away after a precise shot, although the area's atmosphere is compromised. Emilio and Honor locate the target's life sign in a depressurized area. Honor performs a piloting and mechanical maneuver to cut the station's hull from the outside and extract the survivor: a dying Vargr named Krrsh. They bring him aboard the Banshee and place him in an improvised medical bay under surveillance. Scene 2: Captain Krrsh's Story PJs present: All (Nemo, Jimmy, Emilio, Paloma, Honor, Pika, Fomega). NPCs present: Krrsh (Vargr recovering, talkative and grateful), Margaret Blaine (Advisor/Spy - Archetype: The Pragmatic Mentor). Location(s): The Banshee (In transit to the Marduk system), Borite (Planet/System Borite). Ships mentioned: The Banshee (Harrier). Scene summary: Once recovered and fed (and after drinking whiskey), Krrsh reveals his identity. He was captain of the ship Misery's Company until his crew mutinied, led by Ferric Resten, and abandoned him to die. He explains that Ferric is fleeing Admiral Darokin and seeks protection in Black Sun City. Krrsh offers the access codes to this legendary pirate city in the Theev system and the location of a secret fuel depot. The crew debates recruiting him; Krrsh is helpful and eager for revenge. After a technical stop in Borite where Nemo mentions political contacts, they set course for the Marduk system, following Margaret Blaine's advice to ambush ships. Scene 3: Ambush in the Gas Giant PJs present: Emilio, Paloma, Nemo, Jimmy. NPCs present: Margaret Blaine. Location(s): Moons of the Gas Giant (Marduk System). Ships mentioned: The Banshee (Harrier), The Cinsedani (Far Trader, Captain Bogan Erwin). Scene summary: The crew hides the Banshee on one of Marduk's gas giant moons. After two days of waiting with passive sensors, Emilio detects a Far Trader freighter approaching to refuel in the giant's atmosphere. Paloma executes a silent approach maneuver using the moons' gravity. When the freighter emerges from refueling, the Banshee appears at close range. Emilio successfully jams its communications, and Nemo, introducing himself as Captain Jameson Doe, demands its surrender under threat of opening fire with the turrets. Scene 4: The Gentlemanly Boarding PJs present: Fomega, Nemo, Paloma, Pika, Honor, Jimmy. NPCs present: Captain Bogan Erwin (Human, ruined merchant - Archetype: The Cooperative Victim), Crew of the Cinsedani, Krrsh (accompanying the boarding party). Location(s): Interior of the Cinsedani ship (Marduk System). Ships mentioned: The Cinsedani (Far Trader). Scene summary: The target ship surrenders and powers down its engines. Fomega leads the boarding party in vacuum suits. Captain Erwin and his crew (four frightened individuals) cooperate fully. While Krrsh guards the prisoners, Margaret loots valuables from the cabins. Paloma and Fomega inspect the cargo: they find spices and, hidden, 20 tons of high-value illegal drugs. Nemo and Jimmy review the account books and discover that the Cinsedani's crew is ruined and on the verge of losing the ship. A moral debate ensues about how much to steal from them. Finally, they decide to take the drugs (valued at 2 million, though difficult to sell) and part of the spices, leaving the ship operational and "pardoning" their lives and the rest of the cargo in exchange for future favors or information if they cross paths again. Scene 5: The Fate of the Loot PJs present: Nemo, Jimmy, Emilio, Paloma, Honor. NPCs present: - Location(s): The Banshee (Marduk System). Ships mentioned: The Banshee (Harrier). Scene summary: After releasing the Cinsedani, the crew discusses where to sell the stolen merchandise. Margaret suggests a fence in the Exocet system, but it's several jumps away. Considering that the Banshee needs urgent hull repairs and maintenance, and they don't want to lose track of the main pirates, they decide to stay in Marduk. They plan to sell the drugs there, expecting to get only 10% of their value due to a lack of reputation, but will use that money (approx. 200,000 credits) to repair the ship immediately and continue the hunt.

title: 07 - Vallaki
content: Here is the translation of the provided text to English, without adding or inventing anything: Session Title: Welcome to Vallaki: Festivals, Toys, and False Smiles PCs present: Pulgar "bigtoe" (played by Juan Casanova) Ceres (played by Paloma) Ladril Gabriel aka Sir Gabriel / Alvarito / Fomega (played by Nacho this session) NPCs present: Gunther and Yalena Arasek Burgomaster (The Baron of Vallaki) and his wife Claw Guardian (Zec / Izek) Lars (the arrested peasant) Blinsky (the toy maker) and his monkey Piccolo Urwin Martikov (the innkeeper) Main events and loose ends: The group finally manages to enter the city of Vallaki in the morning, discovering a place steeped in a strange and forced happiness imposed by its leader, the Burgomaster, who celebrates absurd festivals every week believing that joy will keep Strahd away. After a bit of investigation around the city and leaving their cart, the characters attend the start of the "Festival of the Blazing Sun," where they witness the cruelty of the Burgomaster and his lethal personal guard. Later, they visit Blinsky's creepy toy shop and the Blue Water Inn. They discover that their allies are divided and in danger: Ireena has been taken to the Burgomaster's mansion, Feyre has disappeared after sleeping at the inn, and they receive a message warning that Erdan and the rest are trapped as prisoners in Castle Strahd. The session ends with the Burgomaster inviting the group to dinner at his mansion as thanks for bringing Ireena to the city. Loose ends requiring follow-up: What kind of monster or beast is locked inside Rictavio's "Carnival of Wonders" wagon? Why does the toy maker Blinsky craft dozens of dolls that are exact copies of Ireena? Where is Feyre currently after leaving the inn? How will they rescue Ireena from the Burgomaster's house? How will they help Erdan, Broseph, and Renoir get out of Castle Strahd?  The innkeeper Urwin has asked for help to find out what has happened to the wine shipment from the Vintner's Wench Winery* to the west. Blinsky has asked for them to bring him or investigate a "mechanical man" that Strahd supposedly keeps in his castle. The Joke of the Session: The "North Korea" of Ravenloft. Undoubtedly, the funniest moment was when the players and Nacho (playing Alvarito/Sir Gabriel) realized that the constant phrase "Everything will be fine" and the forced smiles of terrified citizens turned Vallaki into an absurd dictatorship. Nacho compared the Burgomaster to Kim Jong-un and Vallaki to North Korea, causing everyone to burst into laughter while the paladin threw his hands up in despair as Ceres applauded and shouted "Great!" to go along with the local dictator. Added to this was the moment when the Burgomaster's noble wife mistook Pulgar (a dwarf) for a crippled beggar child, giving him a single copper coin which Pulgar ceremoniously placed in a bag from which only a cloud of dust emerged. Scene 1: Rictavio's Wagon PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present: None visible. Location(s): The Arasek Stable (Vallaki). Loot obtained: A crow feather (collected by Ceres). Summary: Upon entering the city, a guard directs them to park their wagon at the Arasek Stable. There, they see a single, chained, mysterious wagon belonging to "Rictavio's Carnival of Wonders." The group's horse becomes very agitated as they approach. When Pulgar gets closer to peek, something immense and inhuman strikes the inside of the closed wagon, making the wood tremble and causing the dwarf to fall on his backside in the mud from fright. After noticing dried blood on the exterior, they decide to park their wagon as far away from it as possible. Scene 2: Shopping and False Smiles PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel.  NPCs present: Gunther and Yalena Arasek (scared shopkeepers, automaton smiles; archetype: oppressed citizens*). Location(s): The Arasek Shop/Warehouse. Loot obtained: Component Pouch for Ceres. Pulgar trades a gold ring with an emerald (valued at 125 gp) in exchange. Summary: The group enters the shop to get magical components for Ceres. They manage to barter by trading a gold ring. When they inquire about people leaving the city and mention that the Burgomaster seems "overbearing" with so many festivals, the shopkeepers' attitude changes drastically. Terrified, their eyes widen, they put on fake smiles, and begin to repeat as a mantra "Everything will be fine," politely inviting them to leave the shop and avoid trouble. Scene 3: The Festival of the Blazing Sun PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present:    The Burgomaster / Baron (noble with delusions of grandeur; archetype: lunatic dictator*).    The Burgomaster's wife (noble, condescending woman*).    Claw Guardian / Zec (bald man, vacant and cold gaze, with a huge red reptilian claw instead of an arm; archetype: executioner / intimidating thug*).    Lars (scared peasant; archetype: scapegoat*). Location(s): The town square (Vallaki). Loot obtained: 1 copper coin (given to Pulgar as alms). Summary: The group arrives at the square and sees men, women, and children chained to stocks with plaster donkey heads on them. They discover posters announcing the "Festival of the Blazing Sun." A sad procession begins in the rain, led by the Burgomaster, who attempts to set fire to a giant wicker ball. The torch extinguishes, and a peasant (Lars) laughs accidentally. Immediately, the Burgomaster orders him to be tied to his horse to be dragged through the mud. Ceres, trying to gain favor and prevent things from escalating, offers the leader a lit torch. The Burgomaster's wife, believing Pulgar to be a sick child, gives him a copper coin out of pity. The group decides not to intervene for now and leaves. Scene 4: "If it's not fun, it's not a Blinsky" PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present:    Blinsky (small, sturdy man, mustache, wears a jester's hat; archetype: eccentric/creepy artisan*).    Piccolo (a domesticated baboon monkey dressed in a ballerina tutu*). Location(s): Blinsky's Toy Shop. Loot obtained: None. Summary: Drawn by a curious sign, they enter a creepy toy shop filled with decapitated dolls, wooden wolves chasing children, and torture toys. Blinsky tells them he is not from Barovia and asks them, if they go to Strahd's castle, to bring him information or the remains of a "mechanical man" that the vampire keeps there. In exchange, he offers them free toys or even his monkey Piccolo. Pulgar and Ceres notice that Blinsky has a collection of dolls identical to their friend Ireena. When they try to get information about this unsettling resemblance, the toy maker plays dumb and only tries to sell them the dolls for 9 copper pieces. Scene 5: A Raven Message and a Dangerous Dinner PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present:    Urwin Martikov / Ulrich (grey/white hair and beard, a scar on his face and a half-closed blue eye; archetype: good-natured innkeeper and informant*).    The Burgomaster (reappears triumphant and smiling*). Location(s): The Blue Water Inn. Loot obtained: None (Pulgar gives another gold ring valued at 25 gp to open a credit account for the group).  Summary: While Ceres casts the spell Locate Object to search for the scythe Feyre was carrying (detecting it weakly to the west), Pulgar negotiates with the innkeeper Urwin to open a credit account in exchange for a gold ring. Urwin reveals bad news: Feyre slept there but left in the morning, and Ireena was taken to the Burgomaster's house and has not returned. Additionally, he gives them a note brought by a raven signed by Erdan: the rest of the party is trapped in Castle Strahd and will not be allowed to leave until the entire group attends dinner. Urwin also asks them to investigate the Vintner's Wench Winery* because their shipment has not arrived. Suddenly, the Burgomaster enters the inn accompanied by his dogs and guards. He approaches the group with a wide smile and, to thank them for bringing Ireena to the city and for helping with the torch, invites them to dinner at his mansion that very evening, promising them a great surprise. He bids them farewell with his motto: "Everything will be fine."

title: 07.5 - Escape from Ravenloft
content: Here is the translation of the provided text to English, without any additions or invented content: Session Summary: The Escape from Ravenloft and the Monastery of the Mad PCs present: Renoir (played by Nacho), Daijiro (played by Juan Maldonado), Erdan (played by Marcos). Note: Ceres (played by Paloma) was present listening to the session, but her character did not participate in the scene. NPCs present: Cyrus Bellevue, Vistani Girl, Shadow Demon (Rahadin's Pet), Strahd Illusion, Clovin Bellevue, The Abbot, Vasilka. Main Developments and Loose Ends: Main Developments: The group managed to escape Castle Ravenloft using a teleportation brazier. During their escape, they sacrificed (by inaction) the Vistani girl accompanying them, leaving her at the mercy of a shadow demon. They have appeared at St. Markovia Abbey, a madhouse full of human amalgams (mongrels), where they have met the Abbot, a cleric of Lathander who is building a flesh golem (Vasilka) to give to Strahd as a bride and thus lift the curse of Barovia. Loose Ends: The final fate of the Vistani girl's soul (the DM warned that the consciousness of their actions will weigh on them, especially the good-aligned characters). Finding a worthy wedding dress for Vasilka, the flesh golem, at the Abbot's request. Reuniting with the other half of the group, who are currently heading to Vallaki / the Castle to look for them. Delivering the taunting note that Renoir wrote for Strahd (Renoir still has it in his inventory). Session Joke: The "Non-Sacrifice" of the gypsy. Without a doubt the funniest and most cynical moment of the night. When the terrifying Shadow Demon claims the Vistani girl as its toy to torture, the three adventurers (supposedly good and neutral) stand watching without doing anything, close the door, and flee. Afterwards, Juan (Daijiro) tries to justify it by saying his conscience is "relatively calm" because he didn't wield her or sacrifice her, the demon simply said "she's mine" and he thought "well, okay." The DM's complaints about how they have condemned her to a choir of tortured souls while the players shrug caused everyone to laugh. Scene 1: Preparations and Magical Doubts PCs present: Renoir, Daijiro NPCs present: None. Location: Meta-game Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: Before resuming the action, the players discuss rules about the functioning of Bard spells. Nacho (Renoir) clarifies how he can change spells when leveling up and discovers with relief that he does not need to prepare his spell list daily like a wizard, but rather he simply knows the spells and spends his spell slots. Scene 2: The Amalgam Butler PCs present: Renoir, Daijiro, Erdan NPCs present: Cyrus Bellevue (Mongrel, short and hunched, left side with lizard scales, panther ears, duck webbed foot, dog-furred arms. Archetype: Loyal and grotesque servant). Vistani Girl (Scared, armed with a chair leg. Archetype: Helpless victim). Location: Castle Ravenloft Corridors (Room K67). Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: The group finds themselves in a dark corridor with Cyrus Bellevue, the castle's butler. Cyrus calls them "treasures" and insists on taking them to their rooms so as not to disturb the master or Rahadin. As the group wants to go to the brazier room to escape, Renoir takes out his ocarina and casts Charm Person on Cyrus. Enchanted by the music, the deformed butler agrees to guide them through the guard dining room, a room horribly decorated with human bones that Cyrus boasts of as his "artwork." Scene 3: Rahadin's Pet PCs present: Renoir, Daijiro, Erdan NPCs present: Cyrus Bellevue Vistani Girl Shadow Demon / Rahadin's Pet (Telepathic voice with no visible origin, monstrous shadow form. Archetype: Sadistic predator). Location: Rahadin's Study. Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: Looking for a way out, the group enters Rahadin's study, an immaculate room with weapons on the walls. Upon closing the door, it locks itself. A telepathic voice resonates in their heads saying they are intruders. The voice belongs to Rahadin's "pet," a shadow being that feeds on fear. The demon allows them to live in exchange for keeping the Vistani girl to torture her and add her to his lord's choir of souls. The girl screams and curses Daijiro, but the adventurers decide not to intervene. As the demon tears apart and plays with the girl, Daijiro quickly locates a secret door and the group flees down the stairs, leaving Cyrus behind engrossed in the macabre spectacle. Scene 4: The Count's Illusion and the Brazier PCs present: Renoir, Daijiro, Erdan NPCs present: Strahd Illusion (Red eyes, menacing attitude. Archetype: False danger). Location: Secret stairs and Brazier Room (Castle Ravenloft). Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: As they descend a cobweb-filled staircase, mist condenses forming Strahd's figure, who warns them that their gods will not be able to save them. Daijiro, unfazed, throws four Magic Missiles at him, instantly dispelling the illusion. Upon reaching the bottom, they force a door and enter a room with two large iron statues, a magical brazier, and colored glass marbles. The brazier has a poetic riddle indicating where each color teleports. After a chaotic debate full of confusion (confusing blue with indigo) and using a Tarokka card reading by Renoir (which reveals "The Temptress" and "The Transmuter"), the group decides to throw the blue/indigo marble into the fire. As they touch the flame-changing flames, they are teleported one by one out of the castle. Scene 5: The Abbey of the Mad PCs present: Renoir, Daijiro, Erdan NPCs present: Clovin Bellevue (Two-headed mongrel - one goat, one cherub with crocodile skin -, crab claw, bear paw, dressed as a monk and very drunk. Archetype: Deformed jester/guard). The Abbot (Extremely handsome young man, perfect skin, blue eyes with white irises, calm voice. Archetype: Religious fanatic/Disturbed creator). Vasilka (Woman with alabaster skin, beautiful but expressionless, with stitches. Archetype: Flesh golem/The Bride). Location: St. Markovia Abbey (Krezk). Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: The group appears frozen from the cold in a strange abbey. In the room, they find Clovin, playing the viola and drunk, who gets scared and runs to call the "Abbot." Descending some stairs, the adventurers find themselves in a room with a fireplace alongside Vasilka (a woman with a vacant stare) and the Abbot. The Abbot, who is a servant of the god Lathander, explains that they are in Krezk and that the abbey is a madhouse to house the "mongrels." To the players' disbelief, the Abbot confesses with complete naturalness that Vasilka is a golem created from corpse parts; his divine mission is to build the perfect bride for Strahd and thus restore love to him and heal Barovia. The Abbot offers them asylum for the night and, at an unsettling moment, tells Renoir that his eyes are beautiful and would look very good on a woman's face, asking them in passing to get him a worthy wedding dress for his creation. The group, terrified but pretending otherwise, agrees to spend the night there.

title: 08 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 05
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Pirate Protocol in the Black Sun City PCs Present: Nemo (Captain) Pika (Pilot/Engineer) Jim/Jimmy (Security) Paloma (Diplomat/Broker) Emilio (Noble/Social) Rocío (Scholar/Gunner) Honor (Combatant/Aslan) NPCs Present: Krrsh (Vargr guide, ex-pirate with prosthetic arm) Port Woman (Enigmatic receptionist, possible clone) Monk of the House of No Questions (Healer/Informant) Petir Vallis (Pirate Lord, anti-Aslan psychopath) Naval Officer (Distinguished gentleman in the Grand Hotel) Important Developments in PCs' Lives or the Campaign: The crew has arrived at Theev, a famous pirate haven, seeking Miria Silverhand (second-in-command to Ferrik) to collect bounties from Torpol and Clarke, and to gain the favor of Admiral Darokin. They have established contact (and debts/deals) with two figures of power in the pirate city: warlord Petir Vallis and a mysterious high-ranking naval officer. They have located Miria Silverhand's whereabouts in the ship graveyard. Loose Ends: They must deliver 9 tons of spice to Petir Vallis as payment for information. Emilio has agreed not to return to the Naval Officer's port for one year in exchange for information (a temporary docking ban). The capture or elimination of Miria Silverhand and the location of her captain, Ferrik, still needs to be executed. Scene: Jump to the Unknown PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: Krrsh (Guide, crippled). Location: Deep Space (between Marduk and Theev). Ships: Banshee (Harrier, Captain Nemo). After paying docking fees in Marduk (2,400 credits) and leaving Margaret ashore, the crew prepares to pursue the pirates who attacked Torpol and Clarke. Krrsh explains they are looking for Ferrik and his second, Miria Silverhand. Apparently, Admiral Darokin wants Ferrik dead. The crew plans to capture them to collect bounties from the victim planets and earn Darokin's favor. They perform a jump to an empty hex where Krrsh indicates a secret fuel depot. They refuel with hydrogen, refine it, and jump towards the Theev system. Scene: The Law of Lords and the Law of the Street PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: Krrsh, Port Woman (Enigmatic, "too perfect," possible clone/android). Location: Black Sun (Theev). Ships: Banshee. They arrive in the Theev system, a desert world with a thin atmosphere. They land at the spaceport of Black Sun City, hidden beneath the surface. A mysterious woman greets them and explains the rules: in areas with red flags (Pirate Lords' territory) and the Upper District, violence is not permitted. In the rest (the canyons, the lower city), the "Law of the Street" rules. They are warned not to break atmospheric containment. Krrsh gives them a visual tour of the city, pointing out key locations like the Grand Hotel, the shipyards, and areas belonging to different factions. Scene: Purchases and Expensive Silences PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: Shop Vendor (One-eyed and toothless), Monk of the House of No Questions. Location: Lower City, Second-hand Shop, House of No Questions (Black Sun/Theev). The group descends into the dangerous Lower City. They purchase used chainmail armor (Cloth) for discreet protection. They decide to investigate Miria's whereabouts by going to the "House of No Questions," a place that mixes a church with a guild of assassins/healers. A monk attends to them and, after a long wait surrounded by the wounded and dying, asks for 100,000 credits for information about Miria. The group rejects the exorbitant price and decides to seek other avenues. Paloma attempts to bribe and investigate in local bars without success, only discovering who the local big shots are: Petir Vallis and the Aslan Roll Iron Tooth. Scene: Audience with the Psychopath PCs Present: Nemo, Pika, Jim, Honor, Rocío. NPCs Present: Petir Vallis (Pirate Lord, violent, hates Aslans), Miria Silverhand (Mentioned). Location: Red Flag Tower (Black Sun/Theev). Ships: Lion's Den (Corsair 600t, Captain Petir Vallis). Nemo decides to take the initiative and the group heads to the tower controlled by Petir Vallis, marked with the corpses of disemboweled Aslans at the entrance. After a failed initial approach by Nemo to a guard, the group enters armed but in a "diplomatic" attitude. The tension is high due to Petir's hatred of aliens and outsiders. Nemo manages to secure an audience with Petir. The pirate captain demands payment. Nemo offers the Banshee's spice cargo (9 tons). Petir accepts the payment and reveals that Miria Silverhand is hiding in a dilapidated ship in the junkyard area. Scene: High-Society Diplomacy PCs Present: Emilio. NPCs Present: Naval Officer (Distinguished gentleman, "old school," Archetype: Renegade Imperial Officer or Gentleman Pirate). Location: The Grand Hotel, Pink Pavilion Restaurant (Black Sun/Theev). While the others head to the trenches, Emilio goes up to the Upper District with Krrsh seeking a more civilized environment. In the hotel bar, he is discreetly approached by two uniformed escorts who take him to an older man, dressed in impeccable naval uniform. This gentleman knows they are looking for Miria and Ferrik. He offers Miria's location "for free," in exchange for a promise: that Emilio and his ship will not appear there again for at least a year. Emilio accepts the gentleman's agreement. The officer hands him a note with the junkyard's address, confirming the same information the other group obtained, but at a different diplomatic cost.

title: 08 - Prenupcia
content: Here is the translation of the provided text to English, without adding or inventing anything: Session Summary: Shadows, Bones, and Awkward Dinners in Vallaki Player Characters (PCs) present: Bigtoe, Ceres, Hulio. (Mention of Erdan through his familiar, and mention of the other half of the group: Broseph, Feyre, and Ladril Gabriel, who are at Castle Strahd). Non-Player Characters (NPCs) present/mentioned: Strahd (mentioned), Madame Eva (mentioned), Rictavio, Lucian Petrovich, Miloboj (mentioned), Mistress Martikov, Slordar, Yengeni, Burgomaster of Vallaki, Lidia (the Baroness), Victor (Burgomaster's son), Izek Strazni. Main Developments and Loose Ends Main Development: The group has begun exploring Vallaki, discovering that the city's supposed safety is a facade maintained by the forced happiness imposed by the Burgomaster. Furthermore, they have learned that Irina is being held captive in the attic of the Burgomaster's mansion, supposedly to be wed to his psychopathic son at the upcoming festival. Loose Ends: The bones of Saint Andral have been stolen from the church, leaving the place unprotected against Strahd. The acolyte (Miloboj) must be interrogated.        Ceres's detect magic* spell detected human bones in multiple houses in the city (including the Burgomaster's, Lady Wachter's, and the coffin maker's). The mystery of what Rictavio is hiding in his wagon (he claims it is an exotic beast for a circus). The lack of wine supply in the city and the whereabouts of the Martikov family members in the cellars. The strange flickering blue light seen in the attic window of the Burgomaster's mansion where Irina is being held. The Vistani camp and the elves on the outskirts of the city, which they have been warned not to visit. The Session's Gag During the tense dinner at the Burgomaster's mansion, the teenage son (Victor) begins to whisper grotesque death threats to Bigtoe under his breath. To escape the awkward and dangerous situation, Bigtoe stomps heavily on Hulio's foot under the table and, abruptly standing up in his guttural dwarven voice, blurts out: "Where is the privy? I need to take a dump." When the Burgomaster reprimands him, Bigtoe justifies it by saying that domestic violence and bad manners are "simply dwarven customs," prompting laughter from the gaming table. Scene 1: The Stables' Mysteries PCs present: Bigtoe, Ceres. NPCs present: Nohawk (Erdan's Familiar: unusually large crow with greyish/whitish feather tips). Location: Blue Water Inn Stables (Vallaki). Loot obtained: None. Summary: After safely stabling their draft horse, Bigtoe and Ceres examine the grey mare parked in the stable, suspecting it belongs to the mysterious Rictavio. Ceres notices a brand mark on its flank. As they inspect the area, Ceres calls for Erdan's familiar, Nohawk, who descends from the loft and perches on her shoulder. Bigtoe attempts to snoop in the stable loft but desists upon discovering it is infested with hundreds of crows staring intently at him. After securing the door to their own horse with a makeshift sand trap to know if anyone enters, they head out to explore the city. Scene 2: Lost Faith PCs present: Bigtoe, Ceres. NPCs present: Lucian Petrovich (Middle-aged priest, bald, dressed in robes. Archetype: The honest and desperate cleric). Location: Saint Andral's Church (Vallaki). Loot obtained: None (Ceres asks the priest for borrowed bandages). Summary: The group visits the village church, which appears to be in much better condition than the one in Barovia. Ceres strikes up a conversation with Father Lucian Petrovich using religious jargon. Upon mentioning Strahd, Lucian confesses a terrible secret: the church has lost its status as hallowed ground because someone stole Saint Andral's bones three days ago, ripping up the floorboards. The only ones who knew were him and his acolyte, Miloboj. Ceres proposes returning the next day with a Zone of Truth spell to interrogate the boy. Lucian also warns them about the Burgomaster's madness, the cruelty of his lieutenant Izek Strazni (who has a demonic arm that breathes fire), and mentions the Abbey of Saint Markovia in Krezk. Scene 3: Wolf Steaks and Circus Secrets PCs present: Bigtoe, Ceres, Hulio. NPCs present: Mistress Martikov (Elegant, black and white hair tied up with raven feathers, silver jewelry. Archetype: Altruistic and observant innkeeper), Slordar and Yengeni (Rough and bruised hunters. Archetype: Wasteland survivors), Rictavio (Elderly man, pointed ears, outlandish attire. Archetype: The eccentric outsider with secrets). Location: Streets of Vallaki and Blue Water Inn. Loot obtained: None (they are offered wine, but the wolf meat is added to their tab). Summary: Ceres uses detect magic to search for the stolen bones but only manages to detect human bones in several random houses, the Burgomaster's mansion, Lady Wachter's house, and the coffin shop. They head to the inn, where Mistress Martikov serves them free wine (Red Dragon Harvest), explaining that her family gives wine to the city to prevent people from going mad, though they haven't heard from the winery in a while. Some hunters bring the carcass of a dire wolf, and the innkeeper prepares wolf steaks for them. Rictavio appears, and Bigtoe quietly confronts him about his half-elven heritage and the creature in his wagon. Rictavio asks for discretion, claiming it is an exotic animal he is taming for a circus. He shows great interest when they tell him that the other half of the group is at Castle Ravenloft with Strahd. Scene 4: A Dinner Full of Joy and Psychopathy PCs present: Bigtoe, Ceres (leaves halfway), Hulio. NPCs present: Lidia, the Baroness (Well-coiffed white hair, red gothic dress ending in a point, black cape. Archetype: Delusional noble disconnected from reality), Burgomaster Vargas Vallakovich (Imposing, accompanied by mastiffs. Archetype: Paranoid dictator), Victor (16-year-old, semi-bald, prominent ears, chubby face, cheek reddened by a slap. Archetype: Psychopathic teenager), Izek Strazni (seen from afar, intimidating gaze, reptile/demon arm. Archetype: The monstrous enforcer). Location: Burgomaster's Mansion (Vallaki). Loot obtained: None. Summary: The group attends the dinner at the Burgomaster's mansion, being disarmed at the entrance. They are greeted by Lidia, the Baroness, who lives in a constant delusion about the "joy" of Vallaki. During dinner, they discover that Irina will not come down, as she is "indisposed by so much happiness" in the attic. Young Victor is seated next to Bigtoe and, behind his parents' backs, begins to whisper horrible death threats ("I'm going to eat your liver"). Bigtoe escapes the tension by pretending to go to the garden to relieve himself. Hulio attempts to persuade the Burgomaster to establish trade routes, but the idea is vehemently rejected due to the danger of the roads. It is implied that the Burgomaster plans to marry Irina to Victor at the upcoming "Festival of the Blazing Sun." Upon leaving the estate at night, the group observes flashes of a strange pale blue, electric light coming from the closed attic window where Irina is being held, leaving the group to deliberate whether to organize a nocturnal rescue.

title: 09 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 06
content: Here is the session summary strictly based on the provided transcript. Blood Pact at the Scrapyard PCs present: Nemo (Captain), Jimmy (infiltrator, played by Juan), Paloma, Honor (played by Rocío), Pika (communications, played by Emilio). Krrsh is also mentioned. NPCs present: Miria (Fugitive pirate), Alvarito (Ally of the PCs), Scrapyard Thugs. Important Developments: A tense alliance has been established with the pirate Miria to hunt down the pirate warlord Ferrik. The group has agreed to divide Ferrik's bounty: 250,000 credits for Miria and half of the cargo from Ferrik's ship, in exchange for her and her crew's help. Loose Ends: Miria's reliability is questionable; although she has accepted the deal, the group fears betrayal at any moment. The group must meet Miria at "La Calavera" (the spaceport) in two days after she picks up her crew and settles her affairs. Planning in Black Sand PCs present: Nemo, Jimmy, Paloma, Honor, Pika, Krrsh. NPCs present: None. Location(s): Black Sand City (Planet Theev/Tif), PCs' ship (Hangar/Spaceport). Ship(s): Banshee (Harrier Class, PCs' Ship). Scene Summary: The group lands in the lower city of Black Sand, on the pirates' planet (referred to as Tif or Cif). They discuss the strategy for capturing Miria, a pirate captain who works for Ferrik and for whose capture (and that of her boss) there is a bounty. They discard an initial direct assault in favor of a mixed approach. Paloma and Rocío (Honor) are tasked with buying supplies and grenades, while Pika manages communications to ensure a closed and secure network among them. Nemo and Jimmy decide to go ahead to scout the terrain disguised as vagrants to avoid drawing attention. Ambush at the Scrapyard PCs present: Nemo, Jimmy. NPCs present: Three local thugs (Low-level gang members, opportunists). Location(s): The Scrapyard / "Scrapyard" (Outskirts of Black Sand, Planet Theev). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: Nemo and Jimmy venture into the scrapyard area, a labyrinthine zone formed by abandoned ship hulls and shacks. During their exploration, they are intercepted by three hostile individuals (a large guy with a club, a woman, and another man). An immediate firefight breaks out. Nemo and Jimmy, superior in armament and tactics, take down two of the assailants (one with a shotgun and another with a laser pistol) and wound the woman, who flees. They briefly loot the bodies, finding only a few credits and alcohol, before abandoning the area to avoid unwanted attention. Assault on the Sunken Freighter PCs present: Nemo, Jimmy, Paloma, Honor, Pika, Alvarito. NPCs present: Miria (Pirate Captain, Thin woman, blue hair, bionic arm with weapon implant). Location(s): Wreckage of a Subsidized Merchant (The Scrapyard, Planet Theev). Ship(s): Merciful (Subsidized Merchant, Miria's ship, wrecked). Scene Summary: The group regroups and locates the ship where Miria is hiding, a ruined Subsidized Merchant half-submerged in toxic water within a crater. They enter through the upper hangar and descend a ladder into the dark, unpowered interior of the ship. As they advance down a corridor, they are ambushed by Miria, who takes cover and opens fire with a minigun attached to her bionic arm. An intense firefight ensues in the narrow corridor. The PCs take cover and return fire, attempting to flank or stun her, but Miria's armor and position make advancement difficult. Amidst the hail of bullets, Captain Nemo opts for shouted diplomacy. He offers her a deal: join them to take down Ferrik (Miria's boss) in exchange for a portion of the bounty and protection from Admiral Darokin. After tense haggling where Miria demands more money (250,000 credits and half the cargo), they agree to a truce. Miria lowers her weapon, agreeing to meet them at the spaceport "La Calavera" in 48 hours to begin the hunt for Ferrik.

title: 09 - Shadows on the rooftop
content: Here is the session summary following your strict instructions, using Spanish from Spain and based solely on the provided transcript. Session Title: Shadows on the Rooftop and Confessions at the Altar PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Hulio, Ladril Gabriel (Sir Gabriel / fomega). NPCs present: Víctor, Irina, Attic Guard, Ernst (Larnaca), Yevgeni (Geni), Sjölder, Urik (Innkeeper), Father Lucian Petrovich, Milibob (Milojov Petrovich). Main Developments and Loose Ends The session focused on the stealthy infiltration of the Burgomaster's mansion and the investigation into the stolen church bones. The group has discovered Irina's dark fate and made initial contact with the village's rival faction. Loose ends that need follow-up: Irina's Rescue: She remains tied to a bed in the mansion, threatened by Víctor's grim plans. There are three days left until the supposed wedding. Lady Fiora's (Lady West) Invitation: Ernst delivered a formal invitation for the group to dine that same evening at the Westerhaus mansion. Yeska and the Bones' Whereabouts: Milibob confessed to telling the secret of Saint Andrew's bones to Yeska, the young gravedigger who sleeps in a shed in the cemetery. They must go find him. Víctor's Experiments: It remains unexplained what exactly the Burgomaster's son is doing with animated skeletal cats and blue rune circles in his room. The Session Joke "The Rope Debate": Pulgar (Juan) and the DM (Nemo) engaged in a technical, hilarious, and absurdly long discussion about the physics of a 50-foot rope. They debated whether gravity would make the rope fall, how it would drag across the mossy tiles making noise, whether Pulgar carried it on his shoulder like a firehose, or if it would snag on the rain gutters. The situation was so extensive that another player had to intervene to say: "The rope debate is key." Scene 1: The Dwarf Spider-Man PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Hulio. NPCs present: Víctor (Young, thin, inscribes arcane runes on the floor - Archetype: Eccentric Mage / Dark Apprentice). Irina (Trembling voice, melancholic, sobbing, tied to a bed - Archetype: Damsel in Distress). Guard (Man in armor, spear, helmet, almost monstrous appearance, ignoble sleeping posture - Archetype: Sleeping Sentinel). Location(s): Exterior, facade, and rooftops of the Burgomaster's Mansion (Balaqui). Loot obtained: None. Scene Summary: After leaving dinner, the group decides not to make a big fuss by confronting Isaac's guard. Ceres casts Enhance Ability on Pulgar to give him advantage in Strength. The dwarf stealthily climbs the damp and mossy facade of the mansion to the rooftop. Looking through the windows, Pulgar discovers a dusty room where Víctor is casting rhythmic magic surrounded by skeletal cats and child mannequins. In another window, which has been boarded up from the inside, Pulgar manages to pry open a gap and whispers with Irina. She begs him to get her out, revealing that Víctor plans to disembowel her. Pulgar also locates the attic guarded by a sleeping guard. Seeing that an improvised rescue is very risky, the dwarf decides to descend to plan something better with the group. Scene 2: The Chase Through Balaqui PCs present: Hulio, Ceres, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present: Ernst / Larnaca (Short, "a meter sixty-five", elusive, cowardly, wears a dark cape and rapier, has a chipped tooth - Archetype: Spy / Informant). Location(s): Dark streets and alleys of the village. Loot obtained: None (Potential alliance and an invitation). Scene Summary: While Pulgar watches for guard changes, the rest of the group heads to the inn. Hulio notices a figure observing them from a nearby rooftop. Once discovered, the individual descends via a downspout and flees. Ceres, Hulio, and Ladril Gabriel initiate a high-speed chase through the dark streets. Ceres attempts to cast Sacred Flame without much success, but eventually, Hulio manages to corner him in the shadows, brandishing his great axe. The man, terrified, drops his rapier and surrenders. He confesses his name is Ernst and that he works as an observer for Lady Fiora (Lady West), the Burgomaster's rival noble. After a tense negotiation, Ceres suggests Ernst arrange an official meeting, to which the spy, who calls himself "Larnaca," happily agrees before leaving. Scene 3: Night of Drunks and Wolves PCs present: Hulio (Ceres and Ladril Gabriel listen in the background). NPCs present: Yevgeni / Geni and Sjölder (Rough, drunk, ruddy-cheeked, community hunters - Archetype: Rough Patrons / Local Hunters). Lady Fiora's Sons (Mentioned as very drunk). Location(s): The Blue Waters Inn. Loot obtained: Information about local fauna and rumors about werewolves. Scene Summary: Upon arriving at the inn, which is nearly empty late at night, Hulio decides to sit with the only awake patrons: a couple of wolf hunters who are quite drunk. Despite initial wary glances, Hulio uses his hunting knowledge to gain their favor. Geni and Sjölder explain that hunting is abundant to the east but seriously warn him to avoid the northwest, as that is where large packs gather and, according to whispers, werewolves also exist. The hunters explain they work for the community in exchange for bed and board (free wine). After the chat, the group retires to rest. Scene 4: The Altar Boy's Secret PCs present: Ceres, Hulio, Ladril Gabriel. NPCs present: Father Lucian Petrovich (Protective, disappointed but sensible - Archetype: Spiritual Guide). Milibob / Milojov (Young man around 16-19 years old, orphan, shy, tearful, has been an altar boy for 4 years - Archetype: Unwitting Accomplice). Location(s): A small room / Father's study in Saint Andrew's Church (San Andral). Loot obtained: The name and location of the main suspect in the theft (Yeska). Scene Summary: The next morning (while Pulgar is still sleeping at the inn to recover from a sleepless night), the trio goes to the church to interrogate Milibob about the stolen holy bones. They meet in a small room where Ceres sits beside the boy and subtly casts magic that prevents him from lying. Although Ceres tries to relax him with small talk, the boy is very tense. Cornered by the magic and the pressure, Milibob breaks down and tearfully confesses that he let the secret slip. He told the exact location of the relics to his friend Yeska, the young orphan gravedigger who works at the church and sleeps in a shed in the cemetery. Father Lucian is surprised and disappointed, but the group calms the situation, assuring him that they only want to recover the bones without harming the boys. The group prepares to visit the cemetery.

title: 09.5 - Abadia
content: Here is the translation of the provided text to English, without adding or inventing anything: Session Summary: The Miracle of Krezk and the Flesh Bride PCs present: Broseph (Juan Maldonado), Erdan (Marcos), Renard / Yankee (Nacho). Note: At the end of the session, Paloma and Álvaro intervene out of character. NPCs present: Clovin Bellevue, The Abbot, Vasilka, Ezmerelda d'Avenir, Dimitris (Burgomaster of Cres/Krezk), Yelenko (Dimitris' son), Krezk Guards, Bandits/Werewolves. Locations: St. Markovia's Abbey, Cres (Krezk), Road to Valaki (Vallaki). Main Development and Loose Ends The group discovers the Abbot's true and disturbing plan to save Barovia: to create a perfect flesh bride (a golem) for Strahd to fall in love with and lift the curse. After spending the night at the Abbey—where they secretly meet the bride herself (Vasilka) and the monster hunter Ezmerelda—the Abbot demonstrates his divine power by resurrecting the deceased son of Krezk's Burgomaster. However, the miracle has a price: the Burgomaster must obtain a wedding dress from Vallaki within a month, or his son will die again. The group departs as escort to Vallaki but are ambushed by werewolves on the road, leaving the session on a cliffhanger just as combat begins. Loose ends: Will Ezmerelda survive her solo foray into Castle Ravenloft? Who is the "grumpy old man" who taught Ezmerelda to hunt, and why is he hiding? Will they reach Vallaki in time to get the wedding dress and save the Burgomaster's family from the Abbot's ultimatum? Is Krezk's holy pool truly magical, and will there be any side effects from the water Erdan drank? Session Joke The best joke arises from a tragic story in Barovia's lore. When Ezmerelda tells them that Strahd annihilated all the women of an ancient race of elves, leaving only the men alive as punishment and forbidding them from leaving Barovia, the group quickly deduces the reproductive consequences. Amidst laughter, they conclude that "all elves are gay" by obligation, as they have been locked away for centuries without women, commenting with dark humor that they "have nothing to lose" when facing Strahd, because they are already screwed for life. Scene 1: A Dinner with the Creator and his Madness PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renard. NPCs present:    The Abbot (Archetype: Religious fanatic / Disguised celestial entity*. Traits: Human appearance but unusually young and handsome, perfect skin without blemishes or facial hair, orderly, unexpressive to insults, gives off a sense of being much older than he appears).    Clovin Bellevue (Archetype: Tragic henchman*. Traits: Two-headed mutant—one head is a muñon shaped like a baby with a forked tongue—crab claws, and bear legs. Plays the violin and constantly drinks from a flask). Location: Dining hall of St. Markovia's Abbey. Loot: None (magical, bland but nutritious food). Summary: The group dines with the Abbot and Clovin. The Abbot magically summons food and water (gruel). During dinner, he reveals his grand plan dictated by his deity, Lathander: he has been constructing a flesh golem from corpses to create the perfect bride for Strahd, convinced that love will redeem the vampire and lift Barovia's curse. Erdan, incredulous and defiant, repeatedly questions the Abbot's logic, arguing that Strahd is a monster who will not cease to be one for love. The Abbot remains imperturbable in his fanaticism and calls Erdan a "mere worm" incapable of understanding his vision. Renard and Broseph try to mediate to avoid angering their host. The Abbot warns them not to leave their room at night due to the mongrels roaming the Abbey. Scene 2: Nocturnal Visits PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Renard. NPCs present:    Vasilka (Archetype: Monstrous innocent*. Traits: Extremely beautiful flesh golem, made of pieces with visible stitches, gorgeous eyes, cold to the touch, naive and hopeful like a child). Location: Guest room in St. Markovia's Abbey. Loot: None. Summary: The group barricades themselves in a dilapidated room to sleep and stand guard. Broseph investigates the beds and discovers that a woman stayed there a couple of days ago. During Broseph's watch, someone softly knocks on the door. It is Vasilka, the Abbot's "creation." Despite being made of corpses, she is stunning. She sneaks away from her "father" (the Abbot) to anxiously ask about Strahd and his castle, dreaming of being his wife. Broseph tactfully tells her that Strahd is rich and educated, but also a psychopathic tyrant. She ignores the bad, happy about her future. She also reveals that someone named Esmeralda stayed there before them. Renard manages to gently persuade her to return to her quarters before the Abbot discovers her, promising they will get her a worthy dress for her wedding. Scene 3: A Stealthy Encounter PCs present: Erdan. NPCs present:    Ezmerelda d'Avenir (Archetype: Solitary hunter*. Traits: Vistani woman, dark-skinned with curly hair, cautious, carries a drawn sword, capable of casting invisibility spells). Location: Teleportation room in the Abbey / Outer walls. Loot: None. Summary: Erdan ignores the warnings, abandons his guard duty (leaving his companions asleep), and goes out to explore the Abbey. After avoiding the Bellevue mongrels singing creepy rhymes about Strahd and Tatiana in the cells, he reaches the room where the group magically appeared days ago. There he surprises Ezmerelda, a Vistani hunter. After a tense introduction, she asks him about the interior of Castle Ravenloft, planning to use the teleportation point to set a trap for the vampire. Erdan proposes they ally with them, but she rejects him, stating she works alone. She advises them to visit Madame Eva to learn their destiny but warns them not to trust the rest of the Vistani. Before disappearing by becoming invisible, she asks Erdan that if they see a "grumpy old man" (her master), they shouldn't tell him she is there. Upon returning to the room, Renard wakes up, discovers that Erdan left them alone, and becomes extremely angry with him. Scene 4: The Abbot's Miracle PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Renard. NPCs present:    Dimitris (Archetype: Desperate leader*. Traits: Middle-aged, limps and suffers from gout).    Yelenko (Archetype: Resurrected*. Traits: Teenager about 16-17 years old, pale). Clovin Bellevue. The Abbot. Location: Village of Krezk (Cres) and the Burgomaster's house. Loot: Restorative water from the holy pool (Erdan fills his canteen). Summary: In the morning, after enduring a very drunk Clovin playing the violin, the Abbot appears and asks them to follow him. They descend from the Abbey towards the village of Krezk. The villagers flee in terror at the sight of the Abbot. They arrive at the square, where they are met by Burgomaster Dimitris surrounded by guards and armed villagers. The Abbot enters the Burgomaster's house, where they are mourning the corpse of his teenage son, Yelenko. With a prayer to Lathander, the Abbot resurrects the boy, causing shock and joy. However, the Abbot collects his favor: he demands that the Burgomaster obtain a high-quality wedding dress from Vallaki within a month. If he fails, the son will die again, and the Burgomaster will pay with his life. The Burgomaster asks the adventurers to escort his wife by carriage to Vallaki to buy the dress. Before departing, Erdan visits the village's holy pool and discovers that its water has restorative properties, filling his canteen. Scene 5: Ambush on the Old Road PCs present: Broseph, Erdan, Renard. NPCs present:    The Burgomaster's Wife and 4 Krezk Guards (Archetype: Cannon fodder*. Traits: Young, scared, and inexperienced).    Bandits / Werewolves (Archetype: Savage predators*. Traits: Unkempt men, toothless, dirty beards, armed with spears, accompanied by wolves). Location: The old Svalich road to Vallaki. Loot: None. Summary: The group departs from Krezk in a carriage pulled by two horses. Broseph travels on the top, while Erdan and Renard walk alongside the frightened guards. During the journey, they realize a pack of wolves is stalking them from the forest, terrifying the guards. As they round a bend, they find the road blocked by fallen trees. Several unkempt bandits armed with spears emerge from the undergrowth, accompanied by giant wolves, demanding they hand over everything they have. Erdan wastes no time chatting and immediately attacks with Magic Missile. Far from dying, the bandit leader's wounds begin to heal instantly as he smiles maliciously and starts transforming into a huge lycanthrope beast (Werewolf). The session ends just as combat is about to erupt.
