title: 10 - Ataudes
content: Here is the session summary translated to English, strictly following the format and information provided in the transcript. Dinner with Betrayal and Bones in the Night PCs present: Pulgar, Ceres, Broseph, Feyre, Hulio, Erdan, Renoir (Yankee/Nacho). NPCs present: Yesca (altar boy), Father Lucian, Lady Wachter (Fiora/Fiona), Nicolai and Karl, Henrik van der Voort (coffin maker). (Note: Strahd, Irina, Victor, and Madame Eva are mentioned but are not physically present in the scenes). Major developments and loose ends: Major developments: The group has reunited with Feyre after her encounter with Strahd. They have discovered who stole the sacred bones of Saint Andral and have managed to recover them by infiltrating the carpentry shop. Furthermore, they have discovered that Lady Wachter is a staunch loyalist of Strahd and have rejected her offer to assassinate the burgomaster. Loose ends: They know there is a nest with at least half a dozen vampires (or spawn) sleeping in dirt boxes in the upper floor of the coffin shop. Irina remains captive in the burgomaster's mansion under threat of marrying Victor, the psychopathic son who is performing teleportation or summoning rituals with dead cats and mannequins in his room. They still need to investigate what happened to the Wine Mage's shipment. They must decide whether to visit Madame Eva or bring Irina's brother from Barovia to take charge of the political situation. Session Joke: The highlight of the night goes to the infiltration of the coffin shop. Broseph sneaks in by rolling extremely high on Stealth, believing it to be a routine break-in at an empty house, and calmly searches the room of the carpenter who sleeps with his eyes open. The comedic contrast arrives when Renoir, who has gone invisible, rolls Perception inspired by the bard, and points out a trail of blood leading to a room full of boxes with dirt. The group suddenly realizes that the poor carpenter is sleeping wall-to-wall with half a dozen vampires, causing silent panic, as they slowly close doors and flee the house with the unanimous idea of returning during the day to set the entire building on fire. Scene 1: The Reunion and the Rumors PCs present: Feyre, Pulgar, Ceres, Broseph, Hulio, Erdan, Renoir. NPCs present: None directly. Place(s): Inn in Vallaki. Any loot obtained: None. Summary of the scene: After a couple of days separated from the group, Feyre reunites with her companions at the village inn. She tells them that she managed to escape from Strahd thanks to the help of a flock of crows that distracted him. The group updates her on the situation in Vallaki: Irina is being "hosted" (held captive) at the burgomaster's house and they want to marry her off to his son, an aspiring necromancer. They also tell her about the missing bones of Saint Andral, the imminent dinner to which they have been invited by Lady Wachter, and the mysterious delay in the local wine shipment. Scene 2: Yesca's Confession PCs present: Ceres, Hulio, Feyre, Broseph. NPCs present: Yesca (Scared teenager with a shovel in his hands; archetype: Manipulated/repentant pawn), Father Lucian (Compassionate and mediating priest; archetype: Spiritual guide). Place(s): Cemetery behind Saint Andral's church. Any loot obtained: None. Summary of the scene: Guided by Father Lucian, the group amicably corners Yesca in the cemetery as he digs a hole. Broseph stays to watch outside the iron gate. Ceres stealthily casts Zone of Truth. When Yesca realizes he cannot lie, he panics and tries to flee, but Hulio catches him mid-air by grabbing his shirt. Once on the ground, Yesca confesses that he stole the bones because Henrik van der Voort, the reclusive coffin maker with whom he used to drink, offered him a good sum of money for them. Scene 3: Loot Distribution and Dark Secrets PCs present: Pulgar, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Hulio, Erdan, Feyre. NPCs present: None. Place(s): Inn room. Any loot obtained: A manual/magic training book (+2 Constitution), 30 silver pieces, 12 electro pieces, and a lot of platinum pieces (about 63 pieces per person are distributed). Summary of the scene: All gathered in the room (while Renoir pretends to go for a bath), Pulgar lays a cape on the table with the loot they took from Strahd's castle. They give the magic book to Hulio, who will have to read it and exercise every morning for six days to gain the benefits. They distribute the coins to maintain common funds. During the chat, Broseph reveals to Erdan what he saw in the burgomaster's son's room: a circle etched on the floor, animated cat skeletons, and child mannequins, deducing that he is trying to summon demons or teleport. Erdan is deeply affected and depressed by the evil of Barovia. Scene 4: Dinner with Lady Wachter PCs present: Ceres, Hulio, Renoir, Erdan, Feyre. (Broseph stays outside). NPCs present: Lady Wachter (Thin, pale woman with a Victorian hairstyle and a stern expression; archetype: Conspiring noble), Nicolai and Karl (Drunk and ill-mannered young men; archetype: Spoiled rich kids), Lady Wachter's Spy (Servant; archetype: Infiltrator). Place(s): Dining room of Wachterhaus (Wachter Mansion). Any loot obtained: None (except for salty soup that Renoir tries to empty without eating using Sleight of Hand). Summary of the scene: Two of Lady Wachter's drunk sons escort the PCs to the mansion. Broseph decides not to enter and stays outside to spy. In the dining room, Lady Wachter serves them soup (attended by the spy the group already knew). The conversation turns political and tense. The noblewoman harshly criticizes the burgomaster, calling him demented for defying Strahd. When the PCs question Strahd by calling him a tyrant and a sociopath, she defends him as the rightful lord and reveals that she wants to rule Vallaki in his name. She offers the group a magic item if they assassinate the burgomaster. The group rejects the proposal for moral reasons; Lady Wachter, disgusted by their "prejudices," leaves the dinner and abandons them halfway through. Scene 5: The Coffin Maker's Shop PCs present: Broseph, Renoir, Pulgar, Ceres, Feyre, Hulio, Erdan. NPCs present: Henrik van der Voort (Reclusive man, sleeping with his eyes open in his bed; archetype: Terrified civilian). Place(s): Coffin shop (ground floor full of mold, and alcove/workshop on the upper floor). Any loot obtained: A sack with Saint Andral's bones, a sack with 30 silver pieces and 12 electro pieces, and a crumpled child's drawing. Mundane adventuring gear (nails, rope, grappling hook, blankets). Summary of the scene: Taking advantage of the night, the group decides to raid the coffin shop. Broseph skillfully forces the back lock and enters stealthily. After searching the ground floor (full of closed coffins), he goes up to the second floor with Renoir, who is under an invisibility spell. Broseph enters Henrik's room, barricades the door, and discovers a false bottom in his closet, stealing the sacks with the coins and Saint Andral's bones. Meanwhile, Renoir inspects a trail of blood in the hallway that leads to a room with large boxes full of dirt. They discover that at least half a dozen creatures are sleeping inside with a strong trace of necrotic and undead magic (vampires). Totally terrified, they unbar the door and silently flee the house. Scene 6: Bones Secured and New Plans PCs present: Broseph, Pulgar, Ceres, Renoir, Erdan, Feyre, Hulio. NPCs present: Father Lucian. Place(s): Saint Andral's church and inn. Any loot obtained: A vial of holy water. Summary of the scene: The group goes to the church at dawn to return the bones to Father Lucian. The priest is immensely grateful and promises them healing and help in the future; he also gives them holy water as a gift. They secretly inform him of the presence of the vampires in the carpentry shop. After leaving a donation in the collection box, the group debates their next move: they consider setting fire to the carpentry shop during the day to kill the vampires, hesitate on how to rescue Irina (or if they should give her a dagger to defend herself), and decide that the next morning they will go shopping, look for a map, and plot a route to the Wine Mage or back to Barovia to speak with Madame Eva and Irina's brother.

title: 10 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 07
content: Session Title: Alliance at The Skull and the Hunt in Palindrome PCs present: Nemo (Captain) Pika (Medic/Scientist) Chris (Sniper/Combat) Other crew members (referred to as Rocío and Emilio/Roberto, presumably Krrsh or Honor) NPCs present:    Miria (Pirate, Captain of the Mercyfooch*) Aida (Mentioned out of character, daughter of the GM) Important developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: A temporary alliance has been established with the pirate Miria to hunt Ferric and collect a bounty of 2,500,000 credits (of which 250,000 will go to Miria). Significant purchases of personal equipment and ship maintenance have been made to prepare for combat. Loose ends:    The space combat against Ferric's ship, the Yan Altosk*, has just begun as it leaves lunar orbit. The crew's financial situation is precarious, with a mentioned accounting deficit of -72,564 credits, though they have cash for immediate operations. Nemo has a pending debt of one million credits (possibly to the Temple of Science or a similar entity) that he has promised to pay "next year." Scene: Logistics, Accounting, and Supplies PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Chris, rest of the crew. NPCs present: None (interaction with purchase systems). Location: Spaceport (System not specified, presumably where they docked previously). Ships: Banshee (Model unknown, Captain Nemo/PCs). Scene Summary: The crew dedicates time to managing the ship's finances. Payment for maintenance (costs of 66,082 or 79,082 credits) is discussed, and the "time track" is updated. Pika reports on his new medical equipment, including Starlight Drops (infrared vision drops), a personal medical scanner, and drugs like Slow Drug and Panacea. He also mentions possessing a Gauss pistol. Nemo attempts to find a holographic projector without success, but purchases a full-body hair treatment (pink hair) as a gesture towards Krrsh. Chris and Pika acquire Laser Sights for their weapons. Scene: Deal at The Skull PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Chris (on lookout outside), rest of the crew. NPCs present: Miria (Woman with a cybernetic/iron arm, cynical and distrustful attitude, Veteran Pirate archetype). Location: "La Calavera" bar, located in a spaceport carved into an asteroid. Ships: Mercyfooch (Miria's ship). Scene Summary: The crew heads to "La Calavera" bar to meet with Miria. Chris remains outside as security while Nemo and Pika enter, unarmed of long weapons but with hidden pistols. They find Miria playing pinball. After sharing some whiskies, they negotiate the plan to trap Ferric. Miria reveals that Ferric is hiding on a moon awaiting their arrival. They agree that Miria will serve as bait to draw him out, while the PCs' ship, with better sensors, remains hidden to ambush him. Miria demands 250,000 credits and half the cargo for her help. Nemo accepts, they toast, and prepare to depart. Scene: Jump to Palindrome and Ambush PCs present: All PCs on the bridge. NPCs present: Miria (via communications), Ferric (via sensors/laser communications). Location: Deep space and Palindrome System (Specifically near the moon of a gas giant). Ships:    Banshee / CIF* (PCs' ship).    Mercyfooch* (Miria's ship).    Yan Altosk* (Target ship, Captain Ferric). Scene Summary: After refueling the Banshee (42 tons of fuel), the PCs coordinate the hyperspace jump with Miria's ship. After a week of travel, they arrive in the Palindrome system with only minutes between them. They stealthily head towards the moon of the gas giant where Ferric is hiding. The Banshee remains hidden behind the moon or by shutting down active sensors, while Miria approaches and scans the area. Miria contacts Ferric via point-to-point laser. The target ship, Yan Altosk, emerges from its hiding place in orbit. At this moment, the PCs' crew initiates a surprise attack.

title: 11 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 08
content: Hunt in Palindrome PCs present Nemo (Captain), Honor (Pilot/Gunner), Pika (Communications/Sensors), Fomega (Engineer/Medic), James (Security/Boarding), Rocío (Gunner). NPCs present Miria (Allied Pirate Captain), Ferrik Redchain (Mission Target), Krrsh (Aslan crewmember of the Banshee). Campaign Development Capture Ferrik Redchain alive, an important target for a bounty on the Borite or Torpol worlds.    Neutralization and scuttling of the ship Janal Torsk*. Resolution of the debt with Captain Miria by delivering the recovered cargo, consolidating a reputation as pirates who keep their word but avoiding future entanglements. Loose Ends Ferrik Redchain's claim that Admiral Darokin works for Imperial Intelligence and that he possesses proof. Collecting the bounty for Ferrik and selling the recovered data from his computer. Returning to a safe port, with the possibility of engaging in piracy along the route. The Trap on the Moon PCs present: All. NPCs present: Miria (Captain of the Mercyfuge, temporary ally, pragmatic), Ferrik Redchain (Captain of the Janal Torsk, target, cautious). Location: Orbit of a gas giant moon (Palindrome System). Ships: The Banshee (PCs), Mercyfuge (Model 400t, Captain Miria), Janal Torsk (Far Trader 200t, Captain Ferrik Redchain). Summary: After traveling to the Palindrome system and refueling, the PCs position themselves in an ambush while the Mercyfuge acts as bait. Miria manages to convince Ferrik Redchain to leave his hiding spot on the moon. Once the Janal Torsk is exposed, the Banshee and the Mercyfuge initiate a coordinated attack. Space Combat and Revelations PCs present: All. NPCs present: Ferrik Redchain (Desperate, attempts to negotiate). Location: Deep space (Palindrome System). Ships: The Banshee (PCs), Mercyfuge (Captain Miria), Janal Torsk (Captain Ferrik Redchain). Summary: Space combat erupts. Honor maneuvers the Banshee while Rocío and Honor fire the weapons, achieving critical hits that destroy the jump drive and severely damage the hull and power plant of the Janal Torsk. Pika effectively blocks enemy communications. Faced with imminent defeat, Ferrik attempts to negotiate his surrender, claiming Admiral Darokin is an Imperial Intelligence spy and offering proof. Nemo rejects the deal, and the crew decides to disable the enemy ship completely, leaving it adrift and losing atmosphere. Silent Boarding PCs present: Fomega, James, Nemo, Pika, Honor. NPCs present: Krrsh (Aslan, suggests lethal tactics). Location: Interior of the Janal Torsk (Palindrome System). Ships: The Banshee (PCs), Janal Torsk (Depressurized wreck). Summary: The PCs decide to wait a few hours for the enemy crew's life support and suit air to deplete to avoid armed resistance. After monitoring the situation with medical sensors, they board the ship. They encounter minimal resistance and corpses; Fomega manages to stabilize and save Ferrik Redchain's life at the last moment to deliver him alive. They loot the ship's computers for data and secure the stolen petrochemical cargo. Loot Distribution and Farewell PCs present: Nemo, James, Fomega. NPCs present: Miria (Satisfied with the deal). Location: Ship-to-ship communications (Palindrome System). Ships: The Banshee (PCs), Mercyfuge (Captain Miria). Summary: The distribution of loot with Miria is negotiated. To avoid having to meet her again in the future and to settle the agreed-upon debt of 250,000 credits, Nemo and the crew offer her the entirety of the recovered petrochemical cargo (valued at a similar sum). Miria accepts the deal, takes the cargo, and leaves the system. The PCs are left with the prisoner, the data, and the ship's remains, planning their route back towards Torpol or Borite to collect the bounty, considering some piracy along the way.

title: 11 - Viva el Vino
content: Here is the session summary structured according to your instructions and written in Spanish from Spain, using only the information provided in the transcript. Session: The Wine Mage and the Splinter Horde PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Pulgar, Hulio, and Feyre. NPCs present: Toymaker/Puppeteer of Balaqui, Noblewoman from Krezk, Davian Martikov, Enemy Druid. Main Developments and Loose Ends Main Developments: The group resupplied in Balaqui, acquiring a valuable map of Barovia and an additional horse to pull two carts. They traveled to "The Wine Mage" winery to collect the delayed shipment. Upon arrival, they learned from Patriarch Davian Martikov that the winery has been taken over by druids and a horde of hundreds of wooden creatures (splinters). They discovered the existence of three magical gems that made the vines grow, which have been stolen (one 10 years ago, another by Baba Lizaga, and the last 5 days ago by the druids who took it to Yesterday's Hill). The session ended in the midst of combat after a failed infiltration. Loose Ends:        They must return to the shop in Balaqui in a week to pick up the remaining 3 doses of components for the Protection from Evil and Good* spell (paid for with a topaz necklace). The noblewoman from Krezk has 10 platinum coins that Erdan gave her to commission a wedding dress to save her son; Renoir promised to help her with the bargaining later. Renoir commissioned the toymaker to create personalized dolls of the group members. They must recover the stolen magical gems, especially the one taken to Yesterday's Hill, if they want the winery to function again. Survive the massive combat against the hundreds of creatures and the druid that has just erupted in the winery. Session Gag The most comical moment of the session occurred during the winery infiltration. Renoir, being invisible, accompanied Pulgar to "watch his back." However, Renoir rolled a 1 (critical failure) on Stealth, dropping a pair of pliers to the ground and triggering a general alarm. Upon hearing the creatures, Renoir used Levitate to fly comfortably to the rooftop, leaving Pulgar completely alone, cornered in the basement, and receiving a beating from five creatures and a druid. Pulgar's complaint from the shadows: "Renuar, weren't you watching my back?" caused laughter around the table at the unintentional betrayal. Scene 1: The Expensive Purchases of Balaqui PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Pulgar, Hulio.    NPCs present: Puppeteer (pleasant, with a peculiar accent, lonely - Archetype: Eccentric Merchant), Noblewoman from Krezk (desperate, familiar, saddened - Archetype: Damsel in Distress*). Location: Balaqui (Supply shop, Puppet shop, Inn/Stables).    Loot obtained: Backpack, rations, component pouches, silver/iron powder for spells, thieves' tools. A map of Barovia (3 platinum coins). Dolls (a Strahd ventriloquist dummy, a headless doll, dolls resembling Irena). 3 uses of Protection from Evil* components (in exchange for a 750 gp topaz necklace). A horse (for 10 platinum coins). Summary: The group suffers Ravenloft's economy, debating the high costs of magical components, as everything costs five times as much. While most buy rations and supplies, Renoir visits the puppet shop and buys macabre toys, also commissioning dolls of the group. Pulgar finances a map of the region. Erdan solves the transportation problem by negotiating with the noblewoman from Krezk: he gives her 10 platinum coins in exchange for her horse, providing her with initial funds for the wedding dress she needs to save her family. Scene 2: The Road of Mists PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Pulgar, Hulio, Feyre. NPCs present: None. Location: Road from Balaqui towards The Wine Mage (Crossing bridges and intersections). Loot obtained: None. Summary: Mounted on two carts (one of them Irena's) pulled by their horses, the group travels along a road shrouded in fog and drizzle. They pass several intersections marked by wooden posts pointing to Krezk, Lake Baratok, Verez, and The Wine Mage. Hulio examines the road, finding sporadic traces of nomads and constant wolf tracks. Finally, they descend a muddy path that opens into a fog-covered meadow where the vineyards are visible. Scene 3: Davian Martikov's Lament PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Pulgar, Hulio, Feyre.    NPCs present: Davian Martikov (man around 50 years old, cautious, distrustful at first, protective - Archetype: Exiled Patriarch*). Location: Forest edge, half a mile from The Wine Mage's house. Loot obtained: None (Promise of wine and goods from the house if they manage to recover it). Summary: A hooded man gestures to them from the grove. He introduces himself as Davian Martikov and warns them to leave, as the winery has been taken over. He explains that the wine production was sustained by three magical gems: one was lost ten years ago, another was recently stolen by scarecrows from the witch Baba Lizaga, and the last was stolen five days ago by druids who took it to Yesterday's Hill. Two days ago, the druids returned with a horde of splinter creatures and drove out the family. Davian offers them everything in the house if they manage to drive out the druids. Scene 4: Infiltration, Mishaps, and the Horde Awakens PCs present: Erdan, Broseph, Renoir, Ceres, Pulgar, Hulio, Feyre.    NPCs present: Enemy Druid (Hoarse voice, wears a sample of horns on his head - Archetype: Savage Cultist*), Splinter Creatures (small, made of crackling branches). Location: Exterior of the vineyards and Winery/Basement of the house. Loot obtained: None.    Summary: The group plans an infiltration. Erdan sends his familiar raven to scout, but it only finds hundreds of normal ravens on the rooftop. Pulgar decides to approach stealthily, followed by Renoir, who becomes invisible. Pulgar manages to enter the basement, discovering the druid and several creatures. However, Renoir critically fails his roll outside, causing a pair of pliers to fall to the ground and make noise. Upon being discovered, Renoir levitates to the rooftop, scaring away the ravens with a tambourine, leaving Pulgar surrounded. The druid casts Thunderwave* which injures Pulgar. Meanwhile, outside, the rest of the group watches in horror as hundreds of wooden creatures begin to emerge from the fog in the vineyards towards their carts, forcing them to prepare fire spells and prepare a desperate charge with the cart. The session ends just as this large-scale combat begins.

title: 12 - Combate
content: Here is the translation of the text into English: Here is the summary of the Curse of Strahd session based strictly on the provided transcript, written in Spanish (Spain) style and in Markdown format. Session Title: The Winery Assault and the Twig Horde PCs present:  Pulgar (Juan Casanova), Ceres (Paloma), Broseph (Juan Maldonado), Feyre (Rocío), Hulio (Emilio), Erdan (Marcos), Dietrich (Álex), Renoir (Nacho). NPCs present:  Twig Blights (plague-like creatures). Horses (from the group's wagon). Druid 1 (The one on the upper floor with the staff). Druid 2 (The one on the stairs who transforms). Swarm of Ravens. Mysterious men in the woods (seen by Dietrich). Urwin Martinov (mentioned in the initiative order). (Note: Strahd, Madame Eva, the Durst Family, or Stalimir do not appear nor are they mentioned in this session). Key developments: The group deliberately crashes their wagon into the entrance/garage of a huge winery in Barovia to avoid being surrounded outside. They are besieged by an incessant horde of "twig blights" (dozens and dozens of them) entering through every crack and door. A Druid casts an ice/hail storm from the upper floor that ends up destroying and killing the group's horses. The ravens inside the winery seem to be on the players' side, pecking and killing some of the twigs.    Renoir and Erdan manage to decimate a large part of the horde using repeated Thunderwave* spells. A second druid, after taking an axe blow from Hulio thanks to his barkskin, transforms into a giant blue spider and leaves Hulio unconscious (at 0 hit points) with a massive poisonous bite. Dietrich arrives at the winery area running from the woods to assist the group. Loose ends: The Vampire's Staff: The first druid shouted in broken Druidic that he possessed the "vampire's staff." What power exactly does this object have and why does he have it? The men in the woods: Dietrich saw a group of men armed with short swords running behind him in the woods, but they suddenly disappeared or lost interest. Were they illusions, ghosts of Ravenloft, or real enemies waiting? Hulio's survival: The session ends in the middle of combat with Hulio on the ground dying from the giant spider's poison, waiting for Ceres to heal him. Session Joke: Although the DM (Morgan) tried to force "quick session jokes" at the beginning (like the one about the blind man on the braille track), the best joke that emerged naturally due to the players' creativity and reactions was "The Tank Bard." Nacho (Renoir, the bard) dove down a chimney, threw himself into the middle of the horde of monsters, taking hits on purpose so that his Bardic Inspiration ("Vengeance") would deal psychic damage to the enemies, and finished by blowing up entire groups with Thunderwave. The players ended up joking that the bard was the true "frontline" of the group. Scene 1 Scene Title: Forced Landing in Barovia PCs present: Erdan, Pulgar, Hulio, Renoir, Feyre, Broseph, Ceres. NPCs present:  Horses (Nervous, rearing, kicking. Archetype: Scared beasts).    Twig Blights (Small, look like dry branches with claws, walk on twig legs. Archetype: Mooks/Swarm or Minions*). Location(s): Winery entrance/garage, inner ramp. Loot obtained: None. Scene summary:  The group is going at full speed in their wagon fleeing from the twigs. Instead of stopping, Ceres drives the horses to force entry into the winery, breaking the posts and wedging the wagon into the garage by force. Feyre immediately transforms into a Brown Bear as a free action and scares the horses even more, so she has to step aside. Erdan tries to spread oil to create a wall of fire, but upon realizing it will take him a long time, he chooses to cast a Firebolt. Pulgar gets off the wagon and blocks one of the broken doors to try to slow down the horde pursuing them from the fog. Renoir, seeing a chimney, decides to dive down it, crawling downward to enter the building. Scene 2 Scene Title: The Vampire's Staff and the Death of the Horses PCs present: Feyre, Erdan, Ceres, Hulio, Pulgar, Broseph. NPCs present:  Druid 1 (Wild/hick-looking man, face dirty with mud, wears bear fur and pendants, speaks broken Druidic. Archetype: Megalomaniacal cult leader). Twig Blights. Horses (Dead). Location(s): Inside the winery (vat and wagon area), upper balcony where the crane is. Loot obtained: None. Scene summary:  From the upper floor, next to a crane used to move barrels, a man sticks his head out. Feyre manages to understand his bad Druidic: the man proclaims that nature obeys his wishes and that the group has no chance because he possesses the "vampire's staff." Immediately after, he casts a spell (Ice Storm) on the wagon. The bear (Feyre) and the horses take massive cold and bludgeoning damage. The damage completely destroys the horses, killing them on the spot. The twigs start to enter from everywhere, climbing over the equine corpses, and Feyre loses her bear form after taking a beating from the twigs. Broseph fires magic missiles from the rear to clear the area. Scene 3 Scene Title: The Blue Spider and the Atomic Bard PCs present: Renoir, Hulio, Pulgar, Dietrich, Erdan, Broseph, Feyre, Ceres. NPCs present:  Druid 2 (Skin hard like bark, wields a staff with poisonous thorns, transforms into a blue Giant Spider. Archetype: Beastly shapeshifter / Sub-boss). Swarm of Ravens (Frantic, fluttering in the ceiling beams. Archetype: Unexpected beast allies). Mysterious men in the woods (Seen in the distance. Archetype: Phantom threat). Location(s): Inner stairs of the winery, hallways, fermentation room (double ceiling), winery exterior in the fog. Loot obtained: None. Scene summary:  The combat becomes chaotic. Outside, Dietrich runs toward the house throwing javelins while noticing that some men are following him through the woods, although he later loses their trail. Inside, the horde of twigs breaks the defenses. Erdan and Renoir use their Thunderwave spells (a 15-foot cube), shattering wine barrels and blowing up dozens of twig blights, filling the floor with a viscous mixture of red wine and green sap.  On the other hand, Hulio and Pulgar face a second druid in the stairs area. Hulio lands a brutal axe blow that the druid resists thanks to his Barkskin spell. Pulgar decides to climb and hide on the ceiling like Spiderman. The wounded druid suddenly transforms into a huge blue spider and bites Hulio. Hulio fails his Constitution saving throw, taking 23 points of poison damage that leave him unconscious on the floor. Ceres falls back to block a door with her shield and try to assist the group on the next turn. The session ends in maximum tension.

title: 12 - PoD - Honour Among Thieves 09
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Castilian Spanish. Session Title: Funeral Diplomacy and Vermin Cleanup PCs present: Nemo: Captain. Fomega (Álvarito): Engineer/Scientist/Gunner. Jimmy: Marine/Mercenary. Paloma: Pilot/Broker. NPCs present: Chris: Crewmember/Marine (Accompanies on boarding). Honor: Crewmember (Mentioned opening doors). Ferrik: The pirate prisoner. Provost Falx: Leader of Torpol. Guardian Malos: Psychopomp of Clarke. High Psychopomp Boone: Supreme leader of Clarke. The "Bug": Hostile alien creature. Campaign Development and Reconstruction of the Kingdom of Drinax: The relationship with Torpol (now neutral/friendly) and Clarke (now friendly) has been strengthened following the delivery of the criminal Ferrik. A diplomatic path has been opened to annex Clarke to the Kingdom, but with a difficult religious condition: Prince Harrik must accept and promote the faith of "The Cure" (technological resurrection). The crew has obtained a substantial reward (approx. 2.5 million credits) which stabilizes the ship's finances and allows for tribute to be paid to King Oleb. Materials (20 tons of raw materials) have been acquired to repair and beautify the ship, improving its status. Loose Ends: The beacon of the "Proactive Recycling Company": What is this corporation and why do they recycle old ships? The alien corpse: Fomega has kept it for study (possibly the "Cockroach" mentioned at the end). Clarke's condition: Will Prince Harrik agree to convert to a funeral religion to gain an ally? The contact in Exocet (pirate who gave the ingot) remains pending. Station mysteries: The recordings about "the ghost" and the voice on the radio were not thoroughly investigated. Scene 1: The Trap and the Boarding PCs present: Nemo, Fomega, Jimmy, Paloma (from the ship). NPCs present: Chris and Honor (Support crew), The Bug (Xenobiological monster, spits acid, stealthy). Location: Ancient Space Station (Unknown system, orbit of a gas giant). Ships: Banshee (Harrier Class, Captain Nemo). Summary: The crew discusses how to deal with a dangerous alien creature inhabiting an ancient space station where they plan to refuel. Fomega designs an elaborate trap using a box, a vacuum suit with active communications, and meat as bait, hoping to electrocute or capture the beast. After a day of waiting with no results, Nemo orders a direct boarding. Nemo, Jimmy, Fomega, and the NPCs enter the station in zero gravity. They find a grim environment with remnants of resin and shell casings. Jimmy uses a device ("bug") to monitor their rear. Upon reaching a control room, the creature ambushes Jimmy from the darkness. Jimmy fires his shotgun but misses; Nemo reacts quickly and kills the beast with a precise laser rifle shot to the head. After the combat, they loot the station, recovering a huge and valuable painting of an ancient Sindal Emperor and a memory card. Fomega takes the alien corpse for study. Paloma hacks a nearby beacon, discovering it belongs to the "Proactive Recycling Company". Scene 2: Business on Borite PCs present: Paloma, Nemo, Fomega, Jimmy. NPCs present: Local merchant (Seller of scrap and supplies). Location: Borite City and Spaceport (Planet Borite). Summary: The Banshee lands on Borite. Taking advantage of the stay, Paloma contacts a local merchant. They sell the scrap obtained from the station. Paloma strikes a great deal (thanks to an excellent Broker roll and the planet's characteristics) to buy 20 tons of "Common Raw Materials" at half price. The goal is to use these materials to repair and aesthetically improve the ship's hull in the future. The purchase of luxury liquors is discarded due to a temporary lack of funds and the difficulty of trading Borite's agricultural goods off-world. Scene 3: The Delivery on Torpol PCs present: All. NPCs present: Provost Falx (Leader of Torpol, grateful and formal). Location: Torpol (Aquatic Planet). Summary: The crew arrives at Torpol to deliver the prisoner Ferrik, captured in previous sessions. They meet with Provost Falx. To protect the location of the secret fuel depot they discovered, they lie about where they captured Ferrik, claiming it was on a moon of Borite or on Asis. Falx accepts the story and informs them that there will be a joint trial with Clarke's authorities. The group's reputation on Torpol improves considerably. Scene 4: The Tomb World PCs present: All. NPCs present: Guardian Malos (Psychopomp, carries freezing equipment), High Psychopomp Boone (Religious leader, fanatic of "The Cure"). Location: Clarke (Cemetery/Industrial Planet, grim and radioactive atmosphere). Summary: They travel to the Clarke system, a desolate world covered in tombs and black pyramids. The local culture revolves around freezing the dying (in carbonite/black crystal) in anticipation of future resurrection technology. They deliver Ferrik, who is sentenced to be frozen alive and placed in orbit as an eternal warning. High Psychopomp Boone requests an audience. He offers a formal alliance with Drinax, but with one condition: he has heard that Prince Harrik possesses "The Cure" (or the path to it) and demands that the Prince declare his faith in their religion and make it the official religion of Drinax. Paloma takes the opportunity to buy 60 tons of wood (although they can only load 40) and refuel. The relationship with Clarke becomes friendly. Scene 5: Return to the Floating Palace PCs present: All. NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (Mentioned), Drinax Falcon Guard (Patrol ship). Location: Drinax (Floating Palace). Summary: The Banshee returns to Drinax with full pockets (rewards from Clarke and Torpol plus the bounty on Ferrik's head). Debts to King Oleb are settled, and downtime is planned. The characters decide to use the free time and travels to train skills and improve the ship. It is mentioned that they must decide what to do with the loot and whether to give a portion to the NPC crewmember Miria.

title: 12.5 - Combate 2
content: Session Summary: The Battle of the Winery and the Barovian Tomatina PCs present:  Pulgar (played by Juan Casanova) Ceres (played by Paloma) Broseph (played by Juan Maldonado) Feyre (Rocío's character, temporarily controlled by Juan Maldonado) Hulio (played by Emilio) Erdan (played by Marcos) Dietrich (played by Alex) Renoir (played by Nacho) NPCs present:  Urwin Martikov and his family (in human form and as swarms of ravens) Barovian Druids Giant Spider Twig Blights and Vine Blights Main events and loose ends: The group was defending a winery (presumably the Wizard of Wines, given the support of the Martikovs) from a massive siege by plant creatures and druids. After a chaotic combat in which several members of the group fell unconscious or were poisoned, they managed to repel the horde and eliminate the giant spider and several druids, including one that Dietrich decapitated and another that carried a vampiric staff. Loose end 1: The druid on the first floor (or upper floor) who was casting ice storm spells disappeared without a trace at the end of the combat. Loose end 2: Outside the winery, the scorched corpse of an ally (a man, presumably one of the Martikovs) was found, as if he had burned from the inside due to a very powerful magic that they have not yet identified. Loose end 3: Ceres looted the "vampire staff" from a druid's corpse, but they still do not know exactly how it works or what magical properties it has, other than the fact that the druid healed himself when dealing damage with it. The Joke of the Session: The main joke arose when Erdan (Marcos) decided to cast the spell Thunderwave to clear out the plant monsters. The DM (Nemo) described how the explosion not only shattered the enemies but also burst the wine barrels in front of them. A wave of wine swept through the room, mixing with the sap from the plants and the blood from the combat. Alex joked that it looked like "Black Friday," but the players quickly dubbed it "La Tomatina", lamenting (especially Nacho) that they had gone there specifically to save the wine and had destroyed it in the process. Scene 1: Holding the door and the chaos of the Blights PCs present: Ceres, Pulgar, Erdan, Renoir, Broseph, Feyre, Hulio. NPCs present: Giant spider (Relentless beast), Paralyzing druid (Savage cultist, gibbering in Druidic), Twig Blights (Mindless infantry or "minions"). Location: Inside the winery (spiral staircase area and main barrel room). Loot obtained: None. Scene summary: The session picks up at the end of Ceres' turn, who uses her strength to hold a door with her back to prevent more monsters from entering, while using her Channel Divinity (Preserve Life) to heal Pulgar and Renoir from a distance. Hulio and Feyre are poisoned on the ground due to the giant spider. Erdan uses Tasha’s Mind Whip to stun the spider, which allows Pulgar (hidden in the ceiling rafters) to launch a sneak attack. Meanwhile, a druid paralyzes Renoir, and a tide of twig blights passes over him, leaving him unconscious and bleeding out on the soot-covered floor. Scene 2: The Tomatina and Dietrich’s arrival PCs present: Erdan, Dietrich, Pulgar, Broseph, Renoir. NPCs present: Twig Blights (Mindless infantry), Swarms of ravens (Beastly allies). Location: Winery barrel room. Loot obtained: None. Scene summary: Dietrich (Alex) finally manages to join the battle by coming down the stairs. He encounters a bleak scene: Renoir is on the ground being trampled by a mob of blights. Erdan casts his famous Thunderwave, bursting the wine barrels and creating "La Tomatina," which clears part of the room but also scares off the allied ravens. Dietrich pushes through the branches, absorbing immense damage thanks to his heavy armor, and manages to approach Renoir's inert body to use his Lay on Hands, saving his life just before he failed his death saving throws. Scene 3: The Vampire Staff and the Bear on the Stairs PCs present: All. NPCs present: Staff-wielding druid (Cultist leader, strikes, heals with blood), Horned druid (Fanatical cultist, decapitated), Urwin Martikov and allies (Tactical support, use shortswords). Location: Spiral staircase and main room. Loot obtained: A wooden staff (potential "Vampire Staff"). Scene summary: The combat reaches its climax. A druid attacks Pulgar with a staff that glows red and sucks the dwarf's blood to heal the attacker's wounds. Ceres, without abandoning her position at the door, strikes the druid in the jaw with a critical hit from her hammer, and Pulgar finishes him off with a dagger to the kidney. Ceres keeps the fallen staff. For his part, Dietrich uses a Divine Smite to shatter the head of a horned druid with a hammer blow. Feyre tries to join the combat by transforming into a brown bear, but due to the narrowness of the spiral staircase and because Ceres, Pulgar, and Hulio are blocking the way, the bear gets stuck and has to take a long detour through the lower floor. Scene 4: Aftermath amidst Sap and Blood PCs present: All. NPCs present: Urwin Martikov (Allied leader). Location: Inside and outside the winery. Loot obtained: None in this scene. Scene summary: Renoir, now up, casts another Thunderwave (this time at level 2) to clear the last of the plant creatures surrounding him, while Hulio recovers his axe and Broseph spends his last magical resources. Urwin Martikov and his men finish securing the area. The DM (Nemo) declares the end of combat as there are no creatures left in the room. However, upon checking the casualties, they discover that the druid who was casting magic from the upper balcony has fled and, worse, they find the corpse of one of the Martikov men outside, completely scorched from within. With the floor flooded with wine, blood, and sap, the group decides to take a breather to investigate what just happened before heading up to the second floor.

content: Aquí tienes el resumen de la sesión siguiendo estrictamente tus indicaciones, redactado en español de España y en formato Markdown, extrayendo únicamente la información presente en la transcripción. Sesión: El Vino, el Diario y el Destino en las Cartas Personajes Jugadores (PCs) presentes: Pulgar "bigtoe", Ceres, Erdan, Dietrich (y el personaje de Nacho, Renoir). Nota: Las cartas del destino también se tiran para los personajes de Broseph, Feyre y Hulio, aunque sus jugadores estén ausentes. NPCs presentes: Davian Martikov, Adrián Martikov, Urwin Martikov, Elvir, Estefanía, Sacerdote de Lathander (Víctor), Madame Eva. (Mencionados a través del diario o conversación: Strahd / "Stalimir", Familia Durst, Tatiana, Sergéi, Irina). Desarrollos principales y cabos sueltos: Desarrollos principales: El grupo ha salvado la bodega de los Martikov y entregado el último cargamento de vino a la Posada Agua Azul, ganándose el favor de la familia y de los cuervos de Barovia. Han obtenido y leído el diario de Strahd, descubriendo su trágico pasado, su pacto de sangre y su obsesión por Tatiana. Finalmente, han visitado a Madame Eva, quien les ha tirado las cartas del Taroca, revelando la ubicación de objetos clave (un símbolo sagrado y una espada solar), un aliado (un hombre con un mono) y misiones personales para cada miembro del grupo. Cabos sueltos:  Falta recuperar las tres gemas mágicas que hacen crecer las vides de la bodega (una la tienen las brujas, otra los druidas y otra está perdida desde hace 10 años). El grupo debe decidir qué hacer con Irina antes de la boda inminente. Se desconoce si Dietrich podrá curar su estado de "semi-muerto viviente" y recuperar su conexión celestial. Hay que investigar qué ocurre con las pasteleras del molino que venden pasteles con drogas. Deben descifrar exactamente dónde están los lugares mencionados por Madame Eva (las puertas de ámbar, la casa del santo, etc.). Broma de la sesión (Session Joke):  La broma más destacada surge cuando Dietrich (Alex) explica por qué ha estado desaparecido y su terrible aspecto físico. Cuenta que fue al castillo de Strahd (a quien llama accidentalmente "Stalimir") y que el vampiro le hizo "una serie de experimentos" que le hicieron perder su sangre celestial. Inmediatamente, Pulgar pregunta con sorna si fueron "experimentos anales", y el grupo bromea concluyendo que Strahd no ha ido a secuestrar a Irina porque ha estado demasiado ocupado pasándose una semana entera haciéndole "experimentos" a Dietrich todas las noches. Escena 1: Las secuelas en la bodega y el botín PCs presentes: Pulgar, Ceres, Erdan, Dietrich. NPCs presentes:  Davian Martikov (anciano, viste elegante con chistera y bastón; aparenta fragilidad pero es autoritario con su familia. Arquetipo: El patriarca sabio). Adrián Martikov (hijo mayor de Davian, impulsivo, valiente, harto de esconderse. Arquetipo: El heredero rebelde). Lugar(es): Bodega "El Mago de los Vinos". Botín obtenido:  Bastón mágico de druida (un cuarto de madera negra y esponjosa que emana un aura/humo oscuro y absorbe sangre). 50 monedas de oro, 270 monedas de electro y 350 monedas de plata (encontradas en un doble fondo de una cama). 1 botella de vino superviviente (rescatada y guardada en secreto por Pulgar). Medallón con el emblema de la familia Martikov. Resumen de la escena: Tras una dura batalla para recuperar la bodega, el grupo se percata de que Dietrich ha regresado tras haber huido en la "casa del horror". El paladín tiene un aspecto demacrado, ojeras enormes, está muy pálido y ya no respira, secuela de los experimentos de Strahd. Davian Martikov agradece al grupo su ayuda, pero les advierte que no habrá más cosechas a menos que recuperen las tres gemas mágicas robadas. Ceres mantiene una conversación diplomática con Davian, prometiendo intentar derrotar a Strahd para ayudarles; conmovido, el anciano le entrega su medallón personal, asegurándole que los cuervos les ayudarán a partir de ahora. Mientras Ceres cocina, Pulgar y Erdan exploran la casa. Pulgar localiza un doble fondo en la cama principal y roba un cofre con monedas, además de inspeccionar un libro de contabilidad con marcas extrañas de pedidos enviados a Strahd.  Escena 2: La entrega del vino y el Tomo de Strahd PCs presentes: Pulgar, Ceres, Erdan, Dietrich, Renoir (personaje de Nacho). NPCs presentes:  Urwin Martikov (tabernero, cauteloso y agradecido. Arquetipo: El informante aliado). Sacerdote Víctor (cura de la iglesia de Lathander, compasivo. Arquetipo: El guía espiritual). Lugar(es): El camino hacia Vallaki, Posada Agua Azul (Vallaki), Iglesia de Lathander. Botín obtenido: El Diario de Strahd (entregado temporalmente por Urwin en una caja de plomo). Resumen de la escena: El grupo carga el carromato con los barriles de vino sobrevivientes. Dietrich invoca a su montura celestial, que ahora aparece como un caballo gris demacrado con los ojos inyectados en sangre. Viajan hacia la ciudad y entregan el vino en la posada, siendo recibidos con jolgorio y gratitud por los lugareños. En privado, en el ruidoso establo lleno de cuervos, le muestran el medallón a Urwin. Éste, impresionado, les entrega una pequeña caja de plomo que contiene un antiguo diario. Renoir/Nacho asume el honor de leerlo en voz alta. El diario revela el pasado de Strahd: cómo siendo un guerrero envejecido se enamoró de la joven Tatiana, quien le rechazó por su hermano Sergéi. Llevado por la ira y los celos, Strahd hizo un pacto de sangre, asesinó a su hermano el día de la boda y provocó el suicidio de Tatiana, convirtiéndose en el primer vampiro. El texto también menciona el miedo de Strahd al sol y a la espada de Sergéi. Por la noche, Dietrich acude a la iglesia de Lathander en busca de respuestas sobre su estado. El sacerdote Víctor confirma su condición entre la vida y la muerte, y le ofrece iniciar un rito para que encuentre la redención divina. Escena 3: El campamento Vistani y las cartas del destino PCs presentes: Pulgar, Ceres, Erdan, Dietrich, Renoir. NPCs presentes:  Madame Eva (anciana pitonisa, voz crujiente como hierba seca, no tiene el aspecto típico de una gitana, está encorvada mirando una bola de cristal en una tienda iluminada de rojo. Arquetipo: El oráculo místico). Lugar(es): Campamento Vistani (junto a un lago), Tienda de Madame Eva. Botín obtenido: 1 barril de cerveza (comprado a los Vistani). Resumen de la escena: A la mañana siguiente, el grupo se dirige al campamento Vistani. Para evitar problemas, se acercan con intenciones festivas y regalan un barril de vino a los gitanos, ganándose su simpatía al instante. Son dirigidos a la gran tienda de madera de Madame Eva. La anciana les reprocha haber tardado tanto y comienza una lectura con las cartas del Taroca. Les revela cinco claves para vencer al vampiro:  1. Buscar un nido de cuervos.  2. Un símbolo sagrado escondido tras el sol en la casa de un santo.  3. Una espada de luz solar bajo una montaña de tesoros, más allá de unas puertas de ámbar.  4. Un aliado inesperado: un hombre dicharachero que va con un mono.  5. Strahd les espera en lo más alto del corazón del castillo.  Tras la tirada general, Madame Eva saca una carta personalizada para cada miembro del grupo (incluso los ausentes), dándoles crípticas misiones de redención (limpiar el templo de los antiguos dioses, devolverle el nombre a alguien olvidado, liberar el alma de un golem, hacer brillar el faro de plata, etc.). Con estas revelaciones vitales y algo de cerveza comprada a los gitanos, el grupo se prepara para sus próximos movimientos.

title: 13 - PoD - Interludio 01
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Protocol, Purchases and a Royal Hunt PCs present James "Nemo" Hondo Honor Boom (Paloma) Jimmy Mendoza Taya Kler (Rocío) Fomega Krrsh NPCs present King Oleb XVI Lady Hil Thao Polloct Kleon Hardy Lía Hondo Scholar Voha Rachando (mentioned/his robots) Brie Lord Fataqiu Sarah Major developments in the lives of the PCs or the campaign The crew has made tribute payment to King Oleb (approximately 281,000 credits).    Significant repairs have been made to the Banshee*, including the hull and technical systems to reduce monthly maintenance. James Hondo has established positive diplomatic contact with an Aslan noble, Lord Fataqiu, through art and warrior culture. The group has participated in a televised propaganda event to strengthen King Oleb's image. Loose ends The failure of James Hondo's gravitic belt during the hunt: Was it an accident due to lack of maintenance or sabotage (possibly by his sister Lía)? James Hondo's request for a meeting with the merchant Rachando remained unconfirmed. The investigation into the political leanings of the court (who supports the Prince and who supports the Princess) is ongoing. Presentation at Court and Family Reunions PCs present All PCs. NPCs present King Oleb XVI (The Warrior King: Eccentric, loud, and authoritarian). Lady Hil (Nobility: Regular courtier). Thao Polloct (Imperial Consul: Diplomatic, uncomfortable with strange social situations). Kleon Hardy (Representative of Asim). Scholar Voha (Academic). Lía Hondo (The Rival Sister: Arrogant, hostile towards James, accompanied by her lovers). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Floating Palace, Throne Room (Drinax/Drinax). Spaceships mentioned Banshee (Sindalian, Captain James Hondo). Aslan Escort (Unknown class, 800 tons, Clan Itealeio). Aslan Light Freighter (300 tons). Scene summary After arriving in the system and transferring the required funds to the King's secret accounts, the crew attends the Floating Palace by royal order. Krrsh paints his fur in bright colors and uncomfortably harasses the Imperial Consul Thao Polloct. James Hondo reunites with his sister, Lía Hondo, with whom he has a tense conversation full of reproaches about the family inheritance; Jimmy attempts to woo her unsuccessfully. James tries to gauge the political loyalties of the court to find allies for Princess Rao, identifying possible patterns (Rachando, Lady Hil, Lord Drax, etc.). The presentation before King Oleb is brief and formal. Logistics and Market at the Bazaar PCs present Honor Boom, James Hondo, Jimmy Mendoza, Taya Kler, Fomega. NPCs present Rachando's Robots (Automated merchants). Sarah (Aslan merchant: Pragmatic, wife of Lord Fataqiu). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Rachando's Bazaar, Floating Palace (Drinax/Drinax). Spaceships mentioned None. Scene summary The group goes to the merchant Rachando's bazaar to acquire spare parts. Honor and the others manage the purchase of Advanced Electronics and Machine Parts to repair the ship's hull and systems, managing to reduce monthly maintenance costs and repair critical previous damage. They attempt to contact Rachando directly, but only manage to leave a message through his robots offering services and alliances. They observe an Aslan female (Sarah) buying livestock and other supplies, with whom Honor exchanges brief words about trade. They also discuss the sale of stolen laser weaponry. The Televised Hunt of the Drinaxian Mole PCs present All PCs (except Krrsh who is indisposed). NPCs present King Oleb XVI (Hunt leader: Enthusiastic, seeks glory for the cameras). Brie (Commander of the Hawk Guard). Drinax Television Crew (Cameras and producers). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Surface/Subsurface (Drinax/Drinax). Spaceships mentioned Gravitic support ship (Medical/equipment transport). Scene summary King Oleb wakes the crew for a "hunt" that turns out to be a televised propaganda event. Equipped with vacuum suits and melee weapons (gravitic hammers, saw swords, spears), they descend to the surface of Drinax during a storm to hunt a "Drinaxian Mole" (a giant insectoid beast). During aerial combat with gravitic belts, James Hondo's belt fails (possible sabotage), and Jimmy Mendoza has to rescue him in the air to prevent a crash. King Oleb, ignoring the incident, spectacularly kills the beast for the cameras. After the hunt, the PCs search the ship for intruders, finding no conclusive evidence. Diplomatic Encounter with Lord Fataqiu PCs present James Hondo, Honor Boom, Jimmy Mendoza, Taya Kler, Fomega. NPCs present Lord Fataqiu (Aslan noble of Clan Itealeio/Atoleyao: Cultured, warrior poet, melancholic). Sarah (Aslan merchant: Principal wife). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Guest quarters/Simulated Jaima, Floating Palace (Drinax/Drinax). Tiokh (Mentioned as Clan territory). Spaceships mentioned None. Scene summary Impressed by Hondo's "pack's" performance on television, Lord Fataqiu invites the PCs to his Jaima. It turns out to be a cultural exchange where Fataqiu and James Hondo share their appreciation for art (Hondo shows his holograms) and discuss the philosophy of war (Limited War vs. Open War). Fataqiu laments the destruction of Drinax, considering it a waste of territory. While the males discuss war and art, Honor is sent to talk business with the Aslan females, establishing potential future trade routes and obtaining information about goods in demand in the Aslan Hierate. An important friendly contact is established.

title: 14 - PoD - Interludio 02
content: Session Title: New Blood and Old Grudges PCs Present: Captain James Ondo (Jimmy): Crew leader, noble of Drinax. Nemo: Doctor and noble, obsessed with fashion and social status. Honor Boon: Former officer, computer scientist, and fitness expert. Tribal face tattoos. Pika: Intelligence officer/spy, cold and calculating. Fermín: New recruit. A Latin American "thug," very tall (over 2 meters), strong, long hair and beard. Likes to party. Kaimana (Rocío): Gunner/Mechanic. Middle-aged woman, thin and affable. Chris: Crew member (mentioned as drunk/sick during the session). NPCs Present: King Oleb XVI: King of Drinax. Lady Hil: Influential court noble, suspected conspirator. Lía Ondo: Captain James's sister. Rachando: Merchant from Drinax. Saldan Zett: Merchant captain (mentioned). Abra Harper: Miner/Mechanic rescued from cryo-stasis. Wulf Blue-Axe: Cannibal pirate rescued from cryo-stasis. Campaign and Character Development: Reunification and Recruitment: The crew reunites in Drinax after a three-month journey. Fermín, an old contact of Nemo and James, brought by the merchant Saldan Zett, joins them. The King's Wrath: King Oleb reprimands the crew for the lack of tangible loot. He demands more aggressive actions and real piracy ("fury and strength") to acquire materials and resources to rebuild Drinax, not just diplomacy.    Recognition: Captain James Ondo receives the Star of Sindal* medal.    Upgrades: The crew invests in improving the aesthetics and comfort of the ship Banshee* and awakens two new crew members from cryo-stasis pods. Westward Bound: The ship departs for the Pourne system with the objective of hunting prey and making noise on the trade routes. Loose Ends: Nemo's Assignment: Nemo plans the assassination of his "nephew" and seeks the discreet help of Fermín and James. The NAS Device: A purchased life detector that seems to cause interference with the ship's gravity. Chris: His constant state of drunkenness and vomiting prevented him from participating in the events. Court Politics: Lady Hil's true intentions remain ambiguous after her brief exchange with James. Scene 1: The Reunion at the Port PCs Present: James Ondo, Nemo, Honor Boon, Pika, Fermín, Kaimana. NPCs Present: Saldan Zett (Mentioned, merchant captain). Location: Spaceport (Drinax). Ships: The Banshee (Harrier, Captain James Ondo), Saldan Zett's Ship (Free Trader). Summary: The merchant Saldan Zett lands on Drinax bringing a "package" for Nemo: Fermín, an old acquaintance and burly thug who has spent everything to join the crew in search of fortune. Captain James Ondo and the rest of the Banshee's crew welcome Fermín at the port. They catch up, describe their roles, and Fermín makes his "man of action" and party-goer profile clear. James offers him an official position and shows him the ship, mentioning the frozen prisoners they intend to recruit. As they prepare, they receive a notification from the Hawk Guard for an immediate and discreet audience with the King. Scene 2: Royal Audience and Reproaches PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: King Oleb XVI (Fat, drinker, frustrated, Archetype: Decadent but Cunning King), Hawk Guards. Location: Private chamber in the Floating Palace (Drinax). Summary: The crew is escorted through maintenance tunnels to a private chamber where King Oleb awaits. The King is disappointed with the Harrier's performance: 12 jumps and only two minor prey (Free Traders). Oleb criticizes their focus on diplomacy (like with Clarke) instead of the aggressive piracy needed to obtain tangible resources for reconstruction. He demands they bring riches, industrial materials, or machinery, not just words. James tries to defend his diplomatic achievements, but the King insists they need to be a real threat to trade. Pika requests access to the Scholars' Tower to search for ancient maps, which the King grants. Scene 3: Errands in Drinax and Purchases PCs Present: Nemo, Fermín, Pika, James Ondo. NPCs Present: Rachando (Merchant, humble and normal appearance, Archetype: The Informer/Fixer), Kletus (Mentioned, android). Location: Bazaar and Scholars' Tower (Drinax). Summary: During their day off before the ceremony, the characters run errands. Nemo takes Fermín to meet Rachando, a local merchant who procures "difficult" imports. Nemo establishes a business relationship, offering the Harrier's services for future needs, both legal and illegal. Meanwhile, Pika researches in the Scholars' Tower, and James buys a rare NAS device (life detector). Other members purchase medical supplies and ammunition. Scene 4: The Star Ceremony PCs Present: All (except Chris). NPCs Present: Lady Hil (Influential noble, Archetype: The Political Manipulator), Lía Ondo (James's sister), Alvarito (Mentioned as famous on TV). Location: Royal Court (Drinax). Summary: A formal ceremony is held where Lady Hil gives a patriotic speech about Sindal's values. Captain James Ondo is called to the stage to receive the Star of Sindal for rescuing a compatriot (Nemo). Lía Ondo, James's sister, is the one who bestows the medal; James winks at her, and she responds with a slight smile. Nemo attempts to gain prominence unsuccessfully. After the ceremony, James has a brief diplomatic "confrontation" with Lady Hil, implying that they both seek glory for Drinax and suggesting future alliances. Scene 5: Upgrades and Thaw PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: Abra Harper (Miner/Mechanic around 50 years old), Wulf Blue-Axe (Ex-convict, cannibal, sharp teeth). Location: Ship Banshee (Space). Summary: Now on the ship and departing Drinax, the crew uses resources (Chip Shares) to redecorate and upgrade the cabins and hull of the ship, making it more luxurious and comfortable. Later, they proceed to thaw the two prisoners from the cryo-stasis pods: Abra Harper and Wulf Blue-Axe. Both survive the process without serious repercussions. Wulf is enthusiastically welcomed by Fermín and Nemo (who value having a "tough" cannibal on the team). Both agree to join the crew. Scene 6: Jump to Pourne PCs Present: All. NPCs Present: None direct (Spaceport control mentioned). Location: Pourne System. Summary: The crew establishes training routines to improve their skills during voyages. They jump to the Pourne system. Upon arrival, they detect considerable traffic of heavy freighters and smaller ships. The planet has a high Technological Level (TL 10) and a strong network of defense satellites and an active fleet, presenting a more dangerous and bureaucratic scenario than usual.

title: 15 - PoD - Interludio 03
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript: Session Title: Snub in Hilfer and the Imperial Gold Route PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Alvarito, Rocío (PC). NPCs present: Krrsh (Aslan Bodyguard), Thao Polloc (referred to as "Harp," expert mechanic), Jimmy (Crewman/Gunner), Wolf (Crewman). Main Developments: A new command dynamic is established where Captain Nemo makes executive decisions after hearing opinions, avoiding slow votes. Merchandise is sold in the Paal system, yielding significant profit (127,800 credits). A rumor is discovered about an imperial convoy ("Treasure Ship") which could be a high-level long-term target. An immediate piracy and diplomacy route is charted: Paal -> Sink (hunt) -> Byrni (sale/diplomacy). Loose Ends: The convoy of the Martin II (the treasure ship): Its existence and possible route are known (from Tobias/Fist towards Hierato Aslan), but intercepting it requires complex planning and possibly allies. Hostility in Hilfer: The planet hates Drinax and is marked as a potential future hunting ground, as diplomacy is impossible. Fermín's physical recovery after the accident with the supply box. Scene 1: Jump and Convalescence PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Alvarito. NPCs present: Wolf and Harp (Crewmen, criticize Fermín's accident calling him "Fermín the Cookie"). Location: Space (During the jump from Purne to Hilfer) and the ship Harrier. Ships mentioned: Harrier (PCs' Ship). Scene Summary: During the week-long jump to Hilfer, the crew dedicates themselves to study and maintenance. Fermín, still injured from the cargo accident (lost Endurance points), tries to recover and spends his time reviewing recordings of Jane Cobb's medal ceremony, looking for suspicious behavior or conspiracies, though he finds nothing relevant. An inventory is taken of previously stolen cargo: common consumables (low-quality food), mechanical parts, and basic electronics. Harp performs ship maintenance and "cleans" the stolen boxes to hide their origin. Scene 2: Hostility in the Desert PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Alvarito. NPCs present: Krrsh (accompanies the landing party). Location: Hilfer (Hilfer System), Surface Spaceport (Downport). Scene Summary: The crew lands on Hilfer, a desert world with Technology Level 6 and Law A (very strict, weapons prohibited). Upon disembarking and interacting with locals at the dusty port, they discover a deep hostility towards outsiders, and specifically hatred towards Drinax (whom they blame for past bombings or lack of protection). The atmosphere is so tense and xenophobic that the group decides to abort any attempt at trade or diplomacy. They pay docking and fuel fees (around 3,000 credits total plus fuel) and take off immediately to avoid legal or physical conflicts. Hilfer is marked as a hostile territory suitable for future piracy. Scene 3: Business and Rumors in Paal PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Alvarito, Rocío. NPCs present: Emanuel Pelli (Generated name for a failed contact), local merchants, pilots. Location: Paal (Paal System), Spaceport and leisure areas. Scene Summary: After jumping from Hilfer, the ship arrives at Paal, a rich, agricultural, and bustling world ("Capitalism at its finest"). They split into groups: Paloma: Is in charge of selling the stolen merchandise. Despite her social anxiety, she achieves great commercial success, selling electronics at 110% and industrial goods at 135%, totaling 127,800 credits for the crew.    Nemo, Emilio, and Rocío: Attempt to bribe customs officials and seek contacts. They discover that local nobles politically despise Drinax, but covet luxury goods (cars, grav tanks, cybernetics). They also notice a great fear in the population of an impending Aslan invasion, especially from the ihatei* (landless second sons).    Alvarito and Fermín: Visit pilot bars. Alvarito, pretending to be a drunken merchant, obtains a valuable rumor from an imperial pilot: a treasure convoy (the Martin II*) is being prepared to travel from the Empire towards Aslan space. Scene 4: The War Council PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Alvarito, Rocío. NPCs present: None directly. Location: Paal (Paal System) / Ship Harrier. Ships mentioned: Martin II (Imperial convoy/treasure ship, Jump-3), Harrier. Scene Summary: The crew debates what to do with the information about the "Golden Galleon" (Martin II). Some want to pursue it immediately, charting an interception route towards the Exe or Tech-World system. Others, seeing the difficulty of assaulting a militarized imperial convoy with their current resources, prefer to stick to the original plan of kingdom reconstruction. Finally, Captain Nemo decides on a hybrid plan: they will depart Paal for the Sink system (a poor system with gas giants) to ambush ships and practice piracy ("hunt"), and then jump to Byrni to sell what they steal and establish diplomatic contact, staying close to the convoy's possible route should an opportunity arise.

content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Castilian Spanish. Failed Ambush and the Treasure of Arunisiir PCs present Nemo (Captain / Social Leader) Emilio (Communications / Electronic Warfare) Pika (Pilot / Mechanic) Rocío (Gunner) Fomega (Sensors / Science Officer)    Note: "El Perro" (likely Krrsh) is also mentioned operating a turret.* NPCs present Sofía (Robotic guide from Tech-World) Captain Aslan (Hostile voice over radio) Abra (Crew member, engineer) Wolfy (Marine) Important developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign    The crew has located the whereabouts of the Treasure Ship (Martin II*): it is damaged on the planet Arunisiir.    It is confirmed that the Treasure Ship is protected by Imperial Marines with Battle Dress* and plasma rifles. The crew's reputation may have been affected by the forced retreat in Paal. Loose ends The exact nature and experiments of Tech-World scientists and their connection to Newman's "Church of the Shield." Ship repairs are not 100% complete due to lack of spare parts and funds, and crew morale may suffer from the defeat. The Hunt for Aslan PCs present All PCs in their combat stations (Bridge and Turret). NPCs present Captain Aslan (Commander of enemy freighters, aggressive and territorial). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Deep space near Paal (Paal System). Ships mentioned    La Banshee* (PCs' ship). Three Aslan Light Freighters (Targets, armed with 2 turrets each). System Defense Ship (400 tons, patrol class). Scene summary The crew of La Banshee, after an intense debate on approach tactics and sensor usage, decides to ambush three ships they identify as Aslan light freighters carrying livestock and merchandise. They attempt a stealthy approach and issue an ultimatum for surrender. However, they underestimate their prey: the Aslan freighters are heavily armed and unyielding. A space battle erupts. Rocío and "El Perro" manage to damage one of the enemy ships with the particle cannon and missiles, but La Banshee sustains hull damage (7 points) from return laser fire. The situation worsens when they detect a 400-ton System Defense Ship rapidly approaching. Outnumbered and outgunned, the PCs decide to abort the attack, execute evasive maneuvers, and prepare for an emergency jump to flee. Welcome to the Technocracy PCs present All PCs. NPCs present Sofía (Android guide, chrome appearance and metallic voice, archetype of a helpful but unsettling AI). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Spaceport (Planet Tech-World / Teche-World System). Ships mentioned    La Banshee*. Scene summary After a week of jumping, La Banshee arrives in the Tech-World system. The planet exhibits a very high technological level (TL 14+). Landing is managed by nanomachines that construct the runway in real-time on a black surface. Upon disembarking, they are met by swarms of micro-robots that take DNA samples and by Sofía, a robotic guide. Sofía offers them advanced services (cybernetics, cloning, weapons) and explains that the planet is a refuge for scientists fleeing technological religious restrictions. The atmosphere is aseptic, unsettling, and extremely expensive for the PCs' current economy. Rumors at the "Luddite" PCs present Nemo, Emilio, Pika, Fomega (mentioned interacting or rolling dice). NPCs present Bar patrons (Crew from other ships, rough appearance).    Abra (Crew member, playing Torpolín*). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) "Luddite" Bar (Planet Tech-World). Ships mentioned    Martin II* (Treasure Ship, Merchant class, Unknown Captain, First Officer Jagad). Scene summary Seeking a more human environment, the crew heads to the "Luddite" bar, a low-tech establishment within the futuristic city. There, amidst beers and games of table "Torpolian Water Polo," they gather crucial information thanks to Admiral Darokin's contacts and rumors from other crews. They discover that the treasure fleet passed through, but the main ship, the Martin II, suffered a jump drive malfunction and had to be left behind on the planet Arunisiir. They obtain specific details: the malfunction is in the engineering section, it is defended by a squad of elite Imperial Marines, its first officer Jagad is looking for war veterans, and its navigator, Osha, is native to an aquatic world in the Trojan Expansion. Repairs and New Route PCs present Pika, Rocío (assisting with repairs), Nemo. NPCs present None relevant. Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Spaceport (Planet Tech-World). Ships mentioned    La Banshee*. Scene summary Before departing, the crew dedicates a few hours to repairing the hull damage sustained during the ambush in Paal, spending some of their spare parts and money. They dismiss staying longer in Tech-World due to high costs and lack of clear opportunities for quick trade. They chart a new navigation route: they will travel to the Exe system to refuel at a gas giant and from there jump to their final destination: Arunisiir, to intercept the damaged treasure ship.

title: 17 - PoD - Exe
content: Here is the session summary, following the requested format: Assault on Exe and the Surprise of Acrid PJs present: Honor (Pilot) Rocío (Gunner) Nemo (Face/Intimidation) James Hondo (Marine/Boarding) Wolf (Marine/Boarding) Tia (Sensors/Comms/Acting Captain) NPCs present: Krrsh (Gunner/Marine - PJ ship crew, loyal warrior archetype). Ann / "Arpaz" (Engineer - PJ ship crew, technical expert archetype). The "Cannibal" (Marine - PJ ship crew, thug archetype). Merchant Captain (Captain of the raided ship, pragmatic victim archetype). Campaign and PJ Development: The crew has successfully executed a piracy act against a merchant, obtaining significant loot of radioactive materials, precious metals, and gems, estimated to be worth several million credits. This represents a major advance in acquiring financial resources for the campaign. Loose Ends: The exact identity and origin of the patrol corvette that appeared in Exe. The critical situation upon arriving in the Acrid system: they have been met by port authority (PRQ) for an inspection, while carrying a hold full of stolen cargo bearing the corporation's logo. The Wait and the Ambush PJs present: All. NPCs present: None relevant in active scene. Location(s): Gas Giant / Deep Space (Exe System). Ship(s): Banshee (PJ Ship), Subsidized Merchant (Merchant Freighter, Target). Summary: After refueling and refining fuel, the crew decides to wait in the shadow of the system's gas giant in Exe with passive sensors activated. They detect the arrival of a merchant freighter (Subsidized Merchant) heading for Highport. The crew decides to intercept it while maintaining stealth and approaching at assault speed. They perform a detailed scan revealing a defensive turret, about 15 people on board (some in cryogenic sleep), and a full cargo hold, detecting high-density and radioactive materials. Intimidation and Warning Shot PJs present: All (in their combat stations). NPCs present: Merchant Captain (Voice over radio, scared and pragmatic). Location(s): Space near the planet (Exe System). Ship(s): Banshee (PJ Ship), Subsidized Merchant (Target). Summary: The crew blocks the merchant's communications (jamming) to prevent them from calling for help. Nemo opens a channel and impersonates a PRQ (Pax Ruling Quartermasters) authority, demanding they stop and threatening to destroy them with their particle cannon. The merchant captain tries to negotiate by offering to release some cargo, but the PJ crew demands a full boarding. To demonstrate they are serious, Rocío fires at the merchant's defensive turret, disabling it and damaging the hull. The merchant surrenders, shuts down engines, and prepares to be boarded, but warns that a patrol will arrive shortly. The Loot Against the Clock PJs present: James Hondo, Wolf, Nemo (Boarding team); Honor, Rocío, Tia (Ship support). NPCs present: Krrsh (Assisting with cargo), Merchant Crew (Surrendered/Intimidated). Location(s): Merchant Cargo Hold and Connecting Hatches. Ship(s): Banshee and Subsidized Merchant. Summary: With a time limit of approximately one hour before reinforcements arrive, the boarding team enters the ship. While Wolf and Hondo secure the area and intimidate the crew into cooperating, Nemo and the others begin to transfer the cargo. They use the ship's machinery (forklifts) and human chains to move tons of merchandise. During the process, Nemo has an accident and a box falls on him, injuring him. They manage to identify and specifically steal tons of radioactive material, precious metals, gems, and rare minerals, filling their own hold almost to capacity (approx. 24 tons). Escape and Jump to Acrid PJs present: All. NPCs present: Ann (Calculating jump). Location(s): Deep Space (Exe System) and Jump Space. Ship(s): Patrol Corvette (Enemy Patrol Corvette). Summary: Just as they finish loading, sensors detect a Patrol Corvette approaching at high speed. The crew disconnects hastily and Rocío accelerates the ship to get away. While Honor and Tia manage the evasion, Emilio (Tia/Ann) calculates the data for the interstellar jump under pressure. The enemy corvette sweeps them with sensors multiple times but fails to intercept them before they activate the jump drive. During the week in hyperspace, the crew inventories the stolen "surprise boxes," confirming a millionaire's haul. Welcome to Acrid PJs present: All. NPCs present: Customs Control (Voice over radio, Authority). Location(s): Orbit / Approach to the planet (Acrid System). Ship(s): Banshee. Summary: The ship emerges from the jump in the Acrid system. They decide not to refuel at the gas giant and head directly for the main planet (Technology Level 6, Lawless). However, upon approaching, they receive communication from the local authority, identifying themselves as Pax Ruling Quartermasters (PRQ) – the same faction they have robbed and impersonated. They welcome them and order them to prepare for a customs inspection. The session ends with the tension of having the hold full of stolen merchandise with the PRQ logo as the inspectors approach.
