title: 18 - PoD - Treasure Ship 01
content: Here is the session summary in the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Infiltration of the Martin II PCs present: Nemo (Captain), Emilio (Pika), Rocío, Paloma, Juan, Nacho (Fermín), Alphomega. NPCs present: Krrsh, Abra, Mechanic Polo, Commander Mari Jagat, Yan, O'Leary, Ilyn, Bell. Important Developments: A critical flaw is discovered in the PCs' ship's sensors, caused by a mummified corpse hidden in the conduits, which will require costly repairs.    Part of the crew successfully infiltrates the treasure ship, the Martin II*, by being hired as engineers and mechanics, taking a giant step towards the goal of looting it. Loose Ends: The identity and origin of the corpse in a Drinax uniform found in the PCs' ship's sensors remains a mystery. The complete repair of the sensors costs almost 3 million credits, money they do not currently have.    The plan to open the Martin II*'s vault remains undefined, as jump coordinates and specific codes are required. Jump Failure and the Corpse in the Sensors PCs present: Nemo, Emilio, Rocío, Paloma, Juan, Nacho, Alphomega. NPCs present: None. Location: Deep space / Distant orbit (Arunisir System). Ships: Harrier (Fighters, Captain Nemo), Gacela (Imperial Escort, in orbit). The crew discusses the strategy for jumping to the Arunisir system, deciding to use their ship's stealth to avoid detection by the orbiting Gacela escort. Upon arrival, they attempt a passive sensor sweep, but the system fails catastrophically. After emergency repairs led by Emilio, Rocío, and Álvarito, they discover the cause: a mummified corpse in an old Drinax navy uniform (from about 300 years ago) was stuck between the wires. The damage is severe and the repair will cost a fortune. Despite the failure, they manage to detect that the Martin II is on the surface and decide to land in a wild and remote area. Landing and Approach to Civilization PCs present: Nemo, Emilio, Rocío, Paloma, Juan, Nacho, Alphomega. NPCs present: Truck Driver (Human, obese, transport driver; archetype of the hardworking and distrustful local). Location: Wild area / Rural road (Planet Arunisir). Ships: Harrier. The crew lands the ship in a wooded valley and camouflages it with holograms. They decide to walk to a nearby urban center to get transport. Along the way, they are picked up by a worker's truck. Through the driver, they learn about Arunisir's political situation: the planet is divided into 12 Aslan clans, but the Aslans are mere puppets dedicated to hunting and posing, while human counselors are the ones who actually govern. They also hear rumors about "The People's League," a local terrorist group frowned upon by the population. The driver drops them off in a nearby city. Reconnaissance at the Spaceport and the Bar PCs present: All (divided into groups). NPCs present: Yan (Imperial Scout, Scout pilot; archetype of the momentary local hero). O'Leary (Crew member of the Martin II, gunner; archetype of the garrulous and lazy employee).    Bell (Captain of the Hopeful Wanderer*; archetype of the independent merchant). Location: Local city and Arunisir Bar at the Spaceport (Planet Arunisir). Ships: Land Rovers (Purchased ground vehicles), Martin II (Damaged heavy freighter), Hopeful Wanderer (Far Trader), Fafnir (Far Trader). The group buys two Land Rovers and heads to the spaceport, which appears to be a settlement built around the hull of an old Aslan ship. They split up to gather information in the cantina. Emilio talks to Yan, a Scout pilot who is celebrated as a hero for having reported the Martin II's accident. Nemo and Nacho play cards with O'Leary, a crew member of the Martin II, who reveals that the ship suffered a jump drive accident and that the engineering section was vented into space, killing all the technical personnel. They learn that the ship is desperate for engineers for repairs. The Job Interview and the Old Rival PCs present: Rocío, Paloma, Emilio, Alphomega. NPCs present: Mechanic Polo (Acting Chief Mechanic; archetype of the stressed and geeky technician). Commander Mari Jagat (Executive Officer of the Martin II, human, attractive and severe; archetype of the military "Femme Fatale" and former rival). Imperial Marines (Guards in Battle Dress; archetype of unmovable force). Location: Interior of the Martin II (Arunisir Spaceport). Ships: Martin II. Rocío, Paloma, Emilio, and Alphomega present themselves as local mechanics or mercenaries looking for work. They are escorted inside the Martin II past guards in combat armor (Battle Dress). Mechanic Polo gives them a quick technical interview. When it seems they are being accepted, Commander Mari Jagat appears. Surprisingly, Jagat recognizes Rocío from their days at military academy; they were rivals, and Rocío "stole" her boyfriend in the past. Far from rejecting her, Jagat, in a position of power and desperate for qualified personnel after the accident, decides to hire Rocío and her team with an attitude of superiority, assigning them bunks on the ship. The team is inside.

title: 19 - PoD - Treasure Ship 02
content: Session Title: Infiltration and Protocol in Arunisiir PCs present: Emilio (Fomega): Undercover Doctor and Engineer. Rocío (Rocío): Gunner/Mechanic, former navy officer. Pika (Paloma): Computer Engineer and Hacker. Juan Wick (Nacho): Agent and Spy. Nemo (Nemo): Captain and "Face" of the group. NPCs present: Mechanic Polo (Morning shift chief, superstitious). Mechanic Thalys (Afternoon shift chief, mourning the death of her partner Felmar). Yan Laral (Marine, amateur tourist). Salveste (Marine, serious). Lobis Anna (Marine, nervous/uneasy). Sharif (Marine, impeccable and vain). Captain Torsa (Captain of the Martin II, archetype of an arrogant and nepotistic noble). Commander Maria Yagat (First Officer, Rocío's nemesis). Second Officer Halvinar (Efficient and normal). Commander Hark (Head of Marines, cyborg with visible implants, very suspicious). Accountant Vagan (Treasurer/Purser, dull and obsessed with spreadsheets). Pilot Henshaw (Shuttle pilot, solitary and professional). Captain Bell (Independent merchant). Joral and Gila (Elderly merchant couple). Aslan Thug (Local port extortionist). Main developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: The characters have successfully infiltrated the stranded imperial treasure ship, the Martin II, securing temporary jobs as auxiliary mechanics. They have established a work routine to observe the security systems and have rented a nearby industrial ship as a safe house. Additionally, they have discovered there is a 22,000 credit reward for information about their own ship (described as an unknown ship with a particle cannon and a portrait of a human) following their previous incident with Aslan merchants. Loose ends:    The exact content and opening mechanism of The Vault* remain a mystery, although Pika has confirmed it is autonomous but connected to the ship. The Commander of the Marines, Hark, openly suspects Rocío after the interrogation at dinner. The presence of the pirate Aslan "Iron Tooth" has been confirmed in the Exe system by Captain Bell. The nature of the television program "Foresters" recorded on the planet and its relationship with the Empire. Scene 1: First Day of Work and Logistics PCs present: Emilio, Rocío, Pika, Juan Wick, Nemo. NPCs present: Mechanic Polo (Superstitious Chief), Mechanic Thalys (Depressed Chief), Marine Yan Laral (Relaxed Guard), Marine Salveste (Serious Guard). Location: Arunisiir (Planet), Interior of the Martin II, Nearby City. Ships mentioned: Martin II (Stranded Imperial Treasure Ship), Aslan Assault Carrier (Hull converted into Spaceport). Scene Summary: The group splits up. Emilio, Rocío, and Pika begin their work infiltration on the Martin II. They pass security checks (without their own weapons or tools) and are assigned shifts: Emilio and Pika in the morning with the superstitious Polo; Rocío in the afternoon with Thalys. The engineering area is a mess with human remains and hydrogen damage. From the galley, they observe The Vault, built with exotic materials. Meanwhile, outside the ship, Nemo and Juan try to establish an operational base. Nemo manages to rent a discreet industrial ship through bribes and administration, while Juan unsuccessfully attempts to contact local terrorist groups. Scene 2: Contacts at the Spaceport Bar PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Joral and Gila (Elderly merchant couple, owners of a Far Trader), Captain Bell. Location: Spaceport Bar (Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Fafnir (Far Trader, Captains Joral and Gila). Scene Summary: Nemo socializes at the bar to gather information and establish his mercenary alibi. He meets Joral and Gila, an older merchant couple who trade in the Borderlands. Nemo learns rumors about the arrival of three imperial ships to repair the Martin II. Nemo tries to gain their trust by buying drinks and establishing himself as a regular. Scene 3: Dinner with the Officers PCs present: Rocío. NPCs present: Captain Torsa (Arrogant Noble), Commander Maria Yagat (Manipulative Rival), Commander Hark (Suspicious Cyborg), Accountant Vagan (Bureaucrat), Second Officer Halvinar. Location: Officers' Bridge / Conference Room (Martin II). Scene Summary: On the second day, Rocío is pulled from her shift, dirty and covered in grease, by Commander Yagat to dine with the ship's senior staff. It's a social ambush. Captain Torsa is classist and nepotistic. Commander Hark, an intimidating cyborg, subjects Rocío to an aggressive interrogation about her past after leaving the navy. Rocío tries to maintain composure by lying about her record, but awakens Hark's suspicions. She learns that Halvinar will remain on the planet after repairs to finalize paperwork. Scene 4: Hacking and Investigations PCs present: Pika, Emilio, Juan Wick. NPCs present: Marine Sharif (Immaculate), Pilot Henshaw (Antisocial), Pilot Smith (Head of pilots, about to retire). Location: Engineering (Martin II), Arunisiir City. Scene Summary: On the third day, Pika takes advantage of a camera blind spot and the distraction of the marines to hack a terminal. She accesses the accident logs, confirming it was a failure in the jump drive's security locks that released 500 tons of hydrogen, killing the original engineering crew. She finds no definitive proof of prior sabotage but confirms the computer security is standard. Emilio tries to socialize with pilot Henshaw without much initial success, and attempts to provoke a "fortuitous" accident by dirtying the immaculate Marine Sharif to test his reaction, failing spectacularly. Outside, Juan investigates in the city and discovers a television program called "Foresters" produced by an imperial corporation on the planet. Scene 5: The Aslan Thug and the Pirate Route PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Captain Bell (of the Merciful Wanderer), Aslan Thug (Extortionist with wounded honor). Location: Spaceport (Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Merciful Wanderer (Merchant, Captain Bell), Midgrinder (Flagship of the pirate Iron Tooth), Martin II. Scene Summary: Nemo intervenes in a dispute between Captain Bell and a local Aslan demanding a "tax" for landing on his ancestral territory. Nemo uses diplomacy and manipulates the Aslan by appealing to his honor, causing him to withdraw. Grateful, Bell tells him that four weeks ago her sensors detected the famous Aslan pirate "Iron Tooth" and his ship Midgrinder in the Exe asteroid belt. Nemo tries to sell her "legal" (stolen) merchandise, but she declines, preferring to stay within the law. Additionally, Nemo learns about the 22,000 credit reward offered for information about the PCs' ship.

title: 20 - PoD - Treasure Ship 03
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript, following the requested format and language. Session: The Imperial Vault Heist PCs present: Paloma (Hacker), Rocío (Engineer/Social), Honor (Infiltrator), Nemo (Diplomat/Face), Pika (Engineer), Tía (Engineer), Jane (Engineer), Alvarito (Chemist/Doctor - mentioned). NPCs present: Mechanic Thalys, Pilot Smith, Pilot Handshow, Mechanic Polo, Imperial Marines (Sharif, Salvedes, Cera, Yaseline Serra, Dobis), Loadmaster Nippen, Captain Torsa (mentioned), Officer Hallard (mentioned). Campaign Development: The group is advancing in the intelligence phase for the heist of the Imperial Treasure Ship stranded in the port. A plan has been established to introduce a "Trojan Horse" cargo through a fake Aslan tribute managed by Nemo. Surveillance devices (microphones and cameras) have been placed at the entrance of the vault. It has been discovered that the vault's security includes genetic locks and gravitic seals. Loose Ends: The purchase of the scanner jammer by Nacho's character was interrupted by a local television interview, which could have exposed his cover. Nemo is awaiting confirmation and preparation of the Aslan tribute to execute the cargo introduction. Paloma still needs to sell the legitimate merchandise from her own ship to maintain cover. Scene: Brainstorming and Logistics PCs present: The whole group (tactical discussion). NPCs present: None. Location: Outside the ship / Base of operations (Planet Arunisiir). Ships: None. Summary: The group heatedly discusses how to introduce illegal equipment (computers, drugs, weapons) into the Treasure Ship, which has strict security controls with scanners. Scatological ideas about hiding objects in bodily cavities and using distractions are debated. Alvarito proposes a lethal plan using drugs in the vacuum suits, but the group prefers a more subtle approach. Finally, they decide to stop rambling and start executing concrete intelligence and infiltration actions day by day. Scene: Day Shift - The Drill PCs present: Pika, Jane, Alvarito. NPCs present: Mechanic Polo (Superstitious), Marines on guard. Location: Engineering (Treasure Ship, Planet Arunisiir). Ships: Treasure Ship (Imperial). Summary: During the work shift in engineering, Pika attempts to investigate the life support systems to see if the vault has its own atmosphere (concluding it doesn't seem designed to house life). Suddenly, a "general quarters" alarm sounds. The crew and PCs must don vacuum suits and remain in safety cubicles for three hours. The group identifies this drill period as a perfect window of opportunity to act in the future, as the routine is broken. Scene: Social Engineering and Friendships PCs present: Rocío, Paloma, Honor, Tía. NPCs present: Mechanic Thalys (Archetype: The depressed widow), Marine Sharif (Archetype: The elegant one), Captain Torsa (mentioned as incompetent/nepotism), Officer Hallard (mentioned as competent and tough). Location: Engineering and Mess Hall (Treasure Ship). Ships: Treasure Ship. Summary: Rocío gains the trust of Thalys, a mechanic depressed by the death of her partner Fellmark in the ship's accident. Thalys reveals that First Officer Hallard is the one actually running the ship, while Captain Torsa is a useless figure put in place through connections. Meanwhile, Paloma tries to find out the marines' shifts through minor hacks and observation. Scene: The Old Guard and the Taxi PCs present: Pika, Paloma, Rocío. NPCs present: Pilot Smith (Archetype: The veteran about to retire), Pilot Handshow (Archetype: The space taxi driver). Location: Mess Hall (Treasure Ship). Ships: Treasure Ship. Summary: During mealtime, Pika sits with Pilot Smith and pilot Handshow. Smith is an older man who just wants to retire and considers the ship a boring "flying safe," though he confirms it transports documents, jewels, and radioactive materials. He mentions that pirates don't dare to attack them. Paloma tries to join the conversation but is ignored by the veteran. Scene: Device Infiltration PCs present: Paloma, Rocío, Honor. NPCs present: Marine Salvedes, Marine Cera (Security Guards). Location: Access Control Point (Treasure Ship). Ships: Treasure Ship. Summary: The group decides to introduce hidden microphones (bugs) and a high-tech camera (TL13). Upon passing through the security scanner, the device detects something on Paloma. Through a quick distraction maneuver using a hairpin and sleight of hand with Rocío (who hides the device), they manage to convince the marines it's a sensor error or a simple buckle, successfully smuggling the espionage equipment onto the ship. Scene: Vault Reconnaissance PCs present: Pika (Emilio), Paloma. NPCs present: Generic crew in the mess hall. Location: Near the Vault (Cargo Hold, Treasure Ship). Ships: Treasure Ship. Summary: Taking advantage of an oversight, Paloma places a hidden camera pointing at the vault's entrance. Pika manages to get close enough to inspect the external structure of the vault. He observes it is a black monolith that doesn't reach the ceiling, sealed with a braided material, complex locks, gravitic seals, and a genetic reader for a physical key. Pika tries to analyze further but must retreat to avoid arousing suspicion. Scene: Underworld Business and Diplomacy PCs present: Nemo, Nacho's character (Jane/Other). NPCs present: Loadmaster Nippen (Archetype: The drunk stevedore), Aslan Port Lord (mentioned), Local TV crew. Location: City and Port (Planet Arunisiir). Ships: Gazelle (mentioned as escort). Summary: Nemo finds Nippen, the loadmaster, in a bar. Nippen is a loud, drunk man, but Nemo doesn't manage to get much useful information from him immediately. On the other hand, Nemo orchestrates a diplomatic plan: he convinces the local Aslan to send a "tribute" of precious stones to the Empire to gain renown, which will serve as a cover to legally bring cargo (and perhaps the PCs) onto the ship. In parallel, Nacho's character goes to the black market to buy a scanner jammer for 2,500 credits. Upon leaving, he is intercepted by a local news crew who interviews him live; he tries to pass himself off as an eccentric hunter but nearly causes a diplomatic incident by speaking ill of the Aslan occupation. Scene: Port Investigation PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Port officials. Location: Arunisiir Port (Offices/Tower). Ships: Orbital station (mentioned). Summary: Nemo investigates the port's corporate structure. He discovers that the ground port (Downport) is managed by a local oligarch corporation, but the orbital refueling station (Highport) is owned by a subsidiary of GeDeCo, implying larger corporate interests in orbit.

title: 21 - PoD - Treasure Ship 04
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session: Infiltrators in Arunisiir PJs present: Fomega, Nemo, Paloma (also referred to as Pika), Juan Maldonado, Honor (Emilio), Rocío, Nacho (mentioned), Tía (mentioned). NPCs present: Captain Hark (Marine Leader), Commander Maria Gad (Second-in-command of the Martin II), Jane Laral (Marine tourist), Salvestes (Tough Marine), Crewmember O'Leary (Logistics), Crewmember Ealing (Logistics), Amparo (Tech-World merchant), Officer Grimsvold (Tactical Officer), Pilot Henshaw. Important developments in the lives of the PJs or the campaign:    The group consolidates their position as temporary workers aboard the ship Martin II*, gaining the crew's trust (or indifference). A concrete plan is established to introduce a hacking computer onto the ship: dismantling it and smuggling it through supply boxes, taking advantage of the logistics managers' apathy.    Discovery of a potential information buyer or spy (Amparo) interested in the status of the Martin II*'s jump drive. Loose ends / Pending: The Vault: They still don't know what's inside or exactly how to open it (suspected physical key, DNA, and astrophysical coordinates). The ship's health status: Captain Hark is discreetly looking for a doctor in the city, which is unusual. Amparo: It's unknown if they are a simple opportunist, an imperial spy, or an agent of another faction. The computer: The introduction of the computer parts into the supplies and their assembly onboard without detection still needs to be executed. The ship Banshee: It remains hidden far away, and moving it to the spaceport involves risks of detection by the orbiting Gazelle. Scene 1: Recalling the Mission and the Plan PJs present: Fomega, Nemo, Paloma, Juan Maldonado, Honor (Emilio). NPCs present: None direct, the crew of the Martin II is mentioned. Location: Hideout/Garage in the city (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Martin II (Imperial Treasure Ship), Banshee (PJs' Ship), Gazelle (Gazelle Class, escort ship in orbit), Meet Grinder (Pocket Warship Aslan, Captain Joral Iron Tooth). Scene Summary: The group recalls their current situation: they are on planet Arunisiir, where the imperial treasure ship Martin II (about 1200 tons) made an emergency landing after a hydrogen leak in the jump drive. The outside atmosphere is breathable but high in nitrogen, and a Gazelle-class warship is monitoring from orbit. They discuss the "Vault" on the ship. They know it requires a key, biometrics, and possibly specific navigation coordinates to open. Several strategies are debated: 1.  Hack the ship by introducing a powerful computer. 2.  Cause a mass food poisoning to incapacitate the crew (idea of using laxatives or contaminating the food processor). 3.  Simulate an emergency/drill to move the crew. 4.  Nemo suggests "eliminating" some marines to reduce security, but Juan advocates for maintaining a low profile and investigating further before using violence. Finally, they decide that the priority is to introduce Paloma's computer to hack the systems and obtain information about the Vault. They plan to do this by smuggling the parts inside legitimate supply boxes. Scene 2: Morning Shift - Socializing with the Enemy PJs present: Fomega, Honor (Emilio). NPCs present: Marine Salvestes (Tough guy), Marine Jane Laral (Tourist, curious). Location: Mess Hall / Cantina of the ship Martin II (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Martin II. Scene Summary: During their work shift on the ship, Fomega uses mealtime to try and socialize. They sit with marines Salvestes and Jane Laral. Fomega pretends to be a local from the planet Blue to justify their presence. The conversation is innocuous but serves to establish a cordial relationship and make them stop seeing them as suspicious strangers. Meanwhile, Honor (Emilio) tries to get close to the Vault area in the cargo hold to investigate it, but discovers it's a common thoroughfare with people always stretching their legs or standing guard, so they can't get close enough without raising suspicion. Scene 3: Afternoon Shift - Plumbing and Logistics PJs present: Paloma (Pika), Rocío, Tía. NPCs present: Crewmember O'Leary (Logistics, drunk, lazy), Crewmember Ealing (Logistics, drunk, lazy). Location: Engineering / Pipe system of the ship Martin II (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Martin II. Scene Summary: Paloma and her team are assigned an unpleasant task: checking the sewage pipes at the order of Officer Grimsvold. Taking advantage of working near the cargo and supply area, Paloma observes the goods entry procedure. She discovers that the managers, O'Leary and Ealing, are lazy, tired of military discipline, and prefer playing cards over meticulously checking boxes. Paloma uses her social skills to extract information from them about the local supplier from whom they pick up merchandise the next day. This confirms that it is viable to smugmoogle the computer parts in these boxes through bribery or external manipulation. Scene 4: An Indecent Proposal PJs present: Fomega, Honor (Emilio). NPCs present: Amparo (Tech-World merchant, cyberpunk appearance, wears a wafer jack on their head). Location: Spaceport Bar (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Hopeful Wanderer (Ship Amparo arrived on), Martin II. Scene Summary: As the shift ends, a stranger approaches Fomega and Honor. They introduce themselves as Amparo, a merchant of rare parts who has arrived from Tech-World. They have a distinctive technological appearance. Amparo invites them for a beer and offers them money (1,000 credits each) in exchange for truthful information about the Martin II's condition, specifically confirmation that the jump drive is inoperative. The PJs accept the money and confirm the information, though they suspect Amparo's intentions, as Amparo records the conversation in their cranial implant. Amparo claims to want to sell parts to the Empire, but their demeanor is suspicious. Scene 5: The Search for the Supplier PJs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Captain Hark (Mentioned). Location: City / Cantinas (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: None. Scene Summary: Nemo spends their day gathering rumors and preparing the ground for the computer plan. They learn of an unsettling rumor: the Marine Commander, Hark, has been inquiring about the availability of competent doctors in the city, though it's unknown for whom or for what purpose. Later, Paloma informs Nemo about the identity of the ship's supply provider. Nemo decides they will go look for this provider (or their shop) to try and manipulate the next day's shipment and introduce the hacking computer parts.

title: 22 - PoD - Treasure Ship 05
content: Session Title: Infiltration, Chemistry, and the Shadow of Pirates PCs present: Paloma, Fomega (James Hondo), Emilio, Nemo (Ondo/Admiral Darokin in disguise), Fermín, Nacho (Jimmy). NPCs present: Chris (Aslan, allied crew member), Ebubekir (Merchant/Supplier), Polo (Engineering Supervisor), Tia (Ally/Crew member), Captain of the Hopeful Wanderer. Important developments in the PJs' lives or the campaign: The hacking equipment has been successfully introduced and assembled on the target ship, allowing Paloma to access security cameras. A contingency plan has been established, seeking shelter in ruins and negotiating distraction vehicles, in anticipation of the imminent arrival of a pirate fleet. Fomega has begun manufacturing a chemical compound (possibly poisonous or hallucinogenic) using local flora to incapacitate the crew. Loose ends:    The mysterious building: Fermín and Jimmy spotted a building with antennas near the Banshee*'s landing zone, which could be a threat or a point of interest.    The pirate scout ship: It has been confirmed that a Scout*-class ship conducted a reconnaissance of the planet and jumped away, indicating that the pirate attack is imminent (the time window is narrowing). Opening the vault: They still lack the physical key or the necessary DNA to open the vault, although they have access to the electronic systems. Scene: Return to Base and Sighting PCs present: Fermín, Nacho (Jimmy). NPCs present: Chris (Aslan, wearing a respirator, wags his tail happily upon seeing them). Location: Forests and outskirts of the city (Arunisiir). Ships: Banshee (Mentioned as landing site). Scene summary: Fermín and Jimmy return from their supply run through the forests of Arunisiir in the pressurized truck. They bring two tons of jewelry/gems for the Aslan tribute, medicine, food, and drinks. During the return trip, near where the Banshee is landed, they spot a small building with antennas on the horizon about 10 kilometers away. They decide not to investigate for the moment to avoid drawing attention and continue to the safe house, where Chris, the Aslan, greets them enthusiastically. Fermín spends the afternoon getting drunk and socializing with the crew to alleviate boredom. Scene: Bribing Ebubekir PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Ebubekir (Merchant/Supervisor, wears a worn business suit, respirator hanging, thick glasses, bald and thin; archetype of a corruptible official). Location: Industrial Zone, Supervisor's Office (Arunisiir). Scene summary: Nemo disguises himself using a kit and assumes the identity of "Joe Bigman." He heads to the industrial zone to meet Ebubekir, the supplier of spare parts for the target ship. Nemo offers him a deal: to include a package (the disassembled hacking computer) in the legitimate cargo going to the ship. After some negotiation, they agree on the price. Nemo pays 20,000 credits upfront as a guarantee and promises to deliver jewels later. The goal is for the parts to enter without raising suspicion in the maintenance cargo. Scene: Reception and Equipment Assembly PCs present: Paloma, Emilio, Fomega. NPCs present: Tia (Ally covering for Paloma), Polo (Supervisor, demanding and suspicious). Location: Cargo Deck and Engineering Room (Target Ship). Scene summary: Inside the ship, Fomega and Emilio work hard to avoid raising suspicion from their supervisor, Polo. Fomega tries to win Polo over unsuccessfully and acts erratically. Taking advantage of Tia covering her at work, Paloma sneaks to the cargo area when Ebubekir's shipment arrives. She manages to retrieve the computer parts hidden among the spare parts. Later, she finds a safe corner without cameras and manages to assemble the laptop, leaving it ready for operation. Emilio tries to investigate a previously tampered panel but reaches no clear conclusions beyond that someone checked it and closed it improperly. Scene: The Improvised Centrifuge PCs present: Fomega. NPCs present: None directly. Location: Safe House (Arunisiir). Scene summary: At night, in the safe house, Fomega begins to fabricate improvised equipment using a blender, wires, and other utensils. Her goal is to create a centrifuge to process local flora and chemicals (drugs/cleaning agents) in order to synthesize a gas (poisonous or hallucinogenic) that can be introduced into the ship's ventilation system. It is determined that this process will take her several days of nocturnal work and will cost her health (Endurance points) due to lack of sleep and the use of stimulants. Scene: Escape Preparations and News from Space PCs present: Nemo, Fermín (Nacho). NPCs present: Captain of the Hopeful Wanderer (Merchant, ally/acquaintance of Nemo). Location: Spaceport Ruins and Market (Arunisiir). Ships: Hopeful Wanderer (Merchant Vessel), Pirate Scout Ship (Sighted in orbit). Scene summary: Nemo and Fermín look for a secondary safe place in case things go wrong. They find a ruined building near the spaceport that can serve to hide a truck, although it needs repairs. Nemo visits the Captain of the Hopeful Wanderer and negotiates the purchase of a fleet of identical cars to use as decoys/distractions on the day of the operation. During his errands at the port, Nemo learns of a worrying rumor: a Scout-class ship (scout type, jump 2) has entered orbit, scanned the area, and jumped away quickly before being intercepted, confirming that the pirates are exploring the system and their arrival is imminent. Scene: Hacking and Frustration PCs present: Paloma, Fomega, Emilio, Nemo, Fermín. Location: Interior of the Ship and Safe House (Arunisiir). Scene summary: Back on the ship, Paloma uses the assembled computer to hack the system. She gains access to the security cameras (difficulty 12 overcome) and views the corridor leading to the vault, but not its interior. She tries to review old recordings to see who tampered with the panel, but there is too much data to download. She prepares the system to loop the cameras when necessary. The group discusses with frustration the lack of a definitive plan, debating whether to act before the pirates arrive or use the pirate attack as cover. It is confirmed that a marine (Yan) has changed her shift and will have days off soon, which could be an opportunity or a risk.

title: 23 - PoD - Treasure Ship 06
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and restrictions. Session Title: Diplomatic Dilemmas and the Iron Tooth Plot PCs present Nemo (Captain / Social Facet) Juan Maldonado (Security / Marine) Fomega (Engineer / Mechanic) Paloma (Hacker / Computer Specialist) Fermín (Investigator) Emilio (Pilot / Astrogator) NPCs present Ecaf (Aslan Leader. Physique: 2.20m - 2.30m tall, muscular, bristling fur. Archetype: The Honorable/Savage Warrior). Captain Torza (Imperial Ship Captain. Physique: Ceremonial uniform. Archetype: The Protocol Officer). Commander Mari Llagad (Imperial Officer. Physique: Piercing gaze. Archetype: The Perceptive Suspect). Halmi Barbalep (Second Officer. Archetype: The Logistician). Smith (Imperial Pilot. Physique: Older, near retirement. Archetype: The Talkative Veteran). Oshan (Astrogator. Physique: Blue skin, gills, pointed ears, aquatic. Archetype: The Exotic Navigator). Shuttle Pilot (No explicit name, female. Archetype: The Blackmailed Victim). Salvesdes (Pilot's husband. Physique: Strange/disturbing behavior. Archetype: The Coerced Accomplice). Aunt Clare (Ally/Crewmate, covers for Paloma at work). Important Developments in PCs' or Campaign Lives Nemo establishes a commercial and "hunting" alliance with the Aslan leader, Ecaf, promising tributes and seeking a safe haven for future operations. The group discovers it is nearly impossible to open the imperial ship's treasure chamber by conventional means (requires being in the Tioc system, a physical key, a biogenetic scanner, and specific navigation data). A parallel plot is revealed: the pirate Roll Iron Tooth is blackmailing the shuttle pilot (threatening her daughter) to sabotage the ship's jump and divert it to the Exe system, where his pirate fleet awaits. Loose Ends The whereabouts and activities of the marine that Fermín and Juan tried to follow but lost in the city. The final decision on how to execute the heist: Take the ship from the inside by eliminating the astrogators, try to hack the jump (very difficult), or let the Iron Tooth pirates attack? The exact nature of Captain Torza's "physical key." Scene 1: The Tribute to the Aslans PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Ecaf (Aslan Leader, imposing and direct), Aslans from the camp. Location: Aslan camp near Spaceport (Planet with atmosphere). Ships: None. Scene Summary: Nemo visits the Aslan camp to deliver the promised jewels as tribute. He meets Ecaf, who, surrounded by his armed entourage and working females, receives the partial payment with some skepticism but accepts the alliance. Ecaf questions Nemo's true intentions, to which Nemo admits he is seeking a strong ally and a safe place to hide from future enemies ("competitors"). Ecaf values sincerity and strength, agreeing to a friendship based on mutual benefit. Scene 2: Infiltration of the Treasure Ship PCs present: Nemo. NPCs present: Captain Torza (Imperial, strict), Commander Mari Llagad (Imperial, suspicious, friend of Rocío), Halmi Barbalep, Smith, Oshan. Location: Interior of the Imperial Treasure Ship (Spaceport). Ships: Imperial Treasure Ship (Model unknown, Captain Torza). Scene Summary: Nemo, accompanied by the Aslans (carrying the jewels), manages to enter the imperial ship under the pretense of depositing the tribute in the armored chamber. Captain Torza gives them a tour, showing them the bridge and politely (but firmly) refusing to open the chamber, stating it only opens at the final destination (Tioc) and that the cargo will be safe in the hold. During the visit, Nemo observes the security systems and notices Commander Mari Llagad watching him with extreme suspicion. Nemo memorizes the bridge layout and identifies the key officers (Smith and the alien Oshan). Scene 3: Failed Surveillance in the City PCs present: Juan Maldonado, Fermín (mentioned as Nacho/Jimmy). NPCs present: An imperial marine (Surveillance target). Location: Spaceport and City (Planet with atmosphere). Ships: None. Scene Summary: Juan and Fermín attempt to follow an imperial crew marine who goes on leave. Juan disguises himself and changes his appearance, while Fermín searches for clues in the garbage. They wait at the spaceport, but when the marine leaves, she takes the only available taxi to the city and they lose sight of her. They spend the rest of the day trying to locate her at transport stations and tourist offices without success. Scene 4: Social Engineering and Dark Secrets PCs present: Fomega, Emilio, Paloma. NPCs present: Smith (Pilot), Shuttle Pilot (Blackmailed), Salvesdes (Suspicious husband). Location: Cantina / Mess Hall of the Imperial Ship (Spaceport). Ships: Imperial Treasure Ship. Scene Summary: Fomega and Emilio infiltrate the crew socially. Emilio speaks with Smith, who reveals that the treasure chamber contains vital imperial documents for the Aslan clans and that its opening requires very specific conditions (Tioc coordinates, background radiation, etc.) that cannot be easily replicated. Fomega speaks with the shuttle pilot, who, under pressure, confesses to being blackmailed by the pirate Roll Iron Tooth. The pirates' plan is to sabotage the jump drive to divert the ship to the Exe system. The previous mechanic, Fellmar, died trying to manipulate the coordinates. Now, she and her husband Salvesdes must find a way to do it or their daughter will die. Scene 5: The Assault Dilemma PCs present: All (Nemo, Fomega, Paloma, Juan, Emilio, Fermín). NPCs present: None. Location: PCs' meeting place (Likely their ship or a secure location). Ships: Banshee (Harrier, PCs). Scene Summary: The group gathers to consolidate information. Paloma confirms after a successful hack (with Aunt Clare's help) that they cannot open the chamber without the Captain's physical key, a genetic sample from an officer, and a Level 15 Technological Computer to simulate Tioc navigation data. Given the impossibility of opening the chamber on the planet and the discovery of the Iron Tooth pirates' plot, the PCs debate their options: ally with the Empire (ruled out due to little benefit), let the pirates attack and steal from them afterward, or take control of the ship themselves. The most viable option appears to be kidnapping or eliminating the navigators (Smith and Oshan) and taking control of the jump to take the ship to a place where they can dismantle it calmly, escorted by the Banshee.

title: 24 - PoD - Treasure Ship 07
content: Here is the session summary in the requested format: Operation Anesthesia and Tacos on Arunisiir PJs present Fomega (Mechanic/Engineer), Emilio "Nemo" (Diplomat/Face), Paloma (Hacker), Jimmy (Driver/Pilot), Fermín (Gunner/Sniper), Ondo. NPCs present    Pilot Henshaw (Pilot of the Martin II*, desperate mother under duress). Captain Bell (Merchant Captain, Nemo's romantic/commercial interest).    Rocío (Second Officer of the Martin II*, strict and suspicious).    Polo (Chief Mechanic of the Martin II*, somewhat careless).    Thalis (Chief Mechanic of the Martin II*). Chris (Vargr, loyal and alert crewmember). Wolf (Vargr, bloodthirsty crewmember). Jane (Ally/Infiltrated crewmember). Aunt (Ally infiltrated on the ship). Álvaro (Contact for dubious goods). Major developments in PJs' lives or the campaign    The group advances in the plan to hijack the Martin II*: they plan to gas the crew using the vacuum suits or the life support system. Nemo establishes a commercial (and personal) relationship with Captain Bell to sell the loot (gems and precious metals) and gain liquidity. The manipulation of Pilot Henshaw is consolidated, ensuring her cooperation to facilitate access to the shuttle during the assault, using her daughter's safety as leverage. Fomega earns the respect of Chief Mechanic Thalis, improving his infiltrated position. Loose ends Nemo failed to find a seller for the anesthetic or gas needed for the plan, leaving the acquisition of the "drug" pending.    The Banshee*, hidden in the forest, is in danger of being discovered due to the unexpected arrival of a film crew (possibly for a reality show) right next to its hiding place. The biometric security of the armory and the permits of Second Officer Rocío remain an obstacle that Paloma is trying to overcome. Morning Planning and Logistics PJs present: Fomega, Emilio (Nemo), Paloma, Jimmy, Fermín, Ondo. NPCs present: Jane (Ally). Location: Crew Quarters/Ship Banshee (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Banshee (Destroyer, Unknown Captain), Martin II (Heavy Freighter, Unknown Captain). Scene Summary The group discusses options following the revelation of Pilot Henshaw's situation. Fomega proposes a plan to manipulate the vacuum suits or the air to incapacitate the crew of the Martin II instead of fighting, although they need to acquire the chemicals. Emilio (Nemo) and Jane insist on maintaining their cover and buying time. Tasks are divided: the infiltrators (Fomega, Emilio, Paloma, Jane) will go to their work shifts on the Martin II, while the ground team (Jimmy, Fermín) will go to the Banshee to watch over and move cargo. Fomega tries to socialize with Pika's help to improve his interactions with the NPCs. Military Post Exploration PJs present: Jimmy, Fermín. NPCs present: Chris (Vargr, scout/bodyguard), Wolf (Vargr), Abra. Local Guards (Bored Military). Location: Forests and rocky area (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: None. Scene Summary Jimmy and Fermín, accompanied by the Vargr, take a truck from the Banshee to explore a nearby facility previously spotted. Fermín stays as a sniper covering the area while Jimmy and Chris approach stealthily. The facility appears to be a regional police or communications barracks with antennas and official vehicles. They are almost discovered when Chris makes noise, alerting the guards who were patrolling smoking, but they manage to retreat without initiating a firefight. They decide it's not worth attacking and return. Business and Seduction at the Port PJs present: Emilio (under the alias "Nemo"). NPCs present: Captain Bell (Independent Trader, honest and cautious). Location: Pax Rulin food restaurant (Arunisiir Spaceport). Ships mentioned: Captain Bell's Ship (Merchant, Captain Bell). Scene Summary Nemo meets with Captain Bell for dinner to negotiate the sale of the tons of precious metals and gems they have stored. Bell agrees to act as an intermediary (broker) for a 5% commission, making it clear she wants no part in piracy. The evening extends, Nemo uses his charm to talk about the glory of Drinax, and they end up spending the night together at a hotel, consolidating the relationship for future logistical favors. Infiltration and Hacking on the Martin II PJs present: Paloma, Fomega, Emilio, Aunt (PJ/Ally). NPCs present: Polo (Chief Mechanic, incompetent/relaxed), Rocío (Second Officer, diligent and controlling), Thalis (Chief Mechanic). Location: Engineering Deck and Mess Hall (Ship Martin II). Ships mentioned: Martin II (Heavy Freighter). Scene Summary During their work shifts, the team attempts to advance the sabotage. Paloma hacks the logs to study Second Officer Rocío's patterns and armory security, discovering that the officer is very active and personally supervises repairs. Fomega investigates the vacuum suit lockers. Emilio uses his social skills to convince Polo to change work shifts, managing to get Paloma and himself on the same schedule to better coordinate their illegal actions. Aunt tries to approach Rocío without success. Mr. Wolf and the Pilot PJs present: Emilio (Nemo), Fomega. NPCs present: Pilot Henshaw (Coerced Mother), Jane (Liaison), Álvaro (Criminal Contact). Location: Discreet and noisy corner (Arunisiir Spaceport). Ships mentioned: Martin II, Iron Two's Ship (Mentioned as a threat). Scene Summary Nemo and Fomega meet with Pilot Henshaw. Nemo adopts the persona of "Sam Bigman" (a kind of "Mr. Wolf" who solves problems). They dismiss Henshaw's desperate plan to sabotage the engine by brute force and present her with a professional plan: to take the bridge and the ship in a coordinated manner. They pressure her by assuring her it's the only way to save her daughter from Iron Two/Aeron Tuss. They get Henshaw to agree to collaborate by facilitating access to the shuttle and cloning her access card, under the promise of rescuing her daughter afterward. The Reality Show Threat PJs present: Fermín, Jimmy. NPCs present: Film crew (Civilians/Media), Private security guards. Location: Edge of the forest near the ship's hiding place (Planet Arunisiir). Ships mentioned: Banshee (Hidden). Scene Summary Returning with the truck towards where the Banshee is hidden to bring supplies, Fermín and Jimmy stumble upon a van and a deployment team. They observe them unloading recording equipment and cameras, apparently to film a television show or reality show in the wilderness, right in the area where they have their pirate ship hidden, posing a critical and immediate security risk.

title: 25 - PoD - Treasure Ship 08
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format: Session Title: Filming, Business, and Imperial Secrets PCs Present: Sony (Juan), Fermín (Nacho), Nemo, Fomega, Paloma (Emilio), Tía (Juan). NPCs Present: Security Guard (Arunisiir), Krrsh, Wolf, Captain Bell, Salvedes (Marine), Gensho, Abra, Navigator Osha. Important Developments:    The film crew has been prevented from discovering the Banshee*, keeping the ship hidden and safe for now. A sale of precious metals worth approximately 1.2 million credits has been closed, injecting capital into the crew.    Critical information has been uncovered about an imperial convoy arriving in 20 days to escort the Martin II*. It has been revealed that Navigator Osha has a hidden interest in the vault of the "Black Cube." Loose Ends: The plan to ambush the marine Salvedes in a motel is in preparation but has not yet been executed; success is uncertain and Salvedes is suspicious of Fomega.    The exact contents of the "Black Cube" on the Martin II* remain a mystery, although it is known to bear an imperial seal.    The arrival of the convoy (Comino, Henry Ford, Sincerity*) imposes a deadline on current operations. Scene: The Intruder in the Forest PCs Present: Sony (Juan), Fermín (Nacho). NPCs Present: Security Guard (Woman around 50, local to Arunisiir, pragmatic), Krrsh (Crew member, anxious, heir pirate archetype). Location: Dense forest (Arunisiir/System). Ships: Banshee (PCs' Ship). Scene Summary: Sony and Fermín discover an imperial television film crew setting up dangerously close to where the Banshee is hidden. Sony approaches, posing as someone dangerous, and warns the security guard about supposed military operations and "people who don't want to be seen" in the forest. The guard, not wanting trouble for her salary, convinces the director to move the camp the next day. Sony plants hidden microphones (bugs) in the camp before leaving. Krrsh appears nervous and suggests moving the ship to orbit, but it is ultimately decided to leave it there under surveillance. Scene: Return to the City and Criminal Life PCs Present: Fermín (Nacho). NPCs Present: Wolf (Convicted criminal, childish but brutal mindset, loyal thug archetype). Location: Road to the city and City (Arunisiir/System). Ships: N/A. Scene Summary: Fermín drives the truck back to the city with Wolf as co-pilot. During the journey, Wolf speaks nostalgically about his life in various prisons (like an underwater prison in Blue), prison food, and violence, idealizing criminal life. Fermín treats Wolf with patience, almost like a child, and they spend the day together in the city enjoying rough activities (Monster Trucks) to keep Wolf's morale high. Scene: The Million-Credit Deal PCs Present: Nemo. NPCs Present: Captain Bell (Broker/Trader, interested in business), Fomega (mentioned). Location: Spaceport and Restaurants (Arunisiir/System). Ships: N/A. Scene Summary: Nemo manages the sale of the crew's cargo. He obtains medicine and drugs for Fomega and arranges an elegant dinner. After negotiations, and with the help of Captain Bell (who takes a commission), Nemo manages to sell 19 tons of precious metals at an excellent price (140%), obtaining a total of 1,263,500 credits. Scene: Espionage and Engineering on the Martin II PCs Present: Paloma (Emilio), Tía (Juan), Fomega. NPCs Present: Salvedes (Imperial Marine, suspicious, with bionic arm), Gensho (Gunner), Abra (Veteran crew member, wise), Navigator Osha (Alien/Blue modified with gills). Location: Hangar and common areas of the ship Martin II (Arunisiir/System). Ships: Martin II (Imperial Freighter), Gazelle (Escort in orbit), Comino (Gazelle, Unknown Captain), Henry Ford (Repair ship), Sincerity (Patrol corvette). Scene Summary: The PCs infiltrated into the crew of the Martin II take advantage of their shifts:    Paloma (Emilio): Hacks communications and discovers that an escort convoy will arrive in about 20 days. The convoy includes the Comino, the Henry Ford, and the Sincerity*. She also briefly examines the mysterious "Black Cube" in the hangar, noting its unnatural material and imperial seal.    Tía (Juan): Works in engineering and socializes with the crew, earning the trust of Abra and Gensho. Through a hidden microphone (bug*) later reviewed, Juan discovers that Navigator Osha secretly visits the "Black Cube" and examines it, which is highly suspicious. Fomega: Tries to extract information from Marine Salvedes about his personal life to plan an ambush. However, Fomega asks too many direct questions and raises Salvedes' suspicions, who checks his identity and leaves alerted. Scene: Planning the Ambush PCs Present: Nemo, Fermín (Nacho), Fomega, Emilio. NPCs Present: N/A. Location: City (Arunisiir/System). Ships: N/A. Scene Summary: The group meets (physically or telematically) to plan how to neutralize Marine Salvedes and extract information. They dismiss an attack in the street and decide to rent a seedy motel room to set a trap for him. The plan involves using Salvedes' companion (with whom he meets) as bait or intercepting him there. They discuss methods to subdue him (electricity, drugs, numerical superiority), aware that Salvedes is a dangerous combatant.

content: Chaos, Stimulants, and a Court Martial PCs present: Juan, Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio, Aunt (Rocío), Fomega (James/Álvaro). NPCs present: Captain Val (via message), Nacho, Wolf, Marijagad, Marine Salvedes, Captain of the Martin II, Purser (Logistics Officer). Important developments in the lives of the PCs or the campaign:    Aunt's expulsion: Aunt tries to win over Marijagad but ends up in a physical fight. Aunt is arrested and finally dismissed from the crew of the Martin II*, being removed from the infiltration. The Cargo Manifest: Paloma and Emilio manage to hack the computers and discover the contents of the vault: imperial diplomatic documents, luxury goods, pharmaceuticals, radioactive materials, and gems worth approximately 30 million credits (estimated total value of 90 million). The plan against Salvedes: The group decides to set a trap for the dangerous marine Salvedes by sending him an anonymous blackmail message to lure him off the ship for an ambush. Fomega's addiction: Tension grows between Nemo and Fomega over the excessive use of stimulants and combat drugs stolen from the group to endure double shifts. Loose ends: Encrypted messages: Paloma has found deleted and highly encrypted messages on the logistics officer's computer that have not yet been deciphered.    The jump drive: Fomega confirms that the Martin II*'s jump drive is destroyed and he is unable to repair it. Salvedes' reaction: The bait message has been sent, but it is unknown whether the marine will show up for the meeting or alert security, which could jeopardize the entire operation. Scene 1: Surveillance and Farewells PCs present: Nemo, Fermín, Paloma, Emilio. NPCs present: Captain Val (Independent Trader), Nacho (Driver/Henchman). Location(s): Spaceport / Surroundings of the docked ship (Unknown Planet), City. Ships mentioned: Hopeful Wanderer (Trader, Captain Val). Scene summary: The group splits up. While Fermín and Nacho look for a suitable ambush location in the city, Nemo watches the exterior of the Martin II with binoculars, waiting to see marine Salvedes emerge. Paloma begins hacking the ship's systems. Nemo receives a farewell message from Captain Val, who is leaving the system. Fermín finds a suitable spot for the ambush, while Juan gets drunk and gets a siren/Ophi tattoo in the city. Scene 2: The Diplomatic (and Physical) Incident PCs present: Aunt, Fomega. NPCs present: Marijagad (Antagonist Officer, "the scab"), Security Marines. Location(s): Cargo Deck / Brig (Ship Martin II). Scene summary: Aunt tries to smooth things over with officer Marijagad by mentioning their shared past and the boyfriend she "took" from her. The conversation goes terribly wrong and they end up in a fist and scratch fight. Marines intervene, and Aunt is dragged to the brig. Fomega uses the chaos to try to get a blood sample (DNA) from Marijagad to clone her biometric access, but fails, obtaining a contaminated and mixed sample. Scene 3: Road to Hell and Drugs PCs present: Nemo, Juan, Fermín, Fomega (mentioned). NPCs present: Wolf (Henchman), Nacho (Terrible Driver). Location(s): Night road to the base / The Ship Banshee. Ships mentioned: Banshee (PC ship). Scene summary: Fermín, Juan, Wolf, and Nemo return to their base ship (Banshee) hidden in the woods. The journey is a disaster due to bad driving and darkness, losing a lot of time. Upon arrival, or while discussing the situation, Nemo confronts Fomega (who is working double shifts on the infiltrated ship) for stealing and abusing "Alvarito's" combat drugs and stimulants. Nemo confiscates the drugs and threatens him, although Fomega insists he needs them to work. Scene 4: Advocacy and Productive Hacking PCs present: Emilio, Paloma, Fomega. NPCs present: Captain of the Martin II (Elderly, distant, seemingly incompetent or disinterested), Logistics Officer (Purser). Location(s): Command Bridge / Engineering Deck (Ship Martin II). Scene summary: Emilio requests an audience with the Captain to intercede for Aunt. Using his legal knowledge, he argues that it was a personal dispute and that Aunt is needed for repairs. The Captain agrees not to imprison her but dismisses her and expels her from the ship. Meanwhile, Paloma succeeds in hacking the logistics officer's computer, obtaining the full cargo manifest from the vault and finding suspicious encrypted communications. Fomega examines the jump drive and determines that repair is beyond his capabilities. Scene 5: The Ultimatum PCs present: All (group discussion). NPCs present: Marine Salvedes (Target). Location(s): Operations Base / Ship Martin II. Scene summary: The group debates frustratedly about the constant change of plans. Finally, they agree that the priority is to eliminate marine Salvedes before attempting to take the ship, as his combat armor (Battle Dress) is an insurmountable threat. They decide to send him an anonymous message to his personal terminal blackmailing him: "We know what you're doing. Bring 20,000 credits to [Ambush Location] or we'll tell the captain." The goal is to lure him off the ship to ambush him at the site Fermín located.

content: Ambush in the Graveyard and Secrets of the Martin II PCs present Nemo (Captain / Tactical Leader) Fermín (Played by Nacho, muscle of the group) Pika (Played by Emilio, scientist/infiltrated hacker) Álvaro (Played by Fomega, infiltrated medic/geneticist) Jimmy (Sniper, controlled by the group in his player's absence) Paloma (Hacker, mentioned performing actions on the ship) NPCs present Salvedes (Imperial Marine, expert in close combat, tough and dangerous. Archetype: The relentless enforcer) Wolf (Crew member/Cook, found dead. Archetype: The innocent victim) The Astrogator "Blue" (Officer of the Martin II, blue skin, gills, webbed fingers. Archetype: The mysterious officer) Captain Torso (Mentioned in emails, incompetent and whiny. Archetype: The inept leader) Tía, Krish, Arpad (Crew of the Banshee) Plot Development and Reconstruction of the Drinax Kingdom Elimination of a direct threat: The imperial marine Salvedes has been ambushed and eliminated, reducing the combat capability of the enemy ship. Intelligence gathering: Personal communications of Captain Torso have been accessed, revealing his incompetence and dissatisfaction with the crew. Strategic repositioning: The players' ship, the Banshee, has been moved to orbit to avoid terrestrial detection and prepare for the assault. Loose Ends Salvedes' disappearance has been noted on the Martin II, and an investigation with local authorities has been initiated. The decryption of the purser/astrogator's data is in progress and will take 6 days, coinciding with the convoy's arrival. The funeral or final disposition of Wolf's body is pending after being brought aboard the ship. The Astrogator Blue showed nervousness when discussing the jump chamber; they suspect she is hiding something. The Cemetery Trap PCs present: Nemo, Fermín, Jimmy. NPCs present: Salvedes (Imperial Marine, aggressive, martial arts expert), Wolf (Corpse with a broken neck). Location: Abandoned cemetery (Planet Arunisiir). Ships: None. Scene Summary: The group sets an ambush for Salvedes in an abandoned industrial cemetery filled with niches and a hermitage. Upon positioning themselves, they discover the corpse of their companion Wolf with a broken neck; Salvedes was already there. The marine throws a smoke grenade and attacks Fermín. A brutal hand-to-hand combat ensues where Salvedes disarms and immobilizes Fermín, attempting to stab him. Jimmy fires his Gauss Rifle, grazing Fermín, and finally Nemo, using his grav-belt to gain height, fires his laser rifle and takes down Salvedes, leaving him mortally wounded before being finished off. Forensic Cleanup PCs present: Nemo, Fermín, Álvaro, Jimmy. NPCs present: None alive. Location: Abandoned cemetery and a ruined industrial ship (Planet Arunisiir). Ships: Terrestrial van. Scene Summary: After the combat, the group decides to leave no trace. They strip Salvedes' corpse of all equipment (Imperial laser rifle, body pistol, armor, knife). Álvaro and Fermín handle the "cleanup": they extract an eye and a finger from the marine for potential future biometric uses. Subsequently, they move the body to an isolated area where they dismember and burn it using quicklime and fuel to prevent genetic identification, disposing of the remains and unwanted equipment in different locations. Infiltration and Gossip PCs present: Pika, Álvaro (Mentioned). NPCs present: The Astrogator "Blue" (Modified human female from the planet Dolberg, Sindal sector. She has blue skin, layers of fat, and gills). Location: Mess hall and barracks of the Martin II (Imperial Ship). Ships: Martin II (Imperial Freighter, Captain Torso). Scene Summary: Inside the Martin II, Pika tries to extract information from the Astrogator. She discovers that she is from Dolberg (an aquatic world), that she worked in the merchant navy, and that she becomes nervous when talking about astrogation and the jump chamber. In parallel, Paloma hacks Captain Torso's computer. His emails reveal that he is an incompetent from a good family (Pax Rulin) who despises his crew (especially officer María Gad) and complains to his mother that "they don't make marines like they used to." Change of Position PCs present: Nemo, Fermín, Pika (via communication), Álvaro. NPCs present: Tía, Krish. Location: Camp on land and Orbit of Arunisiir. Ships: Banshee (Light Destroyer, PCs), Martin II. Scene Summary: The group decides that the Banshee is vulnerable on the ground. They order Tía and the NPC crew (taking Wolf's body) to take the ship to orbit and maintain radio silence, activating stealth to make scanning difficult. Pika establishes an encrypted and brief communication protocol to maintain contact between the ground team and the ship. They prepare to wait for the remaining 6 days until the convoy arrives, while on the Martin II suspicions begin to arise due to Salvedes' absence.

title: 29 - PoD - Treasure Ship 12
content: Session Title: The Great Heist: The Capture of the Martin II Player Characters Present: Nemo: Captain and leader of the group. Paloma: Hacker and pilot. Jimmy: Marine and in charge of security/interrogations. Emilio (Pika): Astrogator and medic. Fermín: Close combat fighter (brawler). Fomega (Juan/Alvarito): Engineer and medic. Non-Player Characters Present:    Captain Torsa: Imperial Captain of the Martin II*. Arrogant, loyal to the Empire, despises pirates.    Mariagat (Lady Mariel?): Second-in-command of the Martin II*. Competent, described as a "Mary Sue" (perfect), severely wounded by Nemo. Chris (Krrsh): Aslan pirate, ally of the PCs. Fierce and loyal. Henshaw: Pilot deceived by the PCs, believes they are going to Exe.    Osha: Astrogator of the Martin II*, blackmailed due to her genetics. Purser Boggan: Logistics officer, corrupt and a forger. Marine Commander Hark: Combat cyborg, in charge of security. Crewman Ealing: Carefree mechanic. Major Developments in the PCs' Lives or the Campaign: The PCs have succeeded in capturing the Martin II, an imperial treasure ship, fulfilling a major objective to obtain resources and glory (and potentially for King Oleb XVI). They have recovered the treasure of Drinax that was in the hold (previously stolen merchandise). A high-level political conspiracy has been discovered: a fake, imperially sealed treaty designed to provoke a war between the Empire and the Aslan by ceding border territories. Loose Ends: The fate of the prisoners: The group debates whether to execute them to leave no witnesses (suggested by Jimmy) or keep them alive (Nemo and Fomega). Mariagat has survived thanks to Fomega's surgery. The mysterious device: Osha installed a strange device on the navigation console on orders from third parties, whose exact purpose is unknown, except that it collects data and was to be delivered to Tech-World. Henshaw: Still believes they are going to Exe, but the ship has jumped to Blue. Her reaction upon discovering the deception is pending. Pursuit: Escort ships (Gazelles) attacked during the jump; it is unknown if they can track the jump to Blue. Scene 1: Infiltration and Silence PCs Present: Nemo, Paloma, Jimmy, Emilio, Fermín, Fomega. NPCs Present: Henshaw (Pilot), Chris (Aslan Pirate). Location: Shuttle / Engine Room of the Martin II (The World System). Ships: Shuttle (Docked), Martin II (Imperial Treasure Ship). Scene Summary: The group prepares to board the Martin II from their shuttle. Nemo gives a motivating speech promising glory and riches, appealing to loyalty to Drinax (or greed). Paloma performs intensive cyberattacks (hacking) for hours to control cameras and doors, gaining access. The group divides: a stealth team advances first. They have trouble with some doors requiring access cards, so they take the card from pilot Henshaw. They move through the engine room, avoiding being seen by the crew working on the engines, and manage to outsmart a distracted marine guard and the mechanic Ealing by hiding in the ceiling and behind machinery. Scene 2: Chaos on the Command Bridge PCs Present: Nemo, Paloma, Jimmy, Emilio, Fermín, Fomega. NPCs Present: Captain Torsa, Mariagat (Imperial Officer), Marine Commander Hark (Cyborg), Officer Smith, Chris (Aslan Pirate). Location: Command Bridge and Corridors of the Martin II (The World System). Ships: Martin II. Scene Summary: Just as the group positions themselves to assault the bridge and armory, the general attack alarm sounds. Paloma forces the bridge door, revealing the crew arming themselves. Commander Hark (a cyborg) attacks Fermín in close combat. A firefight erupts: Paloma throws an EMP grenade that temporarily disables electronics (including the PCs' suits and the cyborg's arm). Fermín and the group take down the cyborg. Nemo shoots Mariagat (who was trying to arm the captain) with a laser pistol, leaving her severely wounded. Chris and Fomega secure the rear, eliminating a marine exiting an elevator. Jimmy intimidates Captain Torsa by aiming a shotgun at him, achieving the surrender of the ship due to the attackers' tactical superiority. Scene 3: Jump Under Fire PCs Present: Nemo, Paloma, Jimmy, Emilio, Fermín, Fomega. NPCs Present: Captain Torsa. Location: Command Bridge of the Martin II / Space (The World System). Ships: Martin II, Banshee (Harrier, PCs' escort), Imperial Gazelles (Enemy escort ships). Scene Summary: With the bridge taken, the group realizes that two imperial escort ships (Gazelle class) are attacking. One pursues the Banshee and the other fires on the Martin II. Paloma takes the helm, attempting to dodge enemy fire while Emilio makes hasty astrogation calculations under pressure. Fomega runs to engineering to manage the jump drive, where the original crew suffers from radiation. Despite damage to sensors and the hull, they manage to coordinate the jump to hyperspace just in time, leaving the imperial ships behind and heading for the Blue system. Scene 4: Secrets and Scalpel in Hyperspace PCs Present: Nemo, Paloma, Jimmy, Emilio, Fomega. NPCs Present: Osha (Astrogator), Purser Boggan (Logistics), Mariagat (Wounded), Captain Torsa. Location: Interior of the Martin II (Hyperspace, en route to Blue). Ships: Martin II. Scene Summary: During the week-long jump, the group manages the prisoners. Fomega performs emergency surgery on Mariagat, saving her life (and morbidly joking about stealing a kidney), hoping to use her as a bargaining chip or out of respect for her competence. Jimmy and Nemo interrogate key crew members. They discover that Osha was bribed to install a data collection device on the navigation. More seriously, through torture/intimidation of Officer Boggan, they discover a forged document with high-tech imperial seals: a fake treaty designed to allow the Aslan to conquer border sectors, which would provoke total war. The group debates the ethics of eliminating the entire crew to cover their tracks or keeping them as hostages.

title: 30 - PoD - Treasure Ship - Epilogo
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. The Imperial Loot and the Return to Drinax PCs present: Captain James Ondo / Nemo Emilio (Scholar/Astrographer) Paloma (Pilot) Rocío (Engineer) Jimmy (Marine/Spy - Retires at the end of the session) Fermín (Marine/Bodyguard) Pika (Diplomat/Noble) NPCs present: Chris (Vargr, loyal and enthusiastic crew member). Alfomega (Engineer/Astrographer of the Martin II). Admiral Lord Drax (Commander of the Drinax Star Guard). King Oleb XVI (King of Drinax). Prince Harrik (Son of the King, intellectual and measured). Princess Rao's Servant (Messenger). Scholars of the Drinax Tower (Mentioned). Campaign Development:    The group successfully brings the imperial treasure ship Martin II* to Drinax, completing a major coup against the Empire. The alliance with King Oleb is consolidated after presenting him with the loot.    It is decided to donate the hull of the Martin II* to Lord Drax's fleet to gain political favor and avoid repair costs, with the PCs keeping the cargo and the contents of the vault. Jimmy leaves the active crew to establish an intelligence network and infrastructure on Drinax. Loose Ends: The Vault: The scholars of the Tower need a month to decrypt the code and open it.    The Prisoners: The cargo hold of the Martin II* is full of imperial prisoners and crew. What to do with them has not been decided (release them in another system or demand ransom). Rao's Message: Princess Rao will return in two months, and her servant indicates she has extremely urgent information. Aslan Document: There is a document (possibly false) about a treaty between the Empire and the Aslans to divide the sector, which needs to be verified. Loot Sale: Time is needed to liquidate the generic cargo on Drinax or neighboring worlds. Scene 1: Tension in the Blue System PCs present: All. NPCs present: Alfomega (Engineer assisting with the engines). Location: Gas Giant and deep space (Blue System). Ships: Martin II (Imperial Treasure Ship, Captained by James Ondo/Paloma), Banshee (Harrier, Captained by Paloma/Emilio). Summary: After capturing the Martin II, the group arrives in the Blue system. While attempting to repair critical damage to the Martin II's turret, Rocío discovers they lack the correct parts due to the technological difference. They undertake a risky refueling maneuver at the gas giant; Paloma pilots the Banshee and helps coordinate the Martin II, successfully refueling both ships without initial detection. However, they detect a system defense ship approaching on an intercept course. After an intense debate about whether to jump to empty space (coordinate 2222) or risk a direct jump with the Martin II's damaged jump drive, they decide to split up. The Martin II will jump directly to Drinax (risking the engine), and the Banshee will take a safe route via Torpol. Scene 2: The Jump and the Arrival PCs present: All (divided between two ships). NPCs present: Chris (Vargr). Location: Jump space, Torpol System, and Drinax System. Ships: Martin II, Banshee. Summary: The Martin II manages to reach Drinax, but the jump drive breaks down irreparably upon arrival, leaving them stranded at the system's edge. Meanwhile, the Banshee refuels in Torpol without incident and arrives at Drinax a week later. James Ondo takes the Martin II's shuttle to proceed ahead to the Floating Palace. He contacts Admiral Lord Drax, requesting a discreet docking and an urgent audience with the King, hinting that they bring something "bigger than the King's prick." Drax, intrigued and serious, arranges for a Star Guard escort to take them secretly to the palace. Scene 3: Audience with King Oleb PCs present: Captain Ondo, Chris (the "dog"). NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (The Hedonistic King, exuberant and vulgar), Admiral Lord Drax (The Loyal Military Man, stoic). Location: Floating Palace (Drinax Planet). Summary: Ondo finds King Oleb watching a water polo match and scratching his groin. After the bows, Ondo reveals they have stolen an entire imperial treasure ship, complete with crew and cargo. The news causes the King's immediate euphoria, and he demands his Battle Dress to personally inspect the prize. Drax appears skeptical but impressed. Scene 4: Inspection and Celebration PCs present: All (reunited after the Banshee's arrival). NPCs present: King Oleb XVI, Lord Drax, Prince Harrik (The Rebuilt Intellectual, serious and political). Location: Hangar and Officers' Mess of the Martin II / Floating Palace (Drinax Planet). Ships: Martin II. Summary: The King and Drax inspect the ship. Oleb becomes excited by the treasure vault, even striking it in frustration at not being able to open it. During the celebration dinner, the group discusses what to do with the ship. Given that Drinax lacks shipyards capable of maintaining a ship of that tonnage and the engine is broken, they decide to gift the hull of the Martin II to Lord Drax for system defense, with the PCs keeping the contents. Later, they have a private meeting with Prince Harrik. Unlike his father, Harrik is measured and pragmatic. Pika informs him about the document found suggesting a pact between the Empire and the Aslans. Harrik advocates for the industrial and commercial development of Drinax rather than the aggressive military conquest preferred by his sister, Princess Rao. Scene 5: Farewells and Future Plans PCs present: Jimmy, James Ondo, Pika, Emilio. NPCs present: Princess Rao's Servant. Location: Drinax. Summary: A messenger from Princess Rao informs them that she will return in two months and has vital information. Jimmy announces his retirement from the active crew of the Banshee to focus on building an intelligence network on the ground, introducing a replacement (a marine). Emilio coordinates with the scholars of the Tower on opening the vault, which will take approximately one month. The group prepares for a period of rest ("vacation") and selling merchandise while awaiting the vault's opening and the Princess's return.

content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and restrictions: Logistics, Politics, and the Fate of the Prisoners PCs present: Nemo (Captain), Paloma, Emilio, Jimmy, Fermín, Goran, Tia. NPCs present: Lord Rax (Admiral/Noble), Sal Dancet (Smuggler/Ally), Lady Hil (Noble), Krrsh ( Referred to as Chris/Kursk, Vargr crewman), Dr. Yudita (Doctor/Cyberneticist), Consul Tal Pogue (Imperial Consul). Main developments in the PCs' lives or campaign objective:    Enormous profits (tens of millions of credits) are obtained from the sale of the Martin II's cargo and the opening of its vault, securing funds for the Banshee*'s maintenance and the crew's personal enrichment. Nemo establishes political contact with Lady Hil, who suggests possible alliances in Clarke and Torpol to restore the glory of Drinax.    The trail of the Martin II* theft is erased by disposing of the prisoner crew through a deal with Sal Dancet.    Investigations are conducted on Tech-World and Byrni to try and advance events regarding the Martin II* conspiracy, albeit with limited results. Loose ends:    The whereabouts of Aparo, the man who rented the office on Tech-World and appears to be linked to the Martin II* plot.    Krrsh's (Chris) desire to go to Torpol to recover his ship, the Sarcomand*, which could generate future conflicts if he decides to act on his own. The imminent arrival of a Sindalian archaeology expert from the University of Regina, mentioned by the Imperial Consul. Imperial diplomatic and commercial documents found in the vault that have not yet been processed or sold. Logistical and Ethical Dilemmas PCs present: Nemo, Paloma, Emilio, Jimmy, Fermín, Goran, Tia. NPCs present: Lord Rax (Noble of Drinax, social superior, pragmatic). Location: Floating Palace and Spaceport (Drinax). Ships mentioned: Banshee (Heavy bomber fighters, Captain Nemo), Martin II (Captured freighter). Scene summary: The crew intensely debates what supplies and repairs the Banshee needs. Lord Rax informs them that the King does not want to take responsibility for the nearly 30 prisoners from the Martin II's crew and demands they be disposed of. Moral and practical options are discussed: executing them, selling them as slaves, or releasing them. Finally, they decide to freeze them in "fridges" (cryogenic pods) and find a way to abandon them far away to buy time before news of the theft spreads. The Art of Trade PCs present: Paloma, Nemo (supervising). NPCs present: Local merchants. Location: Markets and Spaceport (Drinax). Ships mentioned: N/A. Scene summary: Paloma takes charge of liquidating the Martin II's cargo. She sells common and uncommon minerals, spices, and advanced manufactured goods. Thanks to her Broker skills, she achieves excellent prices (up to 130% of base value), raising millions of credits for the crew. Certain advanced electronic components are reserved for the Banshee's repairs. Pact with the Smuggler PCs present: Nemo, Paloma, Emilio (implied in management). NPCs present: Sal Dancet (Smuggler/Trader, potential ally, pragmatic). Location: Drinax. Ships mentioned: Sal Dancet's ship (Free Trader). Scene summary: The group contacts Sal Dancet, who has just arrived in port. Nemo and Paloma negotiate with her to transport the frozen prisoners and abandon them in a remote location (possibly Hilfer) to prevent them from testifying. Sal Dancet accepts the risk in exchange for a portion of the Martin II's loot and future discounts on merchandise, thereby implicating herself in the pirate conspiracy. The Group Divides: Tech-World and Byrni PCs present: Fermín, Goran, Tia (Tech-World Team); Jimmy (Byrni Team). NPCs present: Commercial transport crews. Location: Tech-World and Byrni. Ships mentioned: Commercial passenger freighters. Scene summary: The group divides to investigate during the weeks of inactivity: Tech-World: Fermín, Goran, and Tia travel as passengers. They investigate an address linked to the stolen navigation data. They discover that the premises were rented by a shell company ("CP Computing") created by an individual named Aparo (a merchant previously seen in Arunisiir). The office is empty and the company dissolved.    Byrni: Jimmy travels to this system. He finds a "fossilized" society loyal to the old Sindal Empire, with knightly orders and a strong naval presence, but finds no concrete clues about the Martin II*'s original crew or the conspiracy. Cybernetic Enhancements and Court Politics PCs present: Nemo, Paloma. NPCs present: Dr. Yudita (Doctor with a rigor mortis grimace and perpetual smile, surrounded by octopus-like robots), Lady Hil (Noble, dressed in holographic projections of sea waves, enigmatic and manipulative). Location: Dr. Yudita's Clinic and Royal Court (Drinax). Ships mentioned: N/A. Scene summary: Several crew members, including Nemo and Paloma, visit Dr. Yudita to install cybernetic implants and genetic enhancements. Later, at court, Nemo has a private conversation with Lady Hil. She criticizes Prince Harrik, deeming him "broken," and advises Nemo to seek funding and influence on the planets Clarke (ancient ruins) or Torpol (tourist and financial paradise) to restore Drinax's glory, warning him not to forget who he is. The Consul and the Vault PCs present: Emilio, Paloma, Nemo. NPCs present: Imperial Consul Tal Pogue (Admirer of Sindalian architecture), Krrsh (Vargr crewman, impatient). Location: Banshee's Hangar and Scholars' Tower (Drinax). Ships mentioned: Banshee, Sarcomand (Krrsh's lost ship). Scene summary: Imperial Consul Tal Pogue approaches to admire the Banshee and comments on the upcoming arrival of an archaeology expert from the University of Regina. In parallel, scholars manage to open the Martin II's vault. Inside, they find encrypted mail, Imperial diplomatic documents, luxury items, radioactive materials, and gems worth tens of millions. The final division of the loot takes place. Krrsh expresses his desire to go to Torpol to ambush the current captain of his former ship, the Sarcomand, and recover it, though Nemo asks for patience until receiving orders from Princess Rao.
