content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Palatial Intrigues and the Iatei Threat PCs present: Hondo (Captain) Honor (Pilot/Broker) Pika (Sensors/Scientist) Goran Dragic (Soldier/Engineer) Fomega (Medic/Engineer) Fermín (Soldier) Nemo (Hacker/Computers) NPCs present: Princess Rao (Heir to the throne of Drinax, pragmatic, demanding, and strategic). Jefa Drax (Leader of the Vespexers, distrustful of "renegades", tough trader). Cera (Allied merchant, wife of an Aslan noble). Cera's Aslan Husband (Hologram, noble concerned about his missing son). Arpa (Harrier crew, attentive to sensors). Chris (Harrier crew, cynical and direct). Rocío (Harrier crew, gunner). Nax (Ship's Artificial Intelligence). Important developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: Hierarchy Restructuring: Captain Hondo abolishes official military ranks on the ship to adopt a more egalitarian pirate/privateer structure (Captain and First Mate), seeking to improve morale and cohesion.    New Mission: Princess Rao tasks the group with stopping the formation of an Iatei* invasion fleet (landless Aslan second sons) gathering on planet Kteiroa with the intention of attacking Drinax.    Ship Upgrades: A medical bay is installed on the Banshee*, sacrificing cabin space, and general repairs are carried out. Loose ends: The Fake Treaty: It is confirmed that the treaty found on the treasure ship (which proposed reducing the non-aggression zone between the Empire and the Hieratic) is a forgery or a conspiracy by an imperial faction, which could trigger a war. The Missing Son: Cera's Aslan husband requests information about his second son, whose ship was shot down in the T-Bus (or Thebus) system.    The Ceremonial Axe (Yuhai*): An Aslan axe is recovered from the wreckage of the scout ship, which could identify the specific clan behind the threat, but it has not yet been thoroughly analyzed. Scene 1: Logistics and Reforms PCs present: Hondo, Fomega, Goran, Pika, Honor, Nemo. NPCs present: N/A Location: Hangar / Ship Interior (Planet Drinax) Ships: Banshee (Harrier Model, Captain Hondo) Summary: The group intensely debates modifications to the Banshee. Fomega insists on the installation of a complete infirmary, arguing that as pirates, there will be wounded. Despite concerns about weight and lost cabin space (an officer's cabin is removed to make room), Captain Hondo approves the installation. Hondo takes the opportunity to announce a change in crew philosophy: they will cease using navy ranks to operate under a pirate code, with only a Captain and a First Mate (Honor), equalizing the rest of the crew. Remaining cabins are assigned. Scene 2: Encounters in the Bazaar and Hospital PCs present: Honor, Fomega, Hondo, Nemo. NPCs present: Jefa Drax (Vespexer Leader), Cera (Merchant), Cera's Aslan Husband (Hologram). Location: The Bazaar and Hospital of the Floating Palace (Planet Drinax). Ships: N/A Summary: During the repair period (approx. 2 months), the characters conduct personal errands. Honor attempts to curry favor with Jefa Drax by assisting her in a negotiation for environmental suits. Although she secures a better price, Drax remains suspicious of a "renegade's" influence but gifts her a suit as payment. Fomega seeks combat drugs, planning a trip to Tech-World to acquire them, and parades with her hero medal. Hondo acquires advanced software and a holographic projector. He unsuccessfully searches for extra crew members.    Nemo, while recovering from an implant surgery (wafer jack*), receives a call from Cera's Aslan husband. He informs Nemo that his second son has disappeared in T-Bus and requests that they find his whereabouts. Scene 3: The Audience with the Princess PCs present: All (Hondo, Pika, Goran, Fomega, Fermín, Honor, Nemo). NPCs present: Princess Rao (Severe Aristocrat), Falcon Guards. Location: A room under construction in the Floating Palace (Planet Drinax). Ships: N/A Summary: Princess Rao summons the crew. She coolly assesses their performance over the past six months; while praising the theft of the treasure ship and the acquisition of the fake treaty, she criticates their inefficiency and greed for spending too much time repairing and "blinging out" instead of being in space gaining influence. Rao reveals an imminent threat: hundreds of Aslan ships are gathering on Kteiroa. They are Iatei (landless second sons) preparing for an invasion, and Drinax is a likely target. She orders them to stop this fleet. They also briefly discuss Prince Harrik and his status on Clarke. Scene 4: Emergency Interception PCs present: All. NPCs present: Arpa (Observer), Nax (AI). Location: Floating Palace and Low Orbit (Planet Drinax). Ships: Banshee (Harrier Model), Aslan Scout Ship (Scout 100ton, Jump-4). Summary: The meeting is interrupted when Arpa detects a hidden ship on the surface of Drinax that has just taken off, presumably a spy that has been monitoring the Palace. The crew rushes to the Banshee, which is still undergoing partial repairs. With the help of the AI Nax, they manage to quickly power up the engines and pursue through Drinax's stormy atmosphere. They identify the enemy ship as a small Aslan Scout with Jump-4 capability. Scene 5: Combat and Impact Zone PCs present: All. NPCs present: Rocío (Gunner), Chris (Crew). Location: Orbit and Surface of Drinax. Ships: Banshee (Harrier Model), Aslan Scout Ship (Destroyed). Summary: A chase ensues. The Aslan ship attempts to flee and evade, but the Banshee is faster. Hondo orders shots fired at the jump engines to prevent its escape. After an exchange of fire, a critical hit from the Banshee's particles causes the enemy ship to lose control and crash violently onto the surface of Drinax. The crew lands to investigate the wreckage. They find the charred bodies of two Aslan and recover a ceremonial axe (Yuhai). The scene ends with tension between Fomega and Goran ("the new guy"), with Chris intervening to prevent a physical altercation between crewmates.

title: 33 - PoD - Iatehi! 01
content: Aslan Protocol in Kteiroa PCs present: Ondo, Paloma, Jay, Goran, Nemo, Fermín. NPCs present: Khashil (Aslan Exile), Chief Grax (Vespexer Leader), Krrsh (Lizard Ally), Utea (Spaceport Matriarch), Princess Rao's Butler (via communicator). Important campaign developments:    The group has successfully recruited an Aslan guide, Khashil, to infiltrate the planet Kteiroa and ascertain the intentions of the Ihatei* fleet gathering there. It is confirmed that Aslan scout ships have been operating in the Drinax system, suggesting a potential imminent invasion or at least aggressive reconnaissance, putting the Kingdom's defenses on alert. Loose ends: The disappearance of four members of the Vespexer clans in Drinax, coinciding with the sighting of Aslan ships. It is unknown if they are dead or captured. Krrsh's solo mission on Torpol to steal a ship and his eventual return. An armed Aslan cargo ship that was sighted in Drinax but whose current whereabouts are unknown. Fermín's pending meeting with Jimmy and Chris. Scene 1: The Audience with the Exile PCs present: Ondo, Paloma, Jay, Goran, Nemo. NPCs present: Khashil (Aslan male nearly 3 meters tall, noble exile, gruff but honorable; Archetype: The Fallen Warrior). Location: Balcony of the Floating Palace (Drinax). Ships: None. Scene summary: After a brief discussion about medical supplies and combat drugs, the group seeks out Khashil, Princess Rao's recommended contact. They find him on a palace balcony living in a high-tech tent and eating raw meat. Ondo attempts to be diplomatic and shows him the recovered Yuhai axe. Khashil identifies the weapon as an honor bestowed upon servants but does not recognize the specific clan, confirming it originates from Kteiroa. Khashil agrees to guide them to the planet Kteiroa in exchange for a future favor. He warns that he is a fugitive wanted by assassins in the Hierate and suggests the group pose as mechanics looking for work to infiltrate the Ihatei (landless second sons). Scene 2: Logistics and Farewells PCs present: Ondo, Paloma, Jay, Goran, Fermín. NPCs present: Krrsh (Ally, aggressive but loyal to his "family"; Archetype: The Reckless Comrade). Location: Floating Palace Hangar (Drinax) and an asteroid in the system. Ships: The Banshee (Harrier, Captain Ondo). Scene summary: The group debates how to travel to Kteiroa: use the holographically disguised Banshee or Khashil's ship. They decide to use Khashil's ship to maintain a low profile, leaving the Banshee hidden and secured. They say goodbye to Krrsh, who departs for Torpol with a risky plan to steal a ship and retrieve it for the fleet. Jay has an emotional farewell with him. They decide that the PCs will go as mechanics, taking only essential equipment and concealing their true identities and firepower. Scene 3: Shadows over Drinax PCs present: Paloma. NPCs present: Chief Grax (Vespexer Leader, worried and direct; Archetype: The Veteran Scout), Rao's Butler (Voice on communicator). Location: Spaceport (Drinax). Ships: Aslan scout ships and armed freighter (mentioned in reports). Scene summary: As they prepare for the journey, Chief Grax approaches Paloma. She reports that four Vespexers have disappeared in the same area where three unknown Aslan ships (two scouts and an armed freighter) were sighted weeks ago. Grax fears they have been captured or killed. Paloma relays this critical intelligence to Princess Rao's butler, urging Lord Drax and the Star Guard to increase defensive alerts in anticipation of a possible infiltration or precursor invasion. Scene 4: Protocol and Culture in Hyperspace PCs present: All. NPCs present: Khashil. Location: Khashil's ship (Hyperspace). Ships: Khashil's ship (Ktiyui model Courier, Captain Khashil). Scene summary: The group boards Khashil's ship, hidden on an asteroid. It is a luxurious vessel, though strange for human physiology. During the week-long journey in hyperspace, Khashil instructs the group on the situation on Kteiroa (thousands of Ihatei warriors gathered) and Aslan culture. He advises them to be submissive, avoid duels (which are typically clawed), and understand that the troop buildup could be due to a charismatic leader or manipulations by larger clans. The objective is to identify if any leader plans to attack Drinax. Scene 5: Landing on the Ice PCs present: All. NPCs present: Utea (Elderly Aslan, fur coat, pragmatic; Archetype: The Renegade Merchant). Location: Spaceport (Kteiroa/Kteiroa System). Ships: Khashil's ship. Scene summary: They arrive in the Kteiroa system, a place with a greenish star and an icy planet that was formerly Piper (bombed by the Empire until it became a radioactive crater). They land at the underground spaceport controlled by a family of Aslan renegades. They are met by Utea, the port matriarch, who charges for docking and warns about the rules. The atmosphere is frontier-like and deals are shady. The group prepares to walk 5 kilometers across the ice towards the Ihatei camp to the north, maintaining their cover story of being human mechanics seeking work.

title: 34 - PoD - Iatehi! 02
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Castilian Spanish. The Ihatei Assembly in Kteiroa PCs present Nemo: Captain/Diplomat. Poses as the leader of a group of mechanics. Paloma: Communications Officer/Intelligence. Seeks information and merchandise. Goran: Artist and technician. Fermín: Engineer/Researcher. Pika: Crew member (mentioned). Álvarito and Rocío: Crew members (allied NPCs, medic and mechanic). NPCs present Kakh'syl / Kasiil (Renegade Aslan, guide and interpreter for the group. Lives in Drinax). Utea (Female Aslan, spaceport administrator of Kteiroa. Pragmatic renegade). Tiau (Elderly Aslan, agent of the Council of Clans. Archetype: The Diplomat/Observer). Ziuq (Aslan, broker and merchant. Archetype: The Mobster/Fixer). Eihei "The Wise" (Ihatei leader of the Tiquisto clan. Archetype: The Calculating Strategist). Old Elion (Ihatei leader without a clan. Archetype: The Veteran Warrior). Tojio (Young and wealthy Aslan from the Hekaher clan. Archetype: The "Influencer" seeking glory). Ikki (Ihatei leader of the losing clan Tlaiowaha/Itoguau. Archetype: The Desperate One). Campaign Development    The PCs discover the reason for the massive influx of Ihatei* (landless second sons) into the area: a limited ritual war between the Hekaher and Itoguau (Tlaiowaha) clans is ending prematurely after 9 years, causing a massive exodus of victorious and defeated warriors towards the Trojan Arm. They identify the main leaders and their intentions: Elion wants to attack the heavily defended planet Pahal, while Eihei plans a systematic conquest of the sector, which is a direct threat to the plans to rebuild the Kingdom of Drinax. Loose Ends The group needs to secure an audience with Ziuq to get work and insider information; for this, Goran is painting a picture valued at 10,000 credits as a gift. There is suspicion that the end of the clan war is due to "foul play" or cheating. If the PCs manage to prove it, it could destabilize the alliance and buy time. A dangerous alliance has formed between Eihei (the strategist) and Ikki (the leader of the desperate reinforcements), increasing the threat to the region. Scene 1: Arrival at the Tundra PCs present: Nemo, Paloma, Goran, Fermín, Pika. NPCs present: Kakh'syl (Aslan Guide), Utea (Port Administrator). Location: Utea's Spaceport (Planet Kteiroa). Ships: Courier class Katyuhi (Kakh'syl's Ship). Scene Summary The group lands on the frozen, dark world of Kteiroa. Kakh'syl briefs them: there are over 5,000 gathered Aslan Ihatei, something unusual caused by changes in the Hierate. They meet Utea, the port administrator, who suggests they pose as mechanics to remain unnoticed and earn a living. Utea recommends they speak with Ziuq (a broker) or Tiau (an agent of the clans) to understand the camp's politics. They decide to use Kakh'syl's ship to move towards the main camp for secure communications. Scene 2: First Contact and Clan Politics PCs present: Nemo, Paloma, Goran, Fermín, Pika. NPCs present: Tiau (Clan Agent, serious diplomat), Ziuq's Guards. Location: Ihatei Camp (Planet Kteiroa). Ships: Several Aslan ships half-buried in the snow. Scene Summary Upon arriving at the massive and chaotic camp, they attempt to speak with the broker Ziuq, but are rejected by his guards for not bringing an appropriate gift, considered a breach of etiquette. However, they are intercepted and brought before Tiau, the agent of the clans. Tiau, an elderly diplomat, warns them about the instability of the situation and informs them about the two main leaders: Eihei "The Wise" (the richest and most dangerous) and Old Elion. Tiau advises them not to interfere in Aslan politics so as not to offend the honor of the clans. Scene 3: Infiltration and Intelligence PCs present: Nemo, Fermín, Nacho (Pika, Alvarito, and Rocío mentioned). NPCs present: Kakh'syl, Tojio (Rich/Media Leader), Anonymous Aslan Warriors. Location: Ihatei Camp (Planet Kteiroa). Ships: Halaheike Class Pocket Warship (Tojio's Ship, 1,200 tons). Scene Summary The group splits up. Fermín investigates among the campfires and discovers the reason for the gathering: the war between the Hekaher and Itoguau clans on the world Ke'ai is ending abruptly in favor of the Hekaher, releasing thousands of troops. A large warship lands, bringing Tojio, a wealthy Aslan seeking glory and broadcasting his life as if it were a "reality show," attracting followers. Nemo attempts to socialize but makes an etiquette mistake by touching an Aslan, provoking a duel to first blood which he manages to resolve (and survive) successfully, earning some respect. Scene 4: Preparations and Alliances PCs present: Paloma, Goran, Nemo. NPCs present: Kakh'syl, Eihei, Ikki (Newly arrived leader). Location: Utea's Spaceport and Ihatei Camp (Planet Kteiroa). Scene Summary While Nemo continues to work as a mechanic in the camp to maintain his cover, Paloma and Goran return to the spaceport. Paloma searches for luxury goods, and Goran buys art supplies. Five days pass during which Goran works on painting a high-quality picture (valued at about 10,000 credits) to use as a gift and secure the audience with the broker Ziuq. In the camp, the situation worsens: Ikki, a furious leader of the losing clan, arrives with many troops. To the detriment of Drinax's interests, Ikki begins to form an alliance with Eihei, consolidating a massive force that could attack the Trojan Arm instead of wasting its strength on Pahal.

title: 35 - PoD - Iatehi! 03
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Intrigues among the Ihatei PCs present Nemo (Engineer/Mechanic) Ondo (Juan - Noble/Artist/Diplomat) Honor (Paloma - Broker/Trader) Goran (Fomega - Spy/Technician) Rocío (Nacho - Investigator) NPCs present Caesil (Renegade Aslan, PCs' guide. Archetype: The native guide). Utea (Female Aslan, spaceport administrator. Pragmatic and business-focused. Archetype: The neutral merchant). Heihei "The Wise" (Elderly Aslan, leader of the Tiquisto clan. Archetype: The old strategist). Teao (Aslan from the Kaukei-Aer clan, diplomatic emissary. Archetype: The peacemaker/politician). Iki (Aslan from the Hityowau clan, young, aggressive, charismatic, wears ceremonial battle armor. Archetype: The ambitious warlord). Fiuk (Aslan information broker, sophisticated, speaks fluent Anglic. Archetype: The untouchable informant). Old Helio (Renegade Aslan, clanless veteran warrior. Archetype: The ronin). Pika (Crew member/Ally with technical and social skills). Important Campaign Developments    The PCs discover that Iki, a charismatic Ihatei* leader, intends to attack and conquer the Floating Palace of Drinax, seeing it as a glorious and technological target.    The group devises a strategic plan to prevent the attack on Drinax: intervening in an existing Aslan civil war in the Acoaft system. They plan to send supplies and weapons to the losing side (Iki's clan) to prolong the conflict and keep the Ihatei* occupied far from Drinax. The groundwork is laid for a "False Flag" operation by creating recordings and propaganda to sow discord among the assembled clans. Loose Ends    The execution of the smuggling plan: The group must split up. One team will use the Banshee* to carry supplies to Acoaft, while another must acquire these supplies (weapons, provisions) from nearby markets. Utea's request: The port administrator requested a power plant (Power 60), water recycling systems, and PVC pipes in exchange for future favors. This remains pending. The effectiveness of the disinformation campaign created by Honor and Nemo is yet to be seen. Scene 1: Land of Ice and Warriors PCs present: Nemo, Ondo, Honor, Goran, Rocío. NPCs present: Caesil (Aslan Guide), Heihei, Teao, Old Helio. Location: Spaceport and Ihatei Camp (Kteiroa/Kteiroa System). Ships mentioned: Caesil's Ship (Kteiroa/Katiyuyi class Courier). Scene Summary: The group arrives at Kteiroa, an icy world full of Ihatei (landless second sons of Aslan). Caesil briefs them on local politics: there is tension between Heihei (who wants to attack the wealthy world of Paal) and Teao (who is trying to maintain peace). They learn of the arrival of Iki, a furious leader because the war he was going to participate in in the Acoaft system has ended prematurely due to alleged betrayal, leaving him without an opportunity for glory. An Aslan "influencer" broadcasting his exploits is also mentioned. Scene 2: Business at the Spaceport PCs present: Ondo, Nemo. NPCs present: Utea (Female Aslan, administrator, mistakes Ondo for a "useless" human or female due to his artistic interests. Archetype: The business matron). Location: Spaceport Cantina/Offices (Kteiroa). Scene Summary: While the group settles in, Nemo and Ondo speak with Utea. Ondo tries to converse about art and poetry, which confuses Utea, who only values utility and business. Nemo redirects the conversation towards technical matters. Utea reveals that the camp is overflowing its resources and requests help acquiring a power plant, water systems, and pipes. She suggests that if the PCs help her, she could be a valuable ally in the future. Scene 3: The Rumor Mill PCs present: Honor, Nemo, Pika (assisting). NPCs present: None directly, internal work. Location: PCs' Ship (Kteiroa). Scene Summary: The group decides that the best defense for Drinax is an information attack. Honor, with technical assistance from Nemo and Pika, spends four days creating fake propaganda material (videos and audio). The goal is to convince the Aslan that the defeat of Iki's clan in the recent war was the result of trickery and dishonor, inciting them to return to fighting instead of seeking new targets. The forgery roll is successful, creating very believable material. Scene 4: An Audience with the Broker PCs present: Ondo. NPCs present: Fiuk (Information broker, polite but dangerous. Archetype: The informed Godfather), Aslan Guards. Location: Fiuk's Ship (Kteiroa). Scene Summary: Ondo spends days painting a picture of the night camp to gain an audience with Fiuk. Fiuk receives him, appreciates the art, but quickly dismantles Ondo's cover, interrogating him about Drinax and Clarke. Fiuk confirms that the "Aslan tide" will eventually attack the Trojan Expansion and that Drinax is a current target for being an Aerial (floating world) that many have overlooked. Fiuk dismisses Ondo politely, making it clear he doesn't like spies, but pays his "debt" for the painting by letting him leave alive and with information: Clarke is safe for now, but Drinax is not. Scene 5: Listening to the Warlords PCs present: Goran. NPCs present: Iki, Heihei, Teao, Fiuk. Location: Ihatei Camp, near an outdoor stove (Kteiroa). Scene Summary: Goran poses as a technician repairing a stove outside to eavesdrop on a high-level meeting. He overhears Iki presenting his plan to Heihei: conquer the Floating Palace of Drinax, information that Fiuk sold him. Teao tries to dissuade them, suggesting "softer" targets like Fantasy or Sink, arguing that attacking near Borito or Paal is dangerous due to their militarization. However, Iki seems obsessed with the glory of taking Drinax. Scene 6: The Old Soldier and the New Plan PCs present: Nemo, Rocío. NPCs present: Iki's old servant (Elderly Aslan, honorable, sad about the defeat. Archetype: The resigned veteran). Location: Hityowau Clan Camp (Kteiroa). Ships mentioned: The Banshee (Heavy Fighter/PCs' Ship). Scene Summary: Nemo and Rocío manage to contact a member of Iki's retinue, an old warrior. Through careful conversation, they confirm that the clan would accept external help if presented as an opportunity to restore lost honor. The elder indicates that they would need about 25-27 tons of supplies and weapons to break the blockade and reactivate resistance in Acoaft. The group decides to activate "Plan Z": use the Banshee to carry out this smuggling, which will require splitting the group to buy the materials and transport them, with the ultimate goal of saving Drinax by diverting the invading fleet.

title: 36 - PoD - Iatehi! 04
content: War Logistics and Diplomacy on the Rim PCs present: Paloma / Honor Nemo (Captain) Fomega (Doctor) Pika (Emilio) NPCs present: Kasyl (Crew member, black market contact) Arpad (Crew member, sensor student) Princess Rao's Butler (Court intermediary) Lord Wrax (Admiral of the Drinax Fleet) Black Sun Widow (Spaceport guard on Theev) Ex-military Woman (Illegal arms dealer on Theev, wears a business suit) Hrai "The Wise" (Aslan Leader, strategist, wears combat armor and a tactical computer) Fighter Salesman on Blue (Commercial representative) Important campaign developments: It is confirmed that the Aslan plan (led by Hrai) is to conquer Drinax to use it as an operational base and conquer the rest of the Rim and the Drinax Chain. Nemo initiates diplomatic and commercial negotiations on Blue to acquire fighter squadrons for the defense of Drinax. A supply route and secure message drops are established between several systems (Drinax, Torpol, Blue). Loose ends: Pika remains infiltrated in the Aslan camp without having managed to change the target of the attack, leaving Drinax in imminent danger. The meeting of the groups in Drinax with the supplies (legal and illegal) is pending to arm the resistance or the Vexpexers. The agreement for fighters on Blue is verbally agreed but not finalized or paid for. Planning and Separation PCs present: Paloma, Nemo, Fomega, Pika. NPCs present: None explicitly mentioned in the dialogue, reference to those who remain (Fermín, Goran). Location(s): Kteiroa (System/Planet), Asim (System/Planet). Ship(s): Kyu-class Courier (Mail, 3-ton capacity), Banshee (Mentioned parked on Drinax). Scene summary: The group decides to split up to optimize time and acquire supplies for the imminent Aslan war. They agree that Paloma will take a fast ship (Courier) to Theev to acquire illegal merchandise, while Nemo and Fomega will head to Drinax to retrieve the Banshee and purchase legal supplies along the trade route. Pika will remain in Kteiroa infiltrated in the Aslan camp to sabotage or gather information. The entire group travels first to Asim, where they separate; Paloma continues on her route, and the others seek passage to Drinax. The Theev Black Market PCs present: Paloma. NPCs present: Black Sun Widow (Security guard), Kasyl (Crew member, helps with contacts), Ex-military Woman (Weapons dealer, pragmatic). Location(s): Black Sun City (Theev/Sindal System), La Calavera Spaceport (Theev). Ship(s): Courier (Paloma's ship). Scene summary: Paloma arrives on Theev, a pirate planet where the crew has restricted access (banned), but manages to land discreetly. She attempts to use her skills to find illegal weapons and contact Miria Silverhand, but initially fails, only buying legal advanced weapons. Kasyl intervenes and makes contact with an ex-military woman in a bar. Paloma sells the advanced weapons to regain liquidity and buys 3 tons of illegal weapons for 630,000 credits. After closing the deal, she leaves the planet quickly to avoid trouble. Audience with The Wise PCs present: Pika. NPCs present: Hrai "The Wise" (Aslan Leader, elderly but strong, wears armor and computer), Aslan Guards. Location(s): Yatei Camp (Kteiroa/System). Scene summary: Pika, posing as an engineer and expert in robotics/cybernetics interested in culture, secures an audience with Hrai after presenting him with a valuable gift (a statuette worth 200,000 credits). Hrai reveals his master plan: he seeks not indiscriminate plunder, but to conquer Drinax for its strategic position and technology (like the Tower of the Scholars) to establish a generational base. Pika attempts to persuade him to attack Tech-World or Fantasy instead, arguing for better resources and trade routes, but Hrai dismisses the idea, remaining firm in his plan for Drinax. The Trade and Diplomatic Route PCs present: Nemo, Fomega. NPCs present: Rao's Butler (Royal servant), Lord Wrax (Admiral, concerned military), Fighter Salesman (Commercial on Blue). Location(s): Drinax (Planet/Floating Palace), Torpol (Trade planet), Blue (Industrial planet), Clarke (Planet). Ship(s): Banshee (Retrieved on Drinax). Scene summary: Nemo and Fomega arrive on Drinax. Nemo warns Admiral Wrax about the Aslan threat and requests an audience with Princess Rao, though he only manages to leave the message through her butler. Later, they travel to Torpol where they purchase 10 tons of food, 5 tons of medical supplies, and spices. They then jump to Blue, where Nemo presents himself as a dignitary to negotiate the purchase of space fighter squadrons; he obtains an offer of 9 million per unit and buys 2 tons of advanced vehicles. Finally, they pass through Clarke and return to Drinax to await Paloma, having spent weeks in the process.

title: 37 - PoD - Iatehi! 05
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format: Blood in Kteiroa and Genetic Gardens PCs Present: Goran, Fermín, Pika, Nemo, Fomega. NPCs Present: Iller, Teau, Iki "The Wise" (mentioned), Toijol "The Brave" (mentioned), Jimmy (mentioned), Horrax (mentioned). Major Developments in PCs' Lives or the Campaign:    Pika has managed to preliminarily divert the attention of a faction of the Aslan ihatei towards the Fantasy* system, drawing them away from Drinax and the Western Trojan Reach. Goran and Fermín have established their physical dominance in the Aslan outlaw camp, earning the "respect" of the outcasts.    An alliance between Aslan leaders Iki and Toijol is confirmed with the long-term goal of conquering Drinax*. Loose Ends / Pending Items:    The fate of the human inhabitants of Fantasy* in the face of an imminent Aslan invasion instigated by Pika.    The pending meeting with Paloma in Pourne*. The status of the repairs to the captured ships under Jimmy's command and whether he will manage to join the fleet.    The lie by omission to Horrax regarding the deal for the fighters in Blue*. Aggressive Negotiations at the Pit PCs Present: Goran, Fermín. NPCs Present: Iller (Aslan outcast, "derailed," addicted, toothless, and balding; archetype of the loser/cannon fodder), Various Aslan thugs (Archetype of drunk gang members). Location(s): Outlaw camp, outcast area (Kteiroa). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: While waiting in Kteiroa, Goran and Fermín decide to infiltrate the lower area of the Aslan camp to look for recruits or information. They make contact with Iller, a marginalized, drug-addicted Aslan, with whom they play cards to integrate. The situation becomes tense when about a dozen drunk and hostile Aslan surround them with the intention of lynching them. Far from being intimidated, Fermín consumes combat drugs and, together with Goran (who uses his tactical knowledge to position himself), unleashes a massacre. Using monoblades and firearms, they eliminate several Aslan and cause the rest to flee. Iller, impressed by the unleashed violence, changes his attitude and becomes much friendlier towards the humans, seeing them as strong warriors. Interstellar Diplomacy PCs Present: Pika. NPCs Present: Teau (Agent of the clans, Aslan diplomat; archetype of the pragmatic functionary). Location(s): Teau's tent, Aslan Camp (Kteiroa). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: Pika seeks an audience with Teau, the representative of the clans, to try to manipulate the direction of the ihatei invasion. He argues that attacking westward would upset the delicate balance of power in the Trojan Reach, while expanding eastward (towards Fantasy) would maintain the status quo and be more beneficial. Teau agrees with this view, revealing that the Hierate prefers to avoid unnecessary major conflicts. They agree that Pika will act as an scout; Teau gets him passage on a merchant ship to go to Fantasy and gather data that will make the planet appealing to the ihatei. Fleet Logistics PCs Present: Nemo, Fomega. NPCs Present: Jimmy (Mentioned via message), Paloma (Mentioned). Location(s): Drinax and space route towards Pourne. Ship(s): Banshee (Harrier, Captain Nemo). Scene Summary: Back in Drinax, Nemo and Fomega plan the next logistical steps. They decide to ignore Horrax's request from Blue regarding the fighters, as the deal was not favorable. They leave orders for Jimmy to repair the captured ships and engage in piracy or join them when he is ready. They plot a shopping and supply route that will pass through Pourne, Pal, The World, and Borite, with the intention of meeting Paloma in Pourne to pick up illegal merchandise and technological equipment. The Paradise of the Naive PCs Present: Pika. NPCs Present: Aslan Merchant Captain (Merchant, ship owner), Inhabitants of Fantasy (Genetically modified humans, beautiful, simple, and primitive; archetype of "the noble savage"). Location(s): Jungle (Fantasy). Ship(s): Aslan Merchant Ship (Small freighter). Scene Summary: Pika arrives in the Fantasy system, a world of low technological level and lush vegetation. He uses a drone and scientific tools to analyze the terrain, seeking to confirm that it is capable of sustaining an Aslan population. During his exploration on the surface, he encounters a group of native humans of extraordinary beauty (possibly the result of ancient genetic engineering) but simple intellect. Upon seeing how they react with childlike curiosity to his tools, Pika concludes that they are easy prey. He decides not to warn them and confirms that the planet is the perfect target (rich territory and zero defense) to sell to the Aslan, effectively condemning the local population to conquest. Rumors of War PCs Present: Goran, Fermín. NPCs Present: Iller (Aslan outcast). Location(s): Aslan Camp (Kteiroa). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: Weeks pass in Kteiroa. Goran attempts to manipulate Iller by appealing to his wounded pride to enlist as cannon fodder on the first ship leaving for war. Meanwhile, the most relevant political news in the camp is confirmed: Iki ("The Wise") and Toijol ("The Brave") have joined forces. They have sent messengers to their clans to gather a fleet with the specific objective of conquering Drinax, although the mobilization will take months to complete.

title: 38 - PoD - Iatehi! 06
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Gods of Fantasy and the Ihatei Conspiracy PCs present: Emilio (Plays a scientist/explorer woman, possibly "Pika"). Nacho (Plays a technical/social character, possibly "Ondo"). Nemo (Captain). Paloma (Mentioned, broker/hacker character, though the player is absent or inactive). NPCs present: Tarja (Native of Fantasy. Human of sculptural beauty but limited intellect. Archetype: The Innocent Savage). Utea (Spaceport administrator of Keiteroa. Pragmatic and concerned with business. Archetype: The Neutral Merchant). Fiuq (Aslan information merchant, a "Sinclan". Archetype: The Mercenary Informant). Teao (Agent of the Aslan clans). Iqi "The Anxious" (Ihatei leader, aggressive and heavily armored). Tohijo "The Brave" (Young Ihatei leader). Heigh "The Wise" (Elderly and tactical Aslan, uses a computer). Main developments in the campaign:    It has been discovered that the planet Fantasy is inhabited by genetically modified humans (former slaves/breeders of the Glorious Empire* Aslan) who lack advanced intelligence due to mental manipulation or blockage.    The group has devised a plan to divert the imminent invasion of the Ihatei* (landless Aslan warriors) that threatens Drinax. The strategy involves manipulating information so that the Aslan attack and conquer Fantasy instead of Drinax, selling them the idea that Fantasy is a rich territory with slaves, while exaggerating Drinax's military defenses. Loose ends: The "mental block" (the cloud) of the natives of Fantasy requires advanced medical technology and facilities that the PCs currently lack to be cured. Nacho must execute the bribery/manipulation plan with Fiuq to disseminate the false information without them discovering the deception. The purchase of aerospace fighters for Drinax was left pending after a failed negotiation by Nemo. Scene 1: The Goddess of Fantasy PCs present: Emilio. NPCs present: Tarja (Native woman, perfect physique, speaks simplified Trokh). Location: Mountains and jungle of Fantasy (Planet/System Fantasy). Ships mentioned: Crashed Aslan ship (1000-ton ancient cargo/slave transport model). Summary: Emilio explores the surface of Fantasy, a world with gravity slightly higher than Earth's. He encounters humans of "sculptural" physical beauty but simple and primitive behavior who speak a degenerate dialect of Trokh (Aslan language). The natives, including a woman named Tarja, worship him as a "Goddess" due to his technology. Tarja guides Emilio to a "sacred place" which turns out to be an Aslan ship that crashed centuries ago and is covered in vegetation. Inside, Emilio discovers that the ship belonged to the Glorious Empire (a heretical Aslan faction that used slaves) and was transporting "breeders" (humans modified for breeding). Emilio deduces that the natives have an artificial mental block. He attempts to access the ship's computers, but the lack of power and tools prevents him from doing more, so he decides to return with the information. Scene 2: Espionage at the Spaceport PCs present: Nacho. NPCs present: Utea (Port administrator), Iqi "The Anxious", Tohijo "The Brave", Heigh "The Wise" (Aslan leaders). Location: Spaceport and Control Tower in Keiteroa (Planet/System Keiteroa). Ships mentioned: None specific, Ihatei ships are mentioned in general. Summary: Nacho remains in Keiteroa gathering information on the Ihatei's movements. He observes that two main factions are forming, led by Iqi and Tohijo (advised by the elder Heigh), and that the departure of the invasion fleet is imminent. Nacho speaks with Utea, the port administrator, who confesses that she doesn't want the Aslan to leave because she would lose business. They agree that the ideal outcome would be to sabotage their plans or redirect them. Utea suggests that the best way to influence the Aslan leaders is through Teao (the clan agent) or Fiuq (the "Sinclan" information merchant). Nacho decides to prepare an expensive gift to try to gain an audience with Fiuq and manipulate him. Scene 3: The New Strategic Plan PCs present: Emilio, Nacho, Nemo. NPCs present: None. Location: PCs' ship (Keiteroa). Ships mentioned: Harrier (reference to the Drinax ship). Summary: The group reunites after Emilio's return. Emilio shares his discovery about Fantasy: it is a habitable planet, with a docile population (perfect slaves for the Glorious Empire's mentality), and no defenses. They cross-reference this information with the situation in Keiteroa. They decide that the best way to save Drinax is not to fight, but to convince the Aslan that Drinax is a difficult target (inventing false military defenses) and that Fantasy is the big prize: a lost world of the Glorious Empire ready to be reconquered. They plan to use Fiuq to leak this fabricated "intelligence." Nemo admits that his previous attempt to buy fighters for Drinax failed because he is not a good negotiator, reinforcing the need for this deception plan.

title: 39 - PoD - Iatehi! 07
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format: Honor, Lies, and Bureaucracy PCs present: Fermín (Nacho) Pika (Emilio) Fomega (Álvaro) Captain Nemo (Juan) NPCs present: Aowai Yankee Teao Polloc Santo Berislav Vicorus (mentioned in flashback) Dhurin (mentioned in flashback) Important campaign developments: Diplomatic Front (Kteiroa): Pika has returned with data from the planet Fantasy to try and convince the Aslan clans to attack there instead of Drinax. Teao Polloc seems receptive and begins to pull strings, although warmongering factions continue to target Drinax.    Logistical Front (Pourne): The crew of the Banshee* has managed to acquire 10 tons of legal advanced weaponry to support defense or negotiation, bypassing local bureaucracy through bribery. Fomega's Background: It is revealed that Fomega fled the surface of Drinax after medical negligence that cost the life of a Vespexer clan chief's son. Loose ends: The Aslan fleet: Although Teao is maneuvering, it is not certain if the warrior leaders (Iki, Eharl) will change their target from Drinax to Fantasy. Paloma's whereabouts: She has not arrived at Pourne with the illegal weapons (tactical nuclear). The group has left her a message to meet in Borite between weeks 13-15. Secondary mission on Kteiroa: Investigating the disappearance of some Vespexers, possibly at the hands of spies or disintegrators, remains pending. The informant Fiuq: An influential "clanless" individual on Kteiroa whom they have not yet managed to manipulate or thoroughly investigate. Scene 1: The Electrician's Duel PCs present: Fermín NPCs present: Aowai (Aslan Warrior, archetype of a proud challenger, wears combat armor). Yankee (Aslan ally of Fermín, acts as assistant/second). Location: Ihatei Camp (Planet Kteiroa). Scene Summary: While Fermín was repairing a toaster, he is surrounded by a group of Aslan. Aowai, a local warrior, challenges him to a duel upon hearing rumors of his combat prowess. Aowai removes his technological armor to fight on equal terms. Fermín attempts to dissuade him unsuccessfully and chooses to fight with a sword. After a brutal exchange of blows where Fermín is wounded, he manages to land a critical hit on Aowai, leaving him incapacitated and bleeding. Fermín spares his opponent's life and requests medical attention for him, earning the silent respect of those present. Fermín spends the following week recovering from his injuries at the spaceport. Scene 2: Memories of a "Doctor" PCs present: Fomega, Captain Nemo NPCs present: Vicorus (Vespexer Clan Chief, mentioned in flashback). Dhurin (Son of Vicorus, mentioned in flashback). Location: The Banshee (Deep space / In transit). Scene Summary: During the journey, details of Fomega's last four years are revealed. After being expelled from the Scout academy, he lived as a vagabond on the surface of Drinax, working as a doctor for the Vespexer clans. His career ended abruptly when Dhurin, Chief Vicorus's son, died of a viral infection under his care (due to Fomega's incompetence, though he blames the virus). Fomega fled to the Floating Palace before the clan could exact revenge. It is also mentioned that he learned to pilot submarines on the aquatic planet Number One. Scene 3: The Fantasy Proposal PCs present: Pika, Fermín NPCs present: Teao Polloc (Aslan Merchant Leader, archetype of an influential negotiator). Aslan Females (Socializing group at the camp). Location: Ihatei Camp (Planet Kteiroa). Scene Summary: Pika returns to Kteiroa after 9 weeks. He meets with Teao Polloc and presents him with manipulated scientific reports about the planet Fantasy. The main argument is that Fantasy, despite having a heavy atmosphere, is colonizable and has historical ties to the "Glorious Empire" (heretical enemies of the Hierate), making it a more honorable and richer conquest target than the wasteland of Drinax. Teao accepts the information to try and influence the invasion leaders. Pika attempts to pry information from a group of Aslan females by drinking with them, but only learns that the mysterious Fiuq has a feud with Teao's clan and that the warrior leaders are determined to go to Drinax. Scene 4: Bureaucratic Hell and Black Market PCs present: Captain Nemo, Fomega NPCs present: Santo Berislav (Customs Officer, archetype of a corruptible and weary bureaucrat). Location: Spaceport (Planet Pourne). Ship: Banshee (Captain Nemo). Scene Summary: The Banshee arrives at Pourne, a high-tech world (TL 10) with a corrosive atmosphere and a militarized, gray society. After a full day of filling out forms, they descend to the spaceport. They encounter endless queues. Nemo uses his social skills and a bribe of 300 credits to the official Santo Berislav to skip the wait and obtain the permits. Once inside, Nemo locates a technology supplier and purchases 10 tons of advanced weaponry for 1,275,000 credits (after negotiating a discount). They decide not to wait for Paloma any longer and leave an encrypted message indicating they are heading to Borite, with a planned route through Pahal and The World.

title: 40 - PoD - Iatehi! 08
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format, using Spanish from Spain and based solely on the provided transcript. Session Title: Nuclear Supplies and Viral Propaganda PCs present: Nemo: Captain of the Banshee. Goran: Mercenary and brute force (Player: Nacho). Abra / "Fomega": Technology and communications specialist (Player: Emilio). Alvarito / Jane: Navigator and driver (Player: Álvaro). NPCs present: Juan: The Arbiter (GM). Paloma: Smuggler ally, captain of her own ship. Kaisil: Pilot and Paloma's partner. Utea: Aslan merchant in Kteiroa, ally. Saldancet: Merchant (mentioned), transported the frozen bodies. King Oleb XVI, Lady Hil, Admiral Darokin: (Not actively present, part of the background). Main developments in PCs' lives or the campaign:    The Imperial Armada has placed a bounty on the heads of the Banshee's crew (100,000 credits) after finding the frozen bodies in Hilfer and linking the ship's stealth technology to the disappearance of the Martin*. It has been possible to delay and partially demoralize the Aslan troops in Kteiroa through a "fake news" operation. A shipment of weapons (including nuclear ones) has been delivered to the losing faction in Acoaft to prolong the civil war and prevent the winning fleet from heading to Drinax. Loose ends: The Vespexers: It has been discovered that humans (possibly the Vespexer mercenaries) are being held on Tiuk's freighter in Kteiroa, fed cheap human food. Judge Yae: "Plan C" involves assassinating the war arbiter in Acoaft, Judge Yae, to prevent him from declaring the end of the conflict if the supplies are ineffective. Abra's Identity: Abra left an identification card (or tool) when sabotaging the communications tower; Utea knows this, although she has covered it up. Scene: Stalemate in Kteiroa PCs present: Goran, Abra. NPCs present: Old Eliu (Aslan Leader, hates humans), Tiuk (Aslan Leader, "The Influencer", wants to conquer Drinax). Location: Kteiroa (Kteiroa System). Ships: None specifically mentioned in action. Scene Summary: During weeks 17 and 18, Goran and Abra attempt political maneuvering in Kteiroa with little success. It is confirmed that the plan to divert the Aslan fleet towards the Fantasy system has failed because Old Eliu refuses, considering Fantasy a worthless place compared to the spoils of Drinax. Goran tries to offer himself as a mercenary but is rejected for being human. Abra tries to extract information from some Aslan females but ends up drunk and without useful data. It is confirmed that Tiuk has a force of about 10 young males in combat armor and several female engineers distributed across three ships (two scouts and one freighter). Scene: Intelligence and Shopping in Pal PCs present: Nemo, Alvarito. NPCs present: Local Aslan merchants. Location: Pal (Pal System), Spaceport. Ships: Banshee (Merchant Corvette, Captain Nemo). Scene Summary: Meanwhile, Nemo and Alvarito spend time in Pal preparing for the trip to Acoaft. Alvarito buys survival equipment (environment suits) and maps, as Acoaft has a corrosive atmosphere. Nemo uses his social skills and trade in spices (and holographic pornography) to infiltrate among the Aslan at the port. He discovers crucial information: the war in Acoaft will end in about 10 weeks with the victory of Drinax's enemies; there is an orbital blockade of 800-ton interceptors; and Judge Yae plans to leave for Keia soon to announce the winner. They also receive a message from Saldancet warning that the Empire is looking for a ship with stealth and has placed a bounty of 100,000 credits. Scene: The Viral Video PCs present: Goran, Abra. NPCs present: Utea (Aslan Merchant). Location: Kteiroa (Kteiroa System), Spaceport. Ships: Tiuk's fleet ships (mentioned in orbit). Scene Summary: In week 19, Goran and Abra execute a media sabotage plan. Goran reconnoiters the spaceport to find the "community video" transmission room. Abra, with the help of Goran's surveillance, infiltrates by forcing the lock (leaving an identification card by mistake) and hacks the system to broadcast a previously created fake video (deepfake). The video causes chaos and duels among the Aslan, damaging the morale of Tiuk's and Eliu's troops and causing some desertions, although it doesn't completely stop their plans. Utea scolds Abra for breaking the door but seems amused by the outcome. Additionally, Goran discovers that Tiuk's women are buying food for humans, deducing they have prisoners (the Vespexers) on their freighter. Scene: Breaking the Blockade PCs present: Nemo, Alvarito. NPCs present: Paloma (Smuggler), Kaisil (Pilot). Location: The World, Borito, Orbit of Acoaft (Acoaft System). Ships: Banshee (Merchant Corvette with stealth), Paloma's Ship (Light Transport). Scene Summary: The crew of the Banshee travels through The World to meet Paloma in Borito (Week 20). Paloma brings illegal weapons (tactical nuclear bombs) instead of spices. They decide to take Paloma and her cargo on the Banshee for the mission. Upon arriving at Acoaft, they use the stealth systems of the Banshee and an expert astrogation roll (calculated with the ship's programs and Alvarito's help) to silently slip through the blockade fleet (8 interceptors and battleships) undetected, entering the planet's atmosphere like "a camouflaged rock." Scene: Delivery in Hostile Territory PCs present: Nemo, Alvarito. NPCs present: Aslan Resistance (observed from a distance). Location: Surface of Acoaft (Acoaft System), canyon and trench area. Ships: Banshee (hidden with holographic camouflage), Enemy Fighters (patrolling). Scene Summary: Already on the surface (Week 21), they use passive and active sensors briefly to locate the losing faction, which is surrounded and without supplies. They land in a canyon and use the Jeeps to bring the cargo closer to the front lines. The operation is risky; they are almost detected by enemy patrols and tanks, forcing them to leave the supplies (10 tons of food, 10 tons of advanced weapons, 5 tons of medicine, and 3 tons of nuclear weapons) a bit further than planned and closer to enemy areas. They attempt to leave a misleading message ("Aslan cache recovered") and coordinates, but the execution is clumsy, making the Aslan distrust the origin of the aid. However, access to nuclear weapons gives them a formidable opportunity for resistance ("+3" in conflict resolution). The PCs retreat to wait and consider "Plan C": hunt down the Judge if he tries to leave the planet.

title: 41 - PoD - Iatehi! 09
content: Sacrifice in Acoaft PCs present Ground Group (Kteiroa): Pika (Emilio), Juan's Character (Marine), Nacho's Character. Space Group (Banshee): Captain Nemo, Alvarito/Abra (Engineer), Paloma (Pilot), Tía (Gunner). NPCs present Fiuk (Aslan Leader, ground infiltration target). Iki (Aslan, mentioned as "good people" and possible contact). The Aslan Judge (Space assassination target, traveling in an escorted courier). Aslan Female (Seen buying cheap supplies/rations). Campaign Development and Drinax Goals    Critical failure in space mission: The attempt to assassinate the Aslan Judge to prevent him from declaring the end of the war and prolonging the conflict (favoring Drinax's plans) has resulted in the total destruction of the Banshee* and the death of most of the group. Succession of command: With Captain Nemo's death, it is suggested that Pika will have to assume the role of Captain due to his noble social status, essential for Drinax's political objectives. Loose ends The fate of the Ground Group: The survivors (Pika, Juan, and Nacho) are trapped on the surface with no ship to escape. The war: Having failed the assassination, the Judge is likely to declare Aslan victory, consolidating his position and complicating the reconstruction of the Kingdom of Drinax. The "Trojan Horse" plan: The infiltration plan on Fiuk's ship is designed but not yet executed. Scene 1: The Trojan Horse Plan PCs present: Pika (Emilio), Juan's Character, Nacho's Character. NPCs present: Fiuk (Aslan, antagonist/target), Aslan Female (Mentioned, distant behavior). Location: Camp/Spaceport in Kteiroa (Surface). Ships: Fiuk's Cargo Ship (Model unknown, Captain Fiuk). Scene Summary: The ground group heatedly discusses how to infiltrate Fiuk's ship to obtain information about the Vespers and their plans with Drinax. They discard hacking and direct assault due to a lack of stealth skills and tools. They devise a "Trojan Horse" style plan: acquire a large enough piece of art or statue to hide one of the PCs (possibly Nacho) inside. Pika, using his diplomacy, will present himself to Fiuk to deliver the "gift" and gain access, lying as little as possible or presenting himself as a noble of Drinax willing to negotiate land. As they debate, they observe the Aslan buying cheap food for humans, suggesting slavery. Scene 2: The Banshee's Last Stand PCs present: Captain Nemo, Paloma, Alvarito/Abra, Tía. NPCs present: Aslan Escorts and fighter pilots (Hierato Forces). Location: Acoaft Orbit (Space). Ships:    Banshee* (High Guard/Stealth Ship, Captain Nemo). Judge's Ship (200-ton Messenger/Courier, Captain Aslan Judge). Fighter Squadron (Light Fighters, Aslan). Scene Summary: The crew of the Banshee locates the Aslan Judge's ship amidst a tangle of orbital traffic. Their plan is a lightning strike: destroy the Judge's ship before it jumps to hyperspace and flee. They initiate a stealth attack, firing missiles and the particle barbette, managing to damage the target ship's hull and cargo. However, they are detected by the escorts. Five Aslan light fighters intercept the Banshee. A brutal combat (dogfight) erupts. Despite Paloma's piloting efforts, Alvarito/Abra's emergency repairs, and Tía and Nemo's defensive fire that manages to take down a couple of fighters, the Banshee is overwhelmed. They suffer critical damage to the power plant and maneuver drive. When they attempt to calculate an emergency jump to escape, the computer fails, and the accumulated damage is catastrophic. The Banshee is destroyed by concentrated fire from the fighters, resulting in the deaths of all PCs on board.

title: 42 - PoD - Iatehi! 10
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Session Title: Escape from Kteiroa and Divergent Origins PCs Present: Paloma (Journalist / Broker) Nemo (Vespexer / Drifter / Medic-Engineer / Agent) Fermín (Criminal / Face of the group) Juan (Marine / Infiltrator - Note: Sometimes referred to as Nacho or Juan by the Game Director) NPCs Present: Pika (Mechanic crewmate, accompanies PCs) Emilio (Crewmate, Navigator) Utea (Local contact on Kteiroa, supplier) The "Yankee" (Local criminal, drug contact) Fiuq (Antagonist Aslan, captain of the enemy ship) Three Vespexers (Rescued prisoners, one temporarily blinded) Female Aslan (Pilot/Engineer on the ship's bridge) Important Developments in the PCs' Lives or the Campaign: Paloma and Nemo advance in creating their backstory (up to Terminus 4), establishing careers as a Broker (after failing as a journalist) and an Intelligence Agent (after attending University and being a Drifter), respectively. The group on Kteiroa executes a risky plan to steal an Aslan ship and rescue prisoners, successfully acquiring a light freighter and jumping to hyperspace towards Drinax. Loose Ends: The stolen ship has made an emergency jump ("blind jump") near the atmosphere under enemy fire; the ship's condition and exact destination are uncertain. There is an armed Aslan hidden on the stolen ship's bridge, directly behind the characters as they pilot. Fiuq and his escort ships are actively pursuing the PCs. Paloma and Nemo still need to finalize their character details (aging, final skills). Scene 1: Forging Destinies (Character Creation) PCs Present: Paloma, Nemo. NPCs Present: None. Location: Meta-game (Rules discussion and rolls). Ships: None. Summary: While part of the group acts in Kteiroa, Paloma and Nemo generate their characters.    Paloma: Tries to be a journalist, but is expelled from the career after failing survival rolls and unfortunate events. She changes her trajectory towards Merchant Broker*, where she begins to have more success, learning legal and streetwise skills, though with bad dice luck.    Nemo: Starts as a Vespexer with aspirations. He attempts to enter Drinax's Military Academy (Navy), but the war interrupts his studies before graduation. He becomes a renegade Drifter*, then manages to enter the University (graduating in Medicine and Engineering) and finally joins an Intelligence agency as a spy, gaining rivals and medical skills along the way. Scene 2: The Trojan Horse of Flesh PCs Present: Fermín, Juan (Marine). NPCs Present: Pika (Mechanic), Utea (Trader), The "Yankee" (Criminal/Drug Addict - Archetype: Mercenary Thug). Location: Spaceport and Market (Planet Kteiroa). Ships: None explicitly mentioned at this stage. Summary: The group on Kteiroa plans how to infiltrate Fiuq's ship to rescue the Vespexer prisoners. They discard a frontal assault. They decide to modify a frozen meat container with a false bottom. Pika and the PCs prepare the container with tools and supplies.    Fermín uses his Deception* skills to sell the container to Fiuq's faction through Utea. Fermín contacts "The Yankee", a local criminal, paying him with money and drugs to organize a fake supply theft at the Aslan camp. This forces the Aslans to move the container (with PJ Juan hidden inside) inside their freighter for security. Scene 3: Blood in the Hold PCs Present: Juan (Marine). NPCs Present: Three Vespexers (Prisoners - Archetype: Victims/Survivors), Male Aslan (Guard - Archetype: Honorable but overconfident warrior). Location: Cargo Hold and Deck 3 (Ship Aoiwai). Ships: Aoiwai (Light Trader, Captain Fiuq). Summary: Juan, infiltrated on the ship Aoiwai thanks to the container, emerges using night-vision goggles. He locates the three Vespexers frozen in cryo-stasis. He successfully thaws them using his medical knowledge, although one is left temporarily blind. He arms the prisoners with what he has.    Upon reaching Deck 2, Juan is surprised by a Male Aslan who was eating. A melee combat ensues. Juan uses a Static Blade* to gravely wound the Aslan. The Aslan attempts to flee to raise the alarm, but Juan pursues and kills him (disemboweling him) before he can organize an effective defense, though he leaves an evident trail of blood. Scene 4: Bridge Assault and Blind Jump PCs Present: Fermín, Juan (Marine). NPCs Present: Pika (Mechanic), Emilio (Navigator), Female Aslan (Pilot - Archetype: Technician/Officer), Fiuq (Voice over radio/Enemy ship), Blind One (Vespexer in turret). Location: Command Bridge and exterior of the ship (Ship Aoiwai). Ships: Aoiwai (Light Trader, controlled by PCs), Fiuq's ships (Hostile Fighters/Escorts). Summary: Juan attempts to access the bridge, but the door is locked. He opts to break it down by brute force or cut it open. As the door opens, a Female Aslan activates the general alarm before surrendering under threat of decapitation. Outside, the alarm alerts ground troops. Fermín and Pika run towards the ship under enemy fire (dodging shots from unarmored Aslans) and manage to board just before the ramp closes.    With the group reunited, they decide to steal the ship. The ship is slow (Thrust 1), and Fiuq begins attacking them with his other ships, damaging the Aoiwai*'s shields and hull. Emilio and the PCs calculate a risky emergency jump to Drinax from within the atmosphere and under intense fire. They manage to jump, but the session ends with the revelation that an armed Aslan has managed to sneak or hide on the bridge behind the group.

content: Session Title: Blood in the Jump and Crossed Destinies PCs present Fermín (Played by Nacho. Dies during the session). Goran (Played by Juan). Pika (Played by Paloma). Nemo (Played by Nemo/Speaker_09). Fomega (New character, pilot, played by Speaker_01). Nacho's New PC (Ex-convict artist, in creation process). NPCs present    Kuk Norra (Male Aslan, invader. Physically described as "Chuck Norris with ears", orange fur. Armed with a Gauss pistol and a Crescent* sword. Archetype: Enemy/Invader). Female Aslan (Invader. Armed with a heavy revolver and claws. Archetype: Enemy/Accomplice). Bespexers (Minor crew members, one possibly blind. Archetype: Mooks/Expendable Crew).    King Oleb XVI (Mentioned as the original owner of the ship Scarlet Loot*). Plot Development and Campaign Objectives PC Death: Fermín dies during an Aslan boarding after a failed jump.    Crew Resources: It is established that Pika owns 50% of the ship Scarlet Loot* (a freighter that belonged to King Oleb) and Nemo has acquired a yacht and TAS membership thanks to his status. New Additions: The backstories of the new characters who will replace losses or join the group are being shaped (a Navy pilot and an ex-convict artist). Loose Ends Pika's Condition: She is incapacitated and possibly crippled after the jump and combat; cryosleep ("the fridge") is discussed to save her. The Prisoner: The female Aslan is unconscious and tied up; her fate has not been definitively resolved. Integration: How the new characters (Fomega and Nacho's new one) physically meet the current group still needs to be narrated. Scene 1: Ambush in Jump Space PCs present Fermín Goran Pika (Incapacitated) Bespexers (Ally NPCs) NPCs present Kuk Norra (Aslan invader. Archetype: Elite Warrior). Female Aslan (Aslan invader. Archetype: Combat Companion). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Command Bridge and Engine Room (PCs' Ship, Jump Space). Ship(s) mentioned PCs' Ship (Model unknown, Captain Pika/Fermín). Scene Summary The ship makes a dangerous jump within a planetary sphere, causing severe physical and mental effects on the crew (nausea, irritability, memory lapses). Pika is incapacitated by vomiting. Taking advantage of the chaos, two Aslans board the bridge. Kuk Norra, a humanoid-looking Aslan, and a female attack. Fermín attempts to defend himself by firing from the pilot's chair, but his armor does not withstand Kuk Norra's Gauss pistol fire, and Fermín dies on the spot. The female Aslan takes Pika hostage. Goran arrives from the engine room, engages in hand-to-hand combat, and after a tough confrontation where he receives several shots, manages to kill Kuk Norra and leave the female unconscious. The scene ends with the surviving crew deciding to place Pika in a cryogenic chamber to try to save her and dealing with Fermín's death. Scene 2: Forging New Lives (Character Creation) PCs present Fomega (Creating character). Nemo (Advancing character). Nacho (Creating new character). Paloma (Advancing Pika). NPCs present No physical NPCs apply, only background mentions (tutors, officers, judges). Location(s) and/or Planet(s) Drinax (Planet/System - Nemo's return location). Prison (Background location for Nacho's new PC). University and Naval Academy (Background locations). Ship(s) mentioned Scarlet Loot (Free Trader Freighter, Captain Pika/King Oleb XVI - Mortgage). Nemo's Yacht (Yacht, Captain Nemo - Creation benefit). Scene Summary The players spend the rest of the session creating new characters and advancing existing ones according to Traveller's creation tables: 1.  Fomega (New PC): Creates a character who attempted to be a Belter, was forcibly recruited by the Army (Infantry), and later managed to enter the Navy as a pilot of small craft, participating in diplomatic missions and surviving a mutiny. 2.  Nacho (New PC): Creates an "artist" and performer who defines himself as a victim of the system. He served a term in prison (where he learned to fight and Streetwise) for a crime he claims he did not commit. He finishes his creation as an artist with political rivals. 3.  Nemo: Advances his career as an Agent and Noble/Diplomat. He returns to Drinax to work in administration. He obtains significant benefits: a Yacht, TAS (Travellers' Aid Society) membership, and Ship Shares. 4.  Pika (Paloma): Rolls for accumulated benefits. She obtains partial ownership of a Free Trader type ship. The GM establishes that this ship is the Scarlet Loot, a former pirate ship of King Oleb XVI, now a freighter in poor condition.

content: Death in the Jump and the Crew's Rebirth PJs Present: Fermín (Nacho's character, deceased this session). Goran (Juan's character). Nemo (Speaker_05's character, Doctor/Diplomat). Paloma's PC (Broker and Captain of the new ship). Fomega's PC (Navy Pilot). Nacho's PC (New character, Artist and Ex-convict). NPCs Present: Pika (Vespexer, incapacitated by the jump). Kia (Female Aslan, ally/crewmate, suffering from jump sickness).    "Cugnorra" / Chuck Norris Aslan (Male Aslan raider, leader of the boarding. Archetype: Formidable Warrior*). Female Aslan (Raider, Cugnorra's companion). King Oleb XVI (Mentioned as the owner of the ship's mortgage). Important Developments in the PJs' Lives or the Campaign: The death of the character Fermín during a hostile boarding.    The formation of the new crew and the acquisition of the ship Scarlet Plunder*, a freighter owned by King Oleb XVI (his former pirate ship), of which Paloma's PC owns 50% and manages the mortgage. Nemo's PC establishes himself as a noble diplomat with political connections and a yacht (possibly integrated into the main ship). Loose Ends: The status of the captured Aslan raiders (one injured and the female unconscious) aboard the ship. Pika's recovery after the jump. Managing the mortgage with King Oleb. Scene: The Jump and the Boarding PJs Present: Goran, Fermín. NPCs Present: Pika (Incapacitated), Kia (Incapacitated), "Cugnorra" (Male Aslan, Chuck Norris appearance, aggressive), Female Aslan (Raider, subordinate). Location: The Ship (Jump Space / Dark Dimension). Ships: The PJs' current ship (No specific name mentioned). Scene Summary: The ship initiates an interstellar jump. During the transition to jump space, the crew suffers severe physical and mental effects due to the "dark dimension." Pika and Kia are incapacitated by vomiting and migraines. Goran suffers mental effects (irascibility, memory gaps), and Fermín suffers severe physical effects. Taking advantage of the chaos, an Aslan with a Chuck Norris appearance ("Cugnorra") and a female Aslan board the bridge. The female takes Pika hostage, threatening her with a claw and demanding surrender. Scene: The Duel and Fermín's Death PJs Present: Goran, Fermín. NPCs Present: "Cugnorra", Female Aslan, Pika. Location: Command Bridge (The Ship). Scene Summary: Combat erupts. Fermín, severely affected by the jump, fires his heavy revolver at the male Aslan, but the enemy's armor absorbs the impact. "Cugnorra" responds with a Gauss pistol on automatic fire, piercing Fermín's cover and armor, causing instant mortal wounds. Goran engages in melee combat with his sword against the Aslan leader, managing to wound him. In the chaos, the female Aslan fires, attempting to hit Goran, but accidentally hits her own companion. Goran seizes the opportunity to knock out the female Aslan. Goran attempts to aid Fermín with first aid, but his wounds are too severe, and he passes away. Goran secures the prisoners and attempts to place them in cryogenics/refrigeration. Scene: Trajectory Creation and the Scarlet Plunder PJs Present: Nemo, Paloma's PC, Fomega's PC, Nacho's PC (New). NPCs Present: King Oleb XVI (Mentioned). Location: Drinax (Planet/System), Prison (Nacho's PC's origin), Purne (Origin Planet). Ships: Scarlet Plunder (Freighter/Former pirate ship, Captain: Paloma's PC), Yacht (Owned by Nemo). Scene Summary: Following Fermín's death, the creation and trajectories of the new characters and the evolution of the existing ones to form the new crew are narrated: Fomega's PC: Joins the Navy, specializes as a pilot of small craft and flight, participating in diplomatic missions and preventing mutinies.    Nacho's PC: An artist/performer who ends up unjustly imprisoned. In prison, he hardens, learns to fight, and develops fixer* skills. Upon release, he resumes his artistic career and criticizes political leaders, gaining enemies and fame. Nemo: Consolidates himself as a noble and diplomat, working in the administration of Drinax. He acquires a Yacht, membership in the TAS, and social status.    Paloma's PC: Develops a successful career as a Broker (merchant). Through benefit events, she obtains partial ownership of the Scarlet Plunder*, King Oleb XVI's former pirate ship, assuming the mortgage with the monarch. The group consolidates as a mix of reformed criminals, military pilots, and noble diplomats ready to begin their campaign.

title: 45 - PoD - Varados en Marduk
content: Fire and Rain on Marduk PCs present Lyra Vance: Captain/Pilot. 42-year-old woman, medium build, dark hair pulled back, technical clothing. Clayton: ~30-40 years old, tall, thin, fair skin, cowboy hat, pilot jacket, smokes cigars. Pika (Yankee): Asian features, appears older than she is, wears corduroy pants and colorful socks. Programmer/Computer scientist. Loves sweets and noodles ("flungis"). Jimmy Mendoza: Thin, nervous, Latino appearance with a thin mustache. Lackey to King Oleb. Félix Corben: Middle-aged, well-kept beard, graying hair, hard features but polite. Ex-diplomat and doctor. NPCs present    Evan: A Vargr* (described as "a bar" in the transcript, but with ears and a muzzle, Tobias's lawyer). Skittish, wears a grey office suit. Finan Tremix: Human, middle-aged, somewhat fat, sloppily dressed. Investor/Scammer, talkative and cowardly. Karim: Young native woman of Marduk. Tunic, fingerless gloves, large backpack. Knows the local terrain and dangers. Major developments in PCs' lives or the campaign    The group convenes under the orders of King Oleb XVI to recover a vital package on Marduk and secure possession of the ship The Ginger*. The PCs survive an attack by Oghma barbarians and a plane crash, becoming stranded on the hostile surface of Marduk. The direct threat of Oghma slavers, who are raiding the system, is established. Loose ends Contact Johnny Belen is in the Downport with the package; the group has not reached him and his status is unknown after the attack. Survival on the surface of Marduk with limited resources and under freezing rain. The presence of a barbarian assault ship that has landed near their crash site. The fate of Finan Tremix's investments and whether he actually has contacts within GeDeCo. Meeting at the Highport PCs present: Lyra, Clayton, Pika, Jimmy, Félix. NPCs present: None relevant (local waiters/porters). Location: Bar in Marduk Highport (Marduk/Marduk System). Ships: The Ginger (Mentioned, docked at the port, equipped with twin laser turrets). The group arrives at Marduk Spaceport (Marduk High). Lyra has received instructions from the Royal House of Drinax to meet Jimmy Mendoza. Jimmy informs them that they must go down to the planet (Marduk Downport) to pick up a package held by one Johnny Belen and take it to Drinax. During the meal, they introduce themselves: Lyra and her crew (Clayton and Pika) meet, while Félix introduces himself as an ex-diplomat and accountant interested in attracting King Oleb's attention. Pika enjoys some local noodles. It is established that the atmosphere at the port is tense due to incursions by Oghma barbarians. The Interrupted Descent PCs present: All. NPCs present: Finan Tremix (Heavy investor trying to involve Pika and Félix in a fishing business scheme).    Evan (Vargr* lawyer, nervous, working on his tablet). Karim (Native, pragmatic, seems to know the port personnel). Location: Interior of a transport Shuttle (Orbit-surface transit). Ships: Passenger shuttle (Standard orbital transport model). The group boards the shuttle to the surface along with three other passengers. During the journey, Finan tries to sell an investment opportunity to Pika and Félix, claiming to have insider information from GeDeCo. The conversation is cut short when the captain announces a massive attack by Oghma ships on the spaceport. The shuttle performs evasive maneuvers and dodges two missiles, but a third explodes close enough to damage the ship, killing the pilots and causing the vessel to nosedive towards the surface between the jungle and islands of Marduk. Survival and Escape PCs present: All. NPCs present: Evan (Archetype: Coward/Useless Civilian), Finan (Archetype: Nuisance/Materialist), Karim (Archetype: Guide/Survivor). Location: Crash site on Marduk surface (Steppe/Jungle zone under torrential rain). Ships: Crashed shuttle (Total loss).    Subsidized Merchant* (400t freighter, likely captured by pirates, lands nearby after the crash). After the crash, the PCs wake up bruised but alive. The ship is destroyed and the pilots are dead. Under the leadership of Lyra and Jimmy, and with medical assistance from Félix, the group quickly scavenges emergency equipment: a survival kit for 12 people, a shotgun, a rifle, food, water, and warm clothing. Karim warns that the Oghma barbarians will come to capture slaves. Indeed, a merchant ship (presumably hostile) lands nearby. The group decides to abandon the shuttle wreckage immediately. They head towards a rugged area to make tracking by vehicles difficult, with Félix in the rear trying to erase their tracks under a freezing rain that is beginning to cause hypothermia. Finan and Evan are terrified and barely cooperate, while Karim guides the group.

title: 46 - PoD - Varados en Marduk 02
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Survival on the Forbidden Continent PCs present Lyra (Dove): Attempts to mediate diplomatically and gather information. Nemo: Tracker and survival expert, distrustful of strangers. Fenix (Fomega): Ex-military pilot with an eye implant (cybernetic eye), pragmatic and armed. Yankee (Nacho): Suffers the beast's attack, fakes being more injured than he is at the end. Den: Conducts reconnaissance and remains hidden at the end. NPCs present Karin: Communications officer of the spaceport. Native of Marduk (from the Downport). (Archetype: The Local Guide / The Informant). Jimmy: Member of the crashed crew, "the fat one." (Archetype: The Cooperative Crew Member). John Clayton: Captain of the crashed ship. (Archetype: The Defeated Captain). Finan: Vargr dressed in a suit and tie. (Archetype: The Bureaucrat Out of His Element). Evan: Passenger worried about his investments, carries an old tablet. (Archetype: The Greedy Civilian). Group of Natives: Men and women with primitive firearms and leather clothing. (Archetype: The Xenophobic Survivors). Campaign Development and Long-Term Objectives There has been no significant progress in the reconstruction of the Kingdom of Drinax in this session, as the focus has been purely on immediate survival after crashing on the planet Marduk. The context of Marduk is established: a planet with islands inhabited by isolationist people and a wild continent formerly bombed by the Sindal Empire. Loose Ends Who exactly are the natives who appeared in the ruins and what are their intentions? What was the creature that attacked Yankee and is still lurking in the undergrowth? Is there really a tracker or a mole among the survivors attracting hunters? The condition of the wounded man being brought by the natives and whether the PCs can help him. Scene 1: Mistrust Under the Rain PCs present: All (Lyra, Nemo, Fenix, Yankee, Den). NPCs present: Karin, Jimmy, John Clayton, Finan, Evan. Location: Bramble thicket (Planet Marduk). Ships mentioned: None. Summary: The group advances under incessant rain through difficult terrain full of brambles, heading towards some rock formations. During the march, Lyra talks with Karin to get information about the planet. Karin explains that the population of Marduk lives on artificial islands (Downport) or isolated and xenophobic archipelagos, and that the continent where they are is a wild and uninhabited area, a former bombed zone of the Sindal Empire. Meanwhile, Nemo and Fenix suspect that the pirates found them too quickly after the accident. They fear someone is carrying a tracker. Taking advantage of a moment to change into dry clothes, the PCs force the NPCs to submit to a search and to turn off all their electronic devices (tablets and phones) to avoid being tracked. Although there is initial tension, they manage to convince them diplomatically. Scene 2: The Prey and the Hunter PCs present: All. NPCs present: The group of survivors (Karin, Finan, etc.). Location: Bramble thicket (Planet Marduk). Ships mentioned: Hunter ship (Model unknown, hostile). Summary: While the group changes clothes and organizes equipment, they hear noises in the vegetation. A creature invisible among the brambles attacks Finan first (unsuccessfully) and, shortly after, lunges at Yankee, biting him in the leg and causing him an injury before disappearing back into the undergrowth. Simultaneously, they spot the ship that shot them down patrolling the sky, searching for survivors. The group throws themselves to the ground, covering themselves in mud and hiding under the brambles to avoid the ship's sensors and sight. After a few minutes of tension, the ship moves away. Nemo and Fenix treat Yankee's wound and decide to move quickly towards the rocks before nightfall. Scene 3: The Ruins of the Ancients PCs present: All. NPCs present: None active at the start (they are with the group). Location: Ancient ruins (Planet Marduk). Ships mentioned: None. Summary: Upon reaching the rock formations, they discover they are not natural, but ruins of an ancient city or structure millennia old (possibly from the Sindal era), with remains of asphalt and collapsed walls covered in vegetation. They find a room with a partial roof that offers shelter and discover remains of a campfire that has been out for at least a day, indicating recent human presence. They decide to camp there, trying to keep the light to a minimum and cover the openings to avoid being seen. Scene 4: Encounter in the Darkness PCs present: All. NPCs present: Group of Natives (Female leader with an oil lamp, men carrying a wounded person, armed adolescents). Location: Campfire room in the Ruins (Planet Marduk). Ships mentioned: None. Summary: As they prepare to spend the night, Jimmy warns that lights are approaching. A group of five natives with a pre-industrial appearance (leather clothing, moccasins) and armed with gunpowder rifles and artisanal revolvers enters the ruins seeking shelter; they are carrying a wounded man. The PCs decide not to ambush them. Den hides in an adjoining room to have a tactical advantage, while the rest (Lyra, Nemo, Fenix, Yankee) sit around the unlit campfire, trying to appear harmless. The natives enter, are surprised to see the strangers, and point their weapons at them while shouting in an unknown language that the PCs' translator cannot immediately decipher. Furthermore, they discover that there are a couple of native adolescents hidden on the flanks, also aiming at them. The session ends at this Mexican standoff point.
