title: 47 - PoD - Varados en Marduk 03
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Session Title: Night Siege in the Ruins of Marduk PCs present: Nemo / Den (whose real name is Felix Corven) Lyra Jimmy Kleiton Yankee Fun (Nacho) NPCs present: Karin (Ally of the group, archer) Evan (Ally of the group) Finan (Ally of the group) Emilia (Leader of the locals, carries a pistol and torch) Eclia (Emilia's daughter, 12-year-old girl with a shotgun) Lorn (Local elder, leg injured, wise figure) Borgs (Local, adult male) Altin (Local, adult male) Hav (Local, teenager) Isk (Local, teenager) Garin Einbrates (Local predatory creatures, "wise things with teeth") Campaign Development: The immediate objective is survival in a hostile environment (Marduk) after the shuttle accident, fleeing from potential slavers and local predators, which is a necessary prerequisite for any attempt at reconstruction or return to Drinax. First diplomatic contact is established with native inhabitants of Marduk, achieving a temporary alliance. A rescue signal is detected, opening the possibility of escaping the planet and continuing with the main mission. Loose Ends: The group must leave the ruins and find an elevated area to respond to the rescue signal, exposing themselves to new attacks. Altin and other locals are injured after combat. It is unknown if the pack of creatures (Garin Einbrates) is still lurking nearby or if there are more members. The threat of Oghma's slavers remains latent, although they did not appear in this session. Scene 1: Encounter in the Ruins PCs present: Nemo, Lyra, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fun. NPCs present: Emilia (distrustful native leader), Eclia (armed child), Lorn (injured elder), Borgs, Altin, Hav, Isk, Karin, Evan, Finan. Location(s): Ruins of an ancient city (Marduk). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: After fleeing the crashed ship and taking refuge in rocky ruins at dusk, the PCs are approached by a group of local natives led by Emilia. A tense initial confrontation occurs with weapons drawn. Nemo attempts to de-escalate the situation by showing empty hands and offering medical aid, while Lyra uses her translator to establish communication. Once the tension subsides, the translator begins to function. The locals explain that they are far from their village hunting and were attacked by creatures called "Garin Einbrates" (translated as "extremely wise things with teeth that kill"), which injured the elder Lorn. The PCs explain they come "from outside" (a ship) and are looking for the large village/spaceport, a concept the locals are almost completely unaware of. Nemo treats Lorn's wound. A heavy storm begins to fall, and visibility is drastically reduced, forcing both groups to share the shelter. Scene 2: The Night of Teeth PCs present: Nemo, Lyra, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fun. NPCs present: Emilia, Eclia, Lorn, Borgs, Altin (severely injured local warrior), Hav (injured teenager), Isk, Karin, Evan, Finan. Location(s): Ruins of an ancient city (Marduk). Ship(s): None. Scene Summary: Jimmy detects movement in the outside darkness and raises the alarm. Shortly after, several "Garin Einbrates" (similar to large dogs or deer, yellowish fur, and very fast) launch a coordinated attack on the camp. A chaotic combat breaks out in the gloom, barely illuminated by flashlights and the bonfire. A dog attacks Hav, injuring his arm. Another dog attacks Altin, leaving him severely injured and on the verge of unconsciousness. The PCs and locals respond with gunfire and melee weapons. Lyra and Jimmy manage to shoot the beasts. Den (Nemo) and Borgs fight hand-to-hand. One of the dogs is brought down after being wounded by shots and finished off by Isk and Den. The other animals, after making quick attacks and injuring their targets (including Isk and Nemo), retreat into the darkness, demonstrating tactical intelligence in attack and flight. After the combat, Den tends to the injured (Altin, Hav, Isk, and himself). Rotating guards are organized to watch the entrances, with the PCs and locals collaborating to protect the perimeter for the rest of the night. Scene 3: A Signal in the Storm PCs present: Nemo, Lyra, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fun. NPCs present: Emilia, Karin. Location(s): Ruins of an ancient city (Marduk). Ship(s): Rescue Ship (Unknown, automatic signal). Scene Summary: During one of the watches, while the rain continues, Lyra's (or Karin's) communicator picks up a weak and intermittent signal. Upon analyzing it with electronics and sensor skills, they confirm it is an automatic looping message from a rescue ship. The message states they have found the wreckage of their shuttle, that the assailants have been expelled from orbit, and requests any survivors to respond. The problem arises when the PCs realize that, due to interference from the ruins and the low power of their handheld communicators, they cannot respond from their current position. They must go outside and find a high point to transmit, which involves risking being attacked again by the beasts lurking in the darkness. Lyra informs Emilia of the situation, raising the need to leave to ensure their evacuation.

title: 48 - PoD - Varados en Marduk 04
content: Escape from Marduk's Ruins PCs present: Lyra Vance (Captain) Jimmy (Captain Mendoza) Kleiton Yankee Fu Den (Nemo / Second Corbin / Seneschal) NPCs present: Karim (Guide/Survivor) Emilia (Leader of local natives) Finan (Shuttle survivor) Evan (Survivor dog/pet) Lorn, Borgs, Dorem, and one of Emilia's daughters (Wounded/present natives) Wise Beasts / "Dogs" / Camberwains (Hostile local fauna) Marduk Port Authority personnel Important developments in the PJs' lives or the campaign: The group manages to contact rescue and survive Marduk's hostile environment, eventually reaching the Downport. The existence of native human populations on Marduk's continents is confirmed, something the port authorities were unaware of or believed impossible. The next immediate step is established: contact Jonny Belen in the port's underbelly. Loose ends: The fate of Emilia and her tribe, who decided to stay in the ruins despite the danger of the beasts and the offer of help. The confirmed identity of the original ship's attackers (slavers or Oghma Barbarians are suspected, and Finan plans to join a class action lawsuit). Den (Nemo)'s attempt to recruit or gain the loyalty of the survivors (Karim, Finan) through a pending dinner. The Decision in the Darkness PCs present: Lyra Vance, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fu, Den (Nemo). NPCs present: Emilia (Protective tribal leader), Karim (Pragmatic ally), Finan, Evan. Location(s): Ruins in the jungle (Planet Marduk). Ship(s): None. Scene summary: The group discusses the best strategy for calling for rescue. They are sheltering in some ruins in the night rain, surrounded by predatory beasts. They try to convince Emilia and the natives to leave with them towards an area with signal coverage, but the natives, wounded and distrustful, prefer to fortify themselves in the shelter. Karim supports the PCs' plan to leave. Finally, they decide to leave the natives behind with some chemical lights and leave as a group (Lyra, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fu, Den, Karim, Finan, and Evan) towards a nearby elevated mound to try to contact the rescue shuttle. The Ascent and the Ambush PCs present: Lyra Vance, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fu, Den (Nemo). NPCs present: Wise Beasts/Camberwains (Stealthy and lethal predators). Location(s): Elevated mound in the Ruins (Planet Marduk). Ship(s): None. Scene summary: Under a light rain and in the dim light, the group reaches a ruined building or mound about 6-7 meters high. Jimmy and Kleiton begin to climb to get a signal with their communicators, while the rest stand guard below. Kleiton detects movement, but is ambushed by a beast that jumps on him while he is climbing. Chaos erupts: Kleiton fires and falls into the void (managing to roll to avoid damage), while below multiple beasts attack the group. Combat in the Mud PCs present: Lyra Vance, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fu, Den (Nemo). NPCs present: Karim (Armed combatant), Evan (Attacked dog), Wise Beasts/Camberwains. Location(s): Base of the mound (Planet Marduk). Ship(s): None. Scene summary: Frenetic hand-to-hand and close-quarters combat ensues. Lyra is seriously wounded by a bite to the shoulder but manages to take down a beast with precise shots. Yankee Fu tries to immobilize a beast by jumping on it, but is thrown against a wall, sustaining injuries. Den (Nemo) fights with an axe, protecting his companions and trying to heal Lyra in the middle of the fray. Kleiton and Jimmy fire from their positions, managing to burn and wound several enemies. Karim is knocked down but continues to fire. After an intense firefight and struggle, they manage to kill or drive away the remaining creatures. Rescue and Arrival at Port PCs present: Lyra Vance, Jimmy, Kleiton, Yankee Fu, Den (Nemo). NPCs present: Port Authority personnel. Location(s): Open area in the jungle and Downport (Planet Marduk). Ship(s): Rescue Shuttle (Model unknown, Port Authority). Scene summary: Jimmy manages to contact the rescue shuttle, which instructs them to move to an open area for landing. The group runs towards the extraction point, leaving the ruins behind. Once on board, the pilot is surprised by the mention of native inhabitants on the continent. The group is transported to Marduk's Downport, where they receive medical attention. Den (Nemo) suggests organizing a dinner for the survivors, while Jimmy remembers that they need to look for their contact, Jonny Belen, in the port's underbelly. Finan mentions his intention to claim legal compensation against Oghma.

title: 49 - PoD - Nuevos comienzos
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript. Business, Particle Barbettes, and Fish in Marduk PCs present: Yankee Fu, Paloma (Lyra), Jimmy, Nemo, Phoenix Corbin. NPCs present: Karin, Finan, Clayton, Johnny Belem, Rica Holloway, Paramedics, Fishmonger. Important developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: A vital shipment for the reconstruction of Drinax has been secured: two imperial particle barbettes. A commercial cover has been established by purchasing local fish to justify the cargo on the ship.    Karin has been recruited as a crew member (Communications/Sensors) for the Ginger*. The group rejects an immediate transport assignment from GD Corp to prioritize returning to Drinax, though they keep the door open for future intelligence work. Loose ends / Pending items: Sarcomond Mortgage: Jimmy's ship has received non-payment notices, and they are claiming against the former captain, Daniel Blau. GD Corp Missing Persons: Chief Engineer Klaug Bougie and Karin's brother, Lamor Lukowiak, are still missing (presumed kidnapped by Oghma raiders).    King Oleb's Offer: A "big business" and a deal that King Oleb XVI has prepared for the PCs in Drinax, which includes full ownership of the ship Ginger*, is mentioned. Stopover in Torpol: Jimmy fears being detained in the Torpol system for past incidents; Nemo will help him forge documents or use diplomacy. Scene 1: Triage and Bad News PCs present: Yankee Fu, Paloma (Lyra). NPCs present: Karin (Concerned sister, potential recruit; electronics/communications expert), GD Corp Paramedics, Shuttle Pilot. Location: Downport (Planet Marduk). Ships: Downpour of Marduk (Shuttle), Ginger (Far Trader, Captain Lyra/Paloma). Summary: Following the shuttle accident/attack, survivors are transferred to the Downport hospital in Marduk. Yankee Fu and the ship's dog receive treatment for serious injuries (bites), while Paloma and Karin are treated for minor contusions. During the transfer, Karin checks her phone and discovers that her brother, Lamor Lukowiak, an employee of Highport, is among those kidnapped by Oghma raiders. Paloma attempts to find information online about the missing persons but confirms that the chances of recovering them without paying ransom or going after them are nil. Scene 2: The Corporate Offer PCs present: Paloma (Lyra), Yankee Fu. NPCs present: Rica Holloway (General Development Company - GD Corp Executive; Archetype: Pragmatic Corporate), Karin. Location: Hospital Room, Downport (Planet Marduk). Summary: Rica Holloway visits the injured to apologize for the incident on behalf of GD Corp. She explains that the attackers stole robotics, electronics, and kidnapped key personnel, including their chief engineer. As they have no jump-capable ships available, she offers the PCs a contract: 20,000 credits to transport her assistant, Elena Markoib, to GD Corp's port in Oghma. Additionally, she offers an intelligence contract: 100,000 credits for orbital information about Oghma and up to 500,000 credits for information obtained on the surface. Paloma shows interest but does not commit immediately. Scene 3: Johnny Belem's Stash PCs present: Jimmy, Phoenix Corbin. NPCs present: Johnny Belem (Criminal contact/Smuggler; Archetype: Low-level but effective smuggler). Location: Basement Bar and a Farm on the Continent (Planet Marduk). Ships: Sarcomond (Unknown Model, Captain Jimmy/Daniel Blau). Summary: Jimmy and Phoenix meet with Johnny Belem, an old contact. Belem takes them to an isolated farm where he is hiding the merchandise destined for Drinax: two 5-ton crates containing imperial-stamped Particle Barbettes, "fallen off a truck" (stolen from a supply ship). Jimmy buys ammunition and a ballistic vest (Flak Jacket) for Phoenix. Belem warns that getting this military merchandise off the planet will be complicated and suggests using the post-attack chaos to their advantage. Scene 4: Dinner and Planning PCs present: All (Yankee Fu, Paloma, Jimmy, Nemo, Phoenix Corbin). NPCs present: Johnny Belem (briefly), Karin (at the end), Finan. Location: Restaurant/Bar near the Spaceport (Planet Marduk). Summary: The group meets for dinner after being discharged from the hospital (Yankee and Paloma are still recovering but stable). Jimmy reports on the particle barbettes and the urgency of taking them to Drinax to fulfill King Oleb's request. The decision of whether to accept GD Corp's job is debated. Ultimately, they decide to decline the passenger transport to Oghma to avoid losing time but verbally accept the intelligence contract for the future. They plan to land the Ginger near the farm (illegally) to load the barbettes. To cover the operation from the authorities and justify the cargo, Paloma arranges the purchase of 40 tons of local fish at a low cost as legitimate commercial merchandise. Scene 5: Recruitment and Departure PCs present: Paloma, Jimmy, Nemo. NPCs present: Karin. Location: Outside the Restaurant/Streets of Downport (Planet Marduk). Ships: Ginger (Far Trader), Sarcomond. Summary: Paloma informs Rica Holloway that they cannot take her assistant due to a commercial urgency in another direction but remain interested in the espionage mission. Paloma convinces Karin to join the crew of the Ginger, promising her that the work in Drinax will provide the means to eventually search for her brother. For the return journey, it is decided that the Ginger will carry the weapons and the fish, while the Sarcomond will travel in parallel. Nemo offers to travel in the Sarcomond with Jimmy to help him navigate the legal and blockade issues expected in the Torpol system, using his diplomatic and forgery skills.

title: 50 - PoD - Una oferta Real
content: The Price of the Crown and the Siege of Drinax PCs present Lyra Vance Jimmy Nemo / Yankee Corben NPCs present Karin Goran Dragic Pika Jefa Galks King Oleb XVI Lord Drax Sergeant Britolar Ben Parr Clayton Walter Ondo (Confirmation of death) Main developments in the lives of the PCs or the campaign    Officially Pirates: King Oleb XVI grants the PCs a Letter of Marque*. Their mandate officially changes: they must raid interstellar trade to finance the reconstruction of Drinax and force its political recognition.    The Sacrifice: The destruction of the ship Banshee* and the death of Walter Ondo along with his crew in a suicidal act to protect allies on the surface is confirmed.    State of War: Drinax is under martial law and blockaded by Aslan Ihatei* fighters. Loose ends Family Rescue: Karin's brother remains kidnapped by pirates on Oghma. Criminal Debt: Nemo owes 120,000 credits to an anagathics dealer on Drinax. Vespexer Logistics: A meeting with Princess Rao is pending to organize aid supply to the surface tribes. Session Gag    The Space Wolf of Wall Street: Ben Parr, a crew member with delusions of financial grandeur, tries to explain to the crew of the Sarcomond* how to apply absurd stock market theories to violent ship boarding, confusing everyone with his economic jargon in the midst of a criminal life. New Faces and Old Vices PCs present: Lyra Vance, Nemo, Jimmy, Corben NPCs present: Karin (New recruit, young and determined - The Apprentice), Clayton (Pilot of The Ginger), Ben Parr (Speculator pirate - The Jester). Location: Spaceport (Marduk) Ships: The Ginger (Far Trader, Captain Lyra Vance), Sarcomond (Asimite Ship, Captain Jimmy) Scene Summary: Before departing Marduk, the group consolidates its forces. They recruit Karin, a communications expert who joins motivated to save her brother. Lyra tries to foster cohesion within The Ginger's crew through social activities (cooking and cinema), seeking to lift Nemo's spirits. On the Sarcomond, Jimmy and Corben manage their undisciplined group of pirates, while Nemo falsifies ship documentation and Ben Parr shares his surreal economic theories. Echoes from the Surface PCs present: None (Narration of past events) NPCs present: Pika (Survivor diplomat), Goran Dragic (Survivor soldier), Jefa Galks (Tribal leader, old and tough - The Matriarch), Walter Ondo (Ambitious botanist - The Martyr). Location: Vespexer Settlements (Drinax / Surface) Scene Summary: The events that occurred weeks ago on the surface of Drinax are revealed. The diplomatic team (Pika, Goran, and Ondo) achieved an initial agreement with Jefa Galks, offering technology in exchange for loyalty. However, facing an imminent Aslan attack, Walter Ondo made the unilateral decision to use the Banshee to intercept the enemies, sacrificing himself in an explosion that saved the others but destroyed the ship and ended his life. Shadows in the Gas Giant PCs present: Lyra Vance, Nemo, Jimmy, Corben NPCs present: Crews of The Ginger and Sarcomond. Location: Gas Giant (Torpol System) Ships: The Ginger (Far Trader, Captain Lyra Vance), Sarcomond (Asimite Ship, Captain Jimmy) Scene Summary: The flotilla arrives in the Torpol system. To avoid authorities' attention due to the Sarcomond's illegal status, they avoid the main station and perform a refueling maneuver (scooping) in a peripheral gas giant. During the tense wait, Lyra instructs Nemo on Drinax court protocol, reviewing the personalities of Lady Hil and Princess Rao to avoid diplomatic incidents upon their arrival. Breaking the Blockade PCs present: Lyra Vance, Nemo, Jimmy, Corben NPCs present: Crews. Location: Deep Space (Drinax System) Ships: The Ginger (Far Trader, Captain Lyra Vance), Sarcomond (Asimite Ship, Captain Jimmy), Aslan Scout Ship (Scout 100t, Enemy). Scene Summary: Upon jumping into the Drinax system, the ships are immediately detected by the Aslan blockade. An enemy scout ship ambushes them. Lyra coordinates the tactical sensors to guide shots, while Nemo and Corben operate the defensive turrets. Despite the enemy's evasive maneuvers, the combined firepower of the Sarcomond and The Ginger manages to disable and destroy the Aslan ship, allowing the group to advance towards the planet, which is revealed to be riddled with enemy signals. War Audience and Letter of Marque PCs present: Lyra Vance, Jimmy, Nemo, Corben NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (King of Drinax, wounded, in partial armor - The Warrior King), Lord Drax (Head of the Guard - The Loyal Protector), Sergeant Britolar (Star Guard). Location: Floating Palace / War Room (Drinax) Scene Summary: The characters land on a Floating Palace marked by the siege and are brought before King Oleb. The monarch has converted a game room into his tactical operations center. After confirming Ondo's death with regret (which elicits visible anger from Jimmy), Oleb shifts the tone to a solemn and martial one. He grants the characters the Letter of Marque, legalizing their criminal activities under the banner of Drinax. He entrusts them with the vital mission of strangling galactic trade to finance the survival and rebirth of the kingdom.

title: 51 - PoD - Corsarios de Drinax
content: War Diplomacy and New Horizons PCs present: Goran, Pika, Yankee Foo, PJ of Nemo (Diplomat). NPCs present: Princess Rao, King Oleb XVI (mentioned), Bogdan Stulik, Megar, Provost Shala, Crew of The Ginger (Lyra, Korven, Clayton), Jimmy (mentioned). Main developments:    The possession of the recovered Aslan ship, renamed Maui*, is legalized under Drinax's flag as war booty. A strong alliance is established with the Clarke system, securing logistical and communication support. A strategic plan is devised to divide the group into two fronts: one to the North (Blue and Cordan) and another to the South (Paal and Byrni) to gather resources and allies for the war against the Aslan.    The Imperatrix* begins to be re-equipped with heavy weaponry and fighter bays. Loose ends: The covert operation contracted to mercenaries to kidnap the scientist from Torpol. The analysis of "Martin II" commercial data to gain an advantage in negotiations in Blue. The delivery of Fermin's inheritance in the Sperle system. The potential hiring of mercenaries from the Glorious Empire. Preparations at Court and Legalization PCs present: Goran, Pika, PJ of Nemo. NPCs present: Juan (GM), Megar (Courtier with artistic aspirations/Documentarian). Location: Floating Palace (Drinax). Ships: Maui (Aslan ship, legalized). The group manages the bureaucracy to legalize the stolen Aslan ship, now named Maui, declaring it war booty from the Ihatei attacks. While planning the diplomatic route, Pika contacts Megar, a courtier fond of recordings, to produce war propaganda and document Drinax's efforts to boost the kingdom's morale and reputation. A local pilot, spurned after a breakup, is hired to fly the Maui. Cold Reception at the Port PCs present: Goran, Pika. NPCs present: Provosts of Torpol, Provost Shala (Local leader/Scientist). Location: Torpol (Torpol System). Ships: Talassa (Former imperial cruiser without a jump drive, used as static defense). The PCs travel to Torpol seeking a military alliance. The Provosts, living in a bubble of security thanks to their orbital cruiser, are indifferent to the Aslan threat, considering it an external problem. They refuse to offer direct military aid, though they grant credit lines with unfavorable interest rates. Provost Shala hints that she could influence the others if Drinax helps repair the Talassa's jump drive (an unfeasible cost of 6,000 MCr). Goran and Pika decide not to commit and depart with almost empty hands. Old Comrades and Black Operations PCs present: Goran, Pika. NPCs present: Psychopomps (Religious leaders/Guides of the dead), Bogdan Stulik (Veteran mercenary, former officer, Ally of Goran). Location: Clarke (Clarke System), Local Bar (Gothic/Symphonic Metal atmosphere). In Clarke, the reception is much warmer. The religious leaders (Psychopomps) fear the Aslan and agree to establish military communications and support Drinax. Goran meets with his old ally, Bogdan Stulik. Stulik, now the leader of a small elite commando, offers information about Cordan, a world divided by warlords where military support could be obtained by breaking the status quo. Goran hires Bogdan (for 2 MCr after a discount for friendship) for a covert operation: to kidnap the scientist from Torpol and bring her to Drinax to force that system's collaboration in the future. The War Council and the Fleet Division PCs present: Goran, Pika, Yankee Foo, PJ of Nemo. NPCs present: Princess Rao, Lyra, Korven, Clayton (Crew of The Ginger). Location: Meeting Room (Drinax). Ships: The Ginger (Fleet ship), Imperatrix (Battleship under repair). Back in Drinax, the group meets with Princess Rao and the crew of the ship The Ginger. Advances are reported: the Imperatrix is being armed with particle barbettes and modified cargo bays for fighters. After debating options (including the risky idea of hiring mercenaries from the Glorious Empire or using stolen commercial data to pressure Blue), it is decided to split forces to cover more ground: 1.  Northern Group: The crew of The Ginger (with Paloma/NPCs) will go to Blue to negotiate the purchase of fighters (using a Broker) and possibly to Cordan. 2.  Southern Group: Goran, Pika, and PJ of Nemo will take the Maui towards Paal and Byrni. In Paal they will attempt diplomacy (perhaps offering scientists) and in Byrni they will try to convince the paladins that King Oleb is the legitimate heir to the Sindal Empire.

title: 52 - PoD - Abriendo Puertas
content: Here is the session summary in the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Divided Diplomacy: From Blue to Pal PCs present    Captain Lyra Vance (Paloma): Captain of the Ginger*.    Kleiton (Jimmy/Juan): Pilot of the Ginger*.    Goran Dragic (Fomega): Marine of the Ginger*.    Nemo/Corben (Segundo): Self-proclaimed captain of the Maui*.    Pika (Emilio): Navigator/Engineer of the Maui*.    Yankee Foo (Nacho): Pilot/Passenger of the Maui*.    Jimmy: Separates from the group at the start to go on the Sarcomond*. NPCs present Purne Customs Agents (Officials, archetype of Men in Black Bureaucrats). Blue Arms Corporation Executives (Businessmen, archetype of Corporate Board). Members of the Greyhide Movement in Pal (Concerned civilians, archetype of Grassroots Resistance). Fermín (Mentioned crew member, his money is used by Goran). Main plot development and reconstruction of the Kingdom of Drinax The group divides into two expeditions to cover more diplomatic and commercial ground.    The Ginger* expedition (Lyra, Kleiton, Goran) achieves resounding success in Blue, establishing an agreement for combat fighters and technological collaboration, thus securing vital military strength for Drinax.    The Maui* expedition (Nemo, Pika, Yankee) travels to Pal to seek allies. Although they manage to sow unease about the Aslan threat through the media, they discover that to win the favor of the local nobles they need to bribe them with specific luxury goods and technology, postponing the mission's success. The foundations for a trade network are laid, purchasing weaponry and electronics in Blue to sell on less technologically advanced worlds like Cordan. Loose ends Jimmy's personal mission, where he separates to pick up Bogdan Stolich in Clark and meet Krrsh, with arrangements to reunite with the group later. The need to obtain luxury goods (gravitational cars, advanced computers) to bribe the leaders of the city-states of Pal (Duke Mikes and King Ear). The mysterious Greyhide Movement in Pal, which requests machinery to manufacture illegal weapons. The final meeting of both ships scheduled in the Cordan system. Preparations and Farewell PCs present: All. NPCs present: None direct. Location: Drinax (Drinax/Drinax System). Ships: The Ginger (Harrier, Captain Lyra), The Maui (Aslan cargo ship, Captain Nemo), Sarcomond (Mentioned, Jimmy). Summary: The group plans the logistics for the coming weeks. They decide to divide into two teams: Lyra, Kleiton, and Goran will go to Blue via Clark in the Ginger; while Nemo, Pika, and Yankee will go to Pal via Purne in the Maui. Jimmy bids farewell to carry out his own mission with the Vespexers and pick up a contact. The state of the Maui, an Aslan ship valued at 90 million but with strange interiors (shrines, controls in another language) and bloodstains that Pika must clean, is discussed. Goran uses some of Fermín's "inheritance" money to finance operations. Bureaucracy on the Frontier PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Yankee Foo. NPCs present: Customs Agents (Men in gray suits and smoked glasses, suspicious officials). Location: Purne Spaceport (Purne/Purne System). Ships: The Maui (Aslan cargo ship, Captain Nemo). Summary: The Maui arrives in Purne, a police and bureaucratic world. Upon landing, they are interrogated in a room by agents who suspect an empty Aslan ship. Yankee Foo tries to pose as an important diplomat with little patience, which tenses the situation. Nemo intervenes using his diplomatic skills, claiming a secret mission related to the war in Drinax and the Ihatei threat. They manage to convince the agents, who take notes, concerned about the geopolitical situation, and they are allowed to refuel and depart without being detained, though they confirm that Purne is a difficult place to get quick support. Stopover on the Graveyard World PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Goran. NPCs present: Missionaries/Psychopomps (Religious figures who freeze people, background). Location: Clark Spaceport (Clark/Clark System). Ships: The Ginger (Harrier, Captain Lyra). Summary: The Ginger makes a stopover in Clark. They are received amicably thanks to the previous alliance; they receive free fuel and good treatment. They observe the peculiar local culture, where "Psychopomps" freeze pilgrims (some alive) in carbonite for the future. They use the travel time and stay to prepare audiovisual material (images of the attack on Drinax) and study technical data for their presentation in Blue. They buy local themed food (incense and "funeral hits") before departing. Agitation in the City-States PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Yankee Foo. NPCs present: Members of the Greyhide Movement (Local partisans, followers of Prince Richard Greyhide). Location: Surface and Spaceport of Pal (Pal/Pal System). Ships: The Maui (Aslan cargo ship, Captain Nemo). Summary: In Pal, the team encounters a world fragmented into city-states without a central government and with great paranoia towards the Aslans. Nemo conducts a media tour, appearing on television to warn about the Ihatei invasion and the need to support Drinax, gaining some popularity. Yankee and Pika investigate and discover that the local nobles are frivolous and will only support the cause in exchange for specific technological gifts (luxury cars, computers). Nemo attends a barbecue/meeting of the Greyhide Movement, a group of concerned citizens who cannot offer ships or money, but request machinery to manufacture weapons and resist. Lacking the necessary bribes for the nobles at that moment, they decide to depart for Byrni and Cordan. The Fighter Jet Deal PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Goran. NPCs present: Board of Directors of the Arms Corporation (Business executives). Location: Corporate meeting room at the Spaceport (Blue/Blue System). Ships: The Ginger (Harrier, Captain Lyra). Summary: The team arrives in Blue, a high-tech corporate world. They secure a meeting with the fighter jet manufacturing company. Lyra, supported by Kleiton (providing technical pilot knowledge) and Goran (military tactics), gives a masterful presentation. They show images of the war and, crucially, they not only offer money but advanced technology from the Tower of the Scholars of Drinax, trade routes, and technical training. The negotiation roll is a critical success. They agree on the shipment of fighter jets, the establishment of a training campus, and improve diplomatic relations. They take advantage of the visit to purchase 10 tons of advanced weaponry and 40 tons of common electronics for trade at their next destination.

title: 53 - PoD - Extendiendo el brazo
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format: Dangerous Alliances and Hidden Cargo PCs present Felix Korven (Nemo), Yankee Fu (Nacho), Pika, Goran Draghi (Emilio), Lyra (Paloma), Clayton (Juan), Fomega. NPCs present Kira (Star Guard Anti-Spin), Tolis de Byrni (Regent of Byrni), Larisa Clark (Mercenary Contact/Ex-mercenary), Byrni Officers. Major Developments in PCs' or Campaign Lives    The Maui* group secures a military alliance with Byrni, convincing the Regent that King Oleb is the true heir to the Sindal Empire. Regent Tolis insists on traveling personally to Drinax to meet Oleb, causing panic among the PCs due to the King's erratic behavior.    The Ginger* group achieves a massive profit (1.2 million credits) by selling electronics on Tanith.    The Ginger* group accepts a transport mission for Baroness Lux of Cordan as a test for a larger job. Loose Ends King Oleb must be prepared (or controlled) before the Byrni delegation arrives to avoid a diplomatic disaster. The actual contents of the 10 tons of cargo being transported to Cordan are unknown. The nature of the "real" mission on Cordan remains a mystery until the cargo is delivered.    The repair of the Ginger*'s maneuvering thruster was a botched or temporary fix (though it later seems to have been permanently repaired with parts). Memories of Blue and Mid-Route Repairs PCs present: Goran, Lyra, Clayton, Fomega. NPCs present: None directly mentioned in scene. Location: Deep space / Blue Markets (Blue Planet/System) / Arunisiir (Arunisiir Planet/System). Ships: Ginger (Banshee/Sindal Model, Captain Goran Draghi). Scene Summary A brief flashback occurs to their time on Blue, where Lyra bought gifts for the crew (cigars, handicrafts, an easel for Goran, and Coporoto coffee) and combat training software. Subsequently, the ship jumps to the Arunisiir system. There, they land at the spacelane for repairs. They purchase spare parts, and working as a team, Fomega and Lyra manage to repair a loose wire in the maneuvering thruster, fixing the ship's critical problem. They also hear news about Banshee attacks on imperial ships, which worries them due to the description of their own ship. Welcome to the Anti-Spin Guard PCs present: Felix Korven, Yankee Fu, Pika. NPCs present: Kira (Star Guard Officer, disciplined soldier archetype, space "Roman"), Byrni Officers. Location: Byrni Orbital Station (Byrni System). Ships: Maui (Unknown Model, Pilot Yankee Fu), Kezer's Aurora (Patrol ship, Sindalite design). Scene Summary The Maui arrives in the Byrni system and is intercepted by the Kezer's Aurora. They are boarded by soldiers in old but functional Battle Dress. Kira, of the Anti-Spin Star Guard, reviews their diplomatic credentials. They are escorted to an orbital station that resembles a living museum of the old Sindal Empire: iron discipline, anachronistic aesthetics, and a rejection of cybernetic implants ("purity of the body"). During a dinner with officers, the PCs discover that Byrni considers itself loyal to the Sindal Emperor (even though he doesn't exist) and views pirates and Aslan as distant threats. Yankee Fu (Nacho) improvises a uniform with medals and "official pilot" patches to impress. The Audience with the Regent PCs present: Felix Korven, Yankee Fu, Pika. NPCs present: Tolis de Byrni (Regent and Lord Commander, elderly, serious, "Believer/Crusader" archetype). Location: War Room / Bridge of the Station (Byrni System). Ships: None. Scene Summary The PCs are received by Regent Tolis. Felix Korven (Nemo) deploys his diplomatic skills, appealing to historical brotherhood and the Aslan threat. Yankee Fu tells (embellished) stories of heroic combat against savages. Felix completely convinces Tolis that King Oleb XVI is the legitimate heir to Sindal. Tolis, excited like a religious fanatic, promises military aid but announces he will travel personally to Drinax to swear loyalty to the "Emperor." The PCs, terrified of how Oleb might behave, decide to rush back to Drinax to prepare. Tolis assigns them an escort. Technical Stop and Forward Escape PCs present: Felix Korven, Yankee Fu, Pika. NPCs present: Escort Captain (Radio voice). Location: Purne Gas Giant (Purne System). Ships: Maui, Torpol's Wake (Patrol Corvette/Escort). Scene Summary The Maui group begins their return journey. They make a stop on Purne. To avoid spacelane bureaucracy and save time, Felix convinces the escort (Torpol's Wake) to refuel at the gas giant, citing haste and "training" for the pilot. The escort reluctantly agrees and monitors the maneuver. After refueling, they jump towards Drinax, arriving a week before the other group at their destination. Business in Port Tanith PCs present: Goran, Lyra, Clayton, Fomega. NPCs present: Local inhabitants and stevedores. Location: Highport "Borderland Prime" / Port bars (Tanith System). Ships: Ginger. Scene Summary The Ginger arrives at Tanith, an aquatic world with a varied technological level. While the ship is in the Highport, Lyra and Fomega go down to the bars to gather information about their next destination, Cordan. They discover that Cordan is a feudal agricultural world with three barons (Lux, Fero, and Halley) and that Baroness Lux is importing technology for the populace, which is unusual. Taking advantage of the local market, Lyra manages to sell the cargo of common electronics for an exorbitant price (1.2 million credits), clearing the group's finances. The Mercenary's Contract PCs present: Goran, Lyra. NPCs present: Larisa Clark (Contact, 50-60 year old woman, unkempt but dangerous appearance, "Hardened Veteran" archetype). Location: Bar in Pilcoe City (Tanith System). Ships: None. Scene Summary Goran and Lyra go down to Pilcoe City, a city full of mercenaries, to meet their contact, Larisa Clark. She evaluates them and offers them a job for a client (Baroness Lux of Cordan). They are looking for a small group with resources and initiative to operate behind enemy lines. As an initial test, they must transport 10 tons of boxes "no questions asked" to Cordan. If they succeed, the real mission will be revealed. The group accepts and prepares to jump to Cordan.

title: 54 - PoD - Conflicto Cordan + La Llama se apaga 01
url: /en/pirates-of-drinax/54 - PoD - Conflicto Cordan + La Llama se apaga 01 - eng
content: Fire on Drinax and Shadows on Cordan PCs present Nemo Pika (Emilio) Yankee (Nacho) Lyra (Paloma) Goran Kleiton NPCs present Bri Tolar (Star Guard Sergeant) Baroness Lux (Ruler of Cordan) Baroness's Butler Air traffic control and security personnel Important Developments in the PCs' Lives or the Campaign    Siege of Drinax: The PCs' home planet is under blockade and attack by Aslan (Ihatei) forces. Planetary defenses have fallen to enemy hands and the Torpol’s Wake* (ally ship) has been destroyed, though its crew escaped in lifeboats. Conspiracy on Cordan: The group of Lyra, Goran, and Kleiton has been hired by Baroness Lux to destabilize her political rivals (Baron Fero and Baron Halley) by assassinating a tax collector and inciting a civil revolt. Loose Ends The success of the infiltration mission planned by Yankee to recover the meson cannon on Drinax. The exact whereabouts of Princess Rao, who fled in search of help. The execution of Josefus Agraki's assassination in Cordan and its repercussions.    The survival of the crew from the Torpol’s Wake*'s lifeboat. Scene 1: Return to Hell PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Yankee. NPCs present: Voices of the Torpol’s Wake (Allies in distress), Aslan/Ihatei Communications (Enemies). Location(s): Deep Space / Orbit (Drinax System). Ship(s): Maui (Freighter/Adventurer, PCs), Torpol’s Wake (Patrol Corvette, Ally), Iki and other Aslan ships (Warships and fighters, Enemies). Scene Summary The group aboard the Maui returns to the Drinax system expecting a safe zone but finds a war-torn scene. Sensors detect wreckage from recent battles and an Aslan (Ihatei) fleet blockading the planet. The escort ship Torpol’s Wake, which arrived shortly before, is under attack by a swarm of fighters. Despite the critical situation, the PCs decide to prioritize reaching the surface of Drinax and avoid direct combat, as their ship is not military. The Torpol’s Wake is destroyed, but they manage to launch a lifeboat. The Maui successfully lands at the Floating Palace, evading the blockade. Scene 2: Landing on Cordan and Bureaucracy PCs present: Lyra, Goran, Kleiton. NPCs present: Camadan Control (Spaceport official). Location(s): Orbit and Camadan Spaceport (Planet Cordan / Borderland System). Ship(s): PCs' Ship (Freighter). Scene Summary The second group arrives in the Cordan system. They contact Camadan spaceport control and request permission to land directly within Baroness Lux's domain, citing a cargo shipment. They are warned about the necessity of vaccination due to local atmospheric pathogens. The PCs proceed with vaccinations and use the time to research the planet's sociopolitical situation: an agricultural world with a low technological level (1950s appearance), divided into three baronies (Lux, Fero, and Halley). Scene 3: Gathering Information in the Bars PCs present: Lyra, Goran, Kleiton. NPCs present: Locals and Travelers (Incidental informants). Location(s): Bars and Spaceport (Planet Cordan). Scene Summary While waiting, the characters investigate rumors. They discover that Baroness Lux has gained popularity by investing in her people's health, while Baron Halley runs a police state and is suffering trade sanctions from the Empire (possibly unfair or fabricated). Baron Fero and Halley have territorial disputes. The general population lives a simple, agricultural life, with border tensions between the baronies. Scene 4: The Baroness's Proposal PCs present: Lyra, Goran, Kleiton. NPCs present: Baroness Lux (Local noble, calculating and ambitious), Butler (Formal servant), Villa Guards (Soldiers). Location(s): Lux's Baronial Halls / Baroness's Villa (Planet Cordan). Scene Summary After being housed in luxury at Baroness Lux's villa, the PCs dine with her. Lux reveals her fear of an alliance between Barons Fero and Halley to overthrow her. She proposes a dirty job: assassinate Josefus Agraki, a tax collector for Baron Halley who is hated by the people, in a disputed border area. The goal is not only to eliminate him but to incite a popular revolt and provoke an armed conflict between Fero and Halley, causing them to weaken each other, allowing Lux to consolidate power without direct Imperial intervention. The PCs discuss cover stories (agricultural merchants) to infiltrate the area. Scene 5: Situation Report and Infiltration Plan PCs present: Nemo, Pika, Yankee. NPCs present: Bri Tolar (Star Guard Sergeant, Exhausted Guard/Soldier). Location(s): Floating Palace Spaceport (Planet Drinax). Scene Summary Now on the ground, Bri Tolar greets the PCs and briefs them on the catastrophe: the Aslans have launched a massive attack, the Imperatrix and other defenses are hidden or destroyed. Most critically, the invaders have taken control of ground defenses, including a meson cannon, preventing safe movement in orbit. Princess Rao has fled and Prince Harrik is in hiding. King Oleb is in the palace, in a very bad mood. Yankee proposes a bold plan: lead an infiltration team with Bespexers (inhabitants of the lower levels) to hack or disable the meson cannon, while Nemo attempts to manage diplomacy with the King.

title: 55 - PoD - La Corte de las cenizas
url: /en/pirates-of-drinax/55 - PoD - La Corte de las cenizas - eng
content: Here is a summary of the session based on the provided transcript, following the requested format and restrictions. Session: The Siege of Drinax and the Ash Alliance PCs present: Pika (Emilio) Phoenix Corven (Nemo) Yankee (Nacho) NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (King of Drinax, depressed at the start, then motivated. Smokes cigars and is surrounded by screens.) Captain Brie / Bri Tolar (Star Guard/Hawk, competent and loyal officer.) Rachado (Bazaar merchant, dark skin, mustache, sells illegal or restricted technology.) Thao Polloc (Imperial Consul, wears a pink ruffled robe, painted face, runes on forehead, pessimistic and dramatic.)    Captain Gawain Dunkel (Captain of the Torpol's Wake*, solemn and pompous.) Lady Hil (Courtesan, childhood rival of Phoenix, wears mourning with a black veil and holographic tear tattoos. Archetype: The Dramatic Lady/Organizer.) Ondo's Nephew (Vespexer, attentive to the plants in Worm's Belly.) Campaign Development and Long-Term Objectives: The situation in Drinax: The planet is under blockade by an Aslan fleet (Ihatei). Planetary defenses have fallen, and the Floating Palace has lost control of them, forcing the King to hide. The coalition: It is confirmed that a Byrni fleet is on its way, led by the Regent. The PCs are coordinating this fleet along with forces from Clarke, Blue, and the remnants of Torpol for a synchronized counterattack. The immediate plan: Regain control of planetary defenses through an infiltration mission to protect the Palace and support the arrival of the allied fleet. Loose Ends: The success of the surface infiltration mission to hack/recover the ancient defenses. The precise coordination of the fleets (Byrni, Clarke, Blue) to arrive simultaneously; if the timing fails, they could be destroyed separately. The "party" or reception that Lady Hil is organizing to impress the Byrni allies. Scene 1: Back to Hell PCs present: All. NPCs present: None (interaction with enemy ships). Location: Drinax system space and high orbit. Ships: Maui (PCs' Yacht), Torpol's Wake (Destroyed), Ikilansioso (Aslan Ekaosikuya-class escort), Ihatei ships (Fighters and modified freighters). Summary: The PCs return to the Drinax system to find it under siege. Their escort ship, the Torpol's Wake, is intercepted and destroyed by Aslan fighters, though its lifeboat manages to escape. The Maui is pursued by two enemy ships but manages to land at the Floating Palace. It is revealed that the Imperatrix (the stolen flagship) participated in the battle but had to hide after suffering damage, and that the planetary defenses were taken by the Aslans. Scene 2: Audience with the Ash King PCs present: Phoenix Corven. NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (Apparently apathetic, "King of Ashes," surrounded by smoke and screens). Location: Royal Chambers (Floating Palace, Drinax). Summary: Phoenix meets with King Oleb, who is demoralized and hiding, feeling like a powerless king. Phoenix uses their diplomatic skills and appeals to the King's ego and Sindalite honor, informing him of the arrival of the Byrni fleet and the Regent himself. They manage to rouse Oleb from his stupor, convincing him that he must act as an Emperor to receive his allies and prepare for the counteroffensive. Oleb reports that his daughter, Princess Rao, is in Clarke coordinating aid and that Prince Harrik is with Lord Drax on the Imperatrix. Scene 3: Logistics and Black Market PCs present: Pika, Yankee. NPCs present: Contacts at the Tower, Rachado (Bazaar Merchant, "fixer"). Location: The Tower (University) and The Bazaar (Floating Palace). Summary: While Phoenix is with the King, Pika goes to the Tower to get advice on military communications and intrusion software for the defense assault. Yankee goes to the Bazaar and finds Rachado, a foreign merchant. Yankee acquires espionage equipment, drones, a radiation-resistant computer, and material cutting tools, all under the guise of "work for the King." Rachado promises to procure scent inhibitors to fool the Aslans. Scene 4: The Prophet of the Apocalypse PCs present: Pika, Yankee. NPCs present: Thao Polloc (Imperial Consul, extravagant and fatalistic). Location: An alley near the Bazaar (Floating Palace). Summary: Upon leaving their errands, Pika and Yankee are approached by Thao Polloc. The consul is terrified, convinced that the Aslans will destroy everything and that they are doomed. Pika tries to calm him and suggests he use his channels to call for help, but Polloc insists the blockade is total. Pika assures him that a plan is underway, leaving him with his despair and his imperial perfumes. Scene 5: Worm's Belly Incursion PCs present: Phoenix, Yankee. NPCs present: Vespexer Leaders, Ondo's Nephew. Location: Worm's Belly (Drinax surface), a settlement made from ship debris and anti-radiation materials. Vehicles: Flyer/Grav-car (PCs' vehicle). Summary: Phoenix and Yankee descend to the surface in a grav-car. On the way, they dodge a rocket fired by an unknown vehicle. Upon arriving at the Vespexer settlement "Worm's Belly," Phoenix gives a passionate speech to the mutants and survivors, appealing to their right to the surface and the need to expel the Aslan invaders. They manage to convince them to provide a support team, ground vehicles, and generate war noise to distract the enemy. Scene 6: Protocol and Strategy PCs present: Pika. NPCs present: Captain Brie, Captain Gawain Dunkel, Lady Hil (Phoenix's rival, event organizer). Location: Hangar and Court Halls (Floating Palace). Summary: Pika receives the survivors of the Torpol's Wake. Captain Dunkel, very formally, requests an audience with the King, but Pika keeps him waiting with diplomatic excuses. Then, Pika seeks out Lady Hil, Phoenix's rival, who is in theatrical mourning. Pika manipulates her into organizing a grand reception for the Byrni fleet, appealing to the need to impress the allies. Concurrently, Pika coordinates the sending of couriers to neighboring systems (Purne, Hilfer) to instruct the allied fleets (Byrni and Clarke) to wait and coordinate for a joint, massive jump. Scene 7: Final Meeting PCs present: All. NPCs present: None explicitly mentioned in the final meeting. Location: Floating Palace. Summary: The surface team returns to the Palace. They meet with Pika and share their progress: they have the infiltration equipment, the support of the Vespexers, and the fleet strategy underway. They prepare for the critical mission: to descend to the surface again to infiltrate and recover the ancient planetary defense network before the allied fleet arrives. Yankee equips himself with the material acquired for the mission.

title: 56 - PoD - Preparativos
content: Here is a summary of the session based on the provided transcript, using the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Session Title: Seeds of Rebellion and Echoes of Sindal PCs present: Cordan Group: Paloma's character (Merchant/Face), Goran, Kleiton, Alvarito (Mentioned). Drinax Group: Fénix Corbin/Nemo, Yankee/Nacho, Pika/Emilio. NPCs present: Baroness Lux (Local ruler in Cordan). Yusef Fusagraki (Target, corrupt tax collector). Karin (PCs' crew member). Rachando (Merchant in the Floating Palace). Bri Tolariz (Hawk Guard Commander). King Oleb XVI (King of Drinax). Lady Hil (Courtesan/Administrator, manages protocol). Alfredo (Local with a personal vendetta).    Captain Gawain (Mentioned, captain of the Torpol's Star*). Main Developments: Cordan Group: An operations base has been established in Baroness Lux's territory, and a social agitation campaign has been launched in Elaton and surrounding villages to provoke an uprising against the tax collector Yusef Fusagraki, with the ultimate goal of eliminating him without direct implication.    Drinax Group: Diplomatic preparations have been finalized for King Oleb's reception of the Torpol's Star* crew, ensuring a brief and formal meeting by presenting Sindal medals. Concurrently, a tactical operation has begun on the planet's surface ("The World") to assault a protected underground complex. Loose Ends: The assault on the underground complex on Drinax's surface is about to begin; the group is positioned but has not yet entered. The social ambush against Yusef in Cordan is in the preparation phase; it remains to be seen if the mob will react violently when the tax collector reaches the final villages on his route. The outcome of the meeting between King Oleb and Captain Gawain while the PCs are on a mission is yet to be confirmed. Scene: Infiltration in Border Territory PCs present: Paloma's character, Goran, Kleiton. NPCs present: Baroness Lux (Local ruler), Yusef Fusagraki (Mentioned, target for elimination). Location: Baroness Lux's Palace and the city of Elaton (Planet Cordan). Ships mentioned: The Ginger (PCs' ship). Scene Summary: The group is in Baroness Lux's territory. They receive information about the target, Yusef Fusagraki, a corrupt tax collector operating in the disputed area between Baron Halley and Baron Fero, especially around the fortified city of Elaton. The PCs decide to leave the ship The Ginger hidden in Baron Fero's territory and access Elaton in a ground vehicle (jeep), posing as Free Traders. For six days, they integrate into the community, selling goods and gauging the atmosphere, discovering that while there is general discontent and rumors of Yusef blackmailing Baron Halley, there is no organized resistance specifically against him. Scene: Logistics and Diplomacy in the Floating Palace PCs present: Fénix Corbin (Nemo), Yankee (Nacho), Pika (Emilio). NPCs present: Rachando (Bazaar merchant, acquires rare items), Bri Tolariz (Hawk Guard Leader, loyal but strict), King Oleb XVI (Eccentric and nostalgic monarch), Lady Hil (Court organizer). Location: Floating Palace (Planet Drinax). Ships mentioned: Torpol's Star (Mentioned, Captain Gawain). Scene Summary: While preparations for the surface assault are underway, the PCs conduct business at the palace. Yankee visits Rachando and acquires an optical/thermal camouflage suit and a heavy laser rifle. Fénix attempts, unsuccessfully, to recruit members of the Hawk Guard by speaking with Bri Tolariz, who declines due to his men's lack of specific training for the mission. Subsequently, Fénix and Pika coordinate with Lady Hil and King Oleb for the diplomatic reception of Captain Gawain and his crew (arriving from Byrni). Fénix persuades the King to hold a brief ceremony, presenting medals from the old Sindal Empire to satisfy the visitors' ego without risking Oleb speaking too much or causing diplomatic incidents. The reception appears to go well under Lady Hil's supervision. Scene: Reconnaissance in the Ruins PCs present: Fénix Corbin (Nemo), Yankee (Nacho), Pika (Emilio). NPCs present: Vespexer squad (Surface explorers, allied mercenaries). Location: Ruins on the surface, bunker area (Planet Drinax/The World). Ships mentioned: Aslan Scout Ship (Scout 100-ton model, parked on the surface). Scene Summary: The team descends to the devastated surface of Drinax with a group of allied Vespexers. They approach the coordinates of the target underground complex, hiding their vehicle in some ruins. Pika uses a drone to conduct aerial reconnaissance by chaining sensor systems. They discover that the complex is enormous (one square kilometer) and has a main entrance with power, protected by drones and where an Aslan Scout ship is parked. They also locate several secondary entrances in the form of collapsed tunnels near an old crater. The group decides to infiltrate through the secondary tunnels to avoid the guarded main entrance. Yankee plans to enter with his environmental protection suit and switch to the stealth suit once inside, while Pika debates whether to stay outside to maintain communications or enter with the group. Scene: Sowing Discord on Yusef's Route PCs present: Paloma's character, Goran. NPCs present: Alfredo (Local of Fero ethnicity, victim of Yusef), Karin (Crew member, stays on communications). Location: Elaton and rural villages along the collection route (Planet Cordan). Ships mentioned: None. Scene Summary: Back on Cordan, after failing to find a radical group willing to kill Yusef in Elaton, Paloma's character locates Alfredo, a man with a personal vendetta against the tax collector. Upon learning that Yusef's tax collection route begins in a week, the group changes strategy. They travel by jeep to the rural villages Yusef will visit at the end of his tour. There, they use their cover as merchants to spread rumors and inflame the atmosphere, telling stories (real or exaggerated) about abuses committed by Yusef in previous villages. The goal is to incite a violent mob or "demonstration" that gets out of hand when Yusef arrives, allowing the PCs to act or eliminate him amidst the chaos without being directly identified as killers. Goran prepares the ground tactically (possible barricades, sniper points) while Paloma socially manipulates the locals.

title: 57 - PoD - En el Agujero
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format: Infiltration of the Planetary Fortress PCs present Yankee (Nacho) Corven / Nemo (Juan) Pika (Emilio) Dora (Paloma) NPCs present Scout (Vespexer native guide) Sharpshooter (Vespexer soldier) Driver (Vespexer, stays with the vehicle) Alex and Tropex (Young Vespexer recruits) Guy 1 and Guy 2 (Vespexer recruits) Important Developments The group begins exploring the ancient planetary defense facilities on the surface of Drinax with the objective of sabotaging the weapon or using it to protect the Floating Palace. Discovery that the lower levels of the facility are still active, with power and security systems operational (droids and sensors), and that they are sending "all clear" signals to orbiting ships. Loose Ends Yankee has suffered serious injuries from electrocution and radiation, requiring medical attention in the vehicle. They have not yet managed to access the command bridge or the main weapon control. They have recovered remains of an ancient security droid that the Vespexers want to use as scrap metal. Exploration of the Communications Level PCs present: Yankee, Corven, Pika, Dora NPCs present: Scout, Guy 1, Guy 2, Sharpshooter (Vespexers - Wasteland survivors) Location: Ancient Planetary Defense Base (Planet Drinax) Ships: None Scene Summary The group parks their ground vehicle near the defenses and enters the facility by forcing an unguarded entrance. They split into teams to explore the first underground level (communications). They discover that the area is in ruins, looted, and without power. During the search, Corven finds a relic: a double-barreled syndalite officer's revolver in perfect condition. Dora and Yankee are accidentally exposed to a high-radiation area and suffer poisoning, having to withdraw temporarily for treatment. Collapses and Dangerous Connections PCs present: Pika, Corven, Yankee, Dora NPCs present: Sharpshooter, Scout (Vespexer - Guide) Location: Crater access and Level 1 (Planet Drinax) Ships: None Scene Summary The next day, they attempt to enter through a cratered area. The structure is unstable; Pika and the Sharpshooter get trapped under a rubble collapse, suffering injuries, but are rescued by the group. Corven detects a nest of Drinaxian red ants (highly venomous insects) and they manage to avoid it. They decide to try and hack the system from Level 1. Pika performs a risky wire splice in a radioactive area to power a console, suffering more radiation. Yankee attempts to hack the system with Pika's help, gaining limited access: they confirm that there are active sensors and encrypted communications leaving the base. Encounter with Automated Security PCs present: Corven NPCs present: Alex, Tropex (Vespexers - Young recruits) Location: Level 3 - Barracks (Planet Drinax) Ships: None Scene Summary Corven descends to the third level (Barracks) with two recruits. This area is in better condition. Suddenly, they are surprised by an ancient security droid that camouflages itself as a noble table but possesses an energy cannon. Combat begins: the droid fires, missing its shot, and Corven responds with automatic fire from his assault rifle, destroying the robot. The recruits collect the droid's remains as war loot. Yankee's Accident and the Withdrawal PCs present: Yankee, Pika, Corven NPCs present: None directly in Yankee's action Location: Access to deep levels and Vehicle (Planet Drinax) Ships: None Scene Summary While Pika stays decrypting communications (discovering after many hours that they are periodic "all clear" messages), Yankee uses his invisibility cloak to attempt a stealthy infiltration towards the active lower levels. While trying to force a locked door, he receives a massive electrical shock that leaves him severely injured. Seriously wounded and having confirmed that direct access is dangerous, Yankee returns to the group. Corven provides first aid, and they decide to abort the mission temporarily, returning to the vehicle so Yankee can recover in the onboard infirmary.

title: 59 - PoD - Espigas Sangrientas
content: Here is the session summary based on the provided transcript: Session Title: Cordan Escape and the Drinax Dilemma PCs present: Lyra (The Captain) Clayton (Medic, severely wounded) Goran (Deceased this session) Yankee Fu (Prisoner) Nemo Corven NPCs present: Karim (PC ship crew member) Lady Hil (Counselor/Noble from Drinax) King Oleb XVI Lord Drax (Mentioned as Admiral/Lord Max) Bri (Hawk Guard)    Captain of the Star of Torpol* and his First Officer. Pika (Ally/Contact in Drinax) Important developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: Goran's Death: He sacrifices himself on Cordan to allow his companions to escape. Yankee Fu's Capture: It is confirmed he is alive but a prisoner in an enemy facility, undergoing interrogation and truth serum. Diplomatic Strategy: The group decides to postpone a suicidal rescue to travel to Torpol. The goal is to acquire information or experts in Sindalite history to impress the Regent of Byrni and secure the alliance before launching the fleet attack. Loose ends: Yankee Fu's final fate and whether he will survive until the attack. The repair and use of the combat robot Corven wants to fix. The imminent arrival of Clark's fleet and the Regent, and whether King Oleb will live up to "imperial" expectations. Scene 1: Wheat Field Pursuit PCs present: Lyra, Clayton, Goran. NPCs present: Karim (Inexperienced crew member), Enemy soldiers (Well-armed paramilitaries with air support). Location: Farmland and backroads (Cordan). Ships: Ginger (PC ship, remotely piloted/by Karim), "Dragonfly" Gravicopter (Enemy vehicle). Summary: Following the chaos in the town, Lyra drives an armored car with a severely wounded and unconscious Clayton in the back, while Goran follows on a stolen motorcycle until it runs out of fuel. The group attempts to reach the ship Ginger cross-country to avoid police checkpoints, hiding the car in a barn. However, an enemy gravicopter with advanced scanners and a squad of soldiers locates them. Goran decides to stay behind to ambush the soldiers and buy time, managing to take down one, but is strafed by the enemy craft's automatic cannon, dying instantly. Lyra and Clayton run towards the Ginger, which lands clumsily piloted by Karim. Under heavy fire, they manage to board and escape the planet, leaving Goran's body behind. Scene 2: Prisoner of War PCs present: Yankee Fu. NPCs present: Drinaxian and Vespex prisoners (Captives), Facility guards (Aslan/Hostiles). Location: Prisoner cell (Enemy facility, presumably on or around Cordan). Ships: None. Summary: Yankee Fu is chained in a dark room with other prisoners. Although not brutally physically tortured, he is subjected to interrogations with truth serum, involuntarily revealing part of the group's plans. During his captivity, he forms a bond with a Drinaxian prisoner (who becomes a Contact). Security is high and escape seems impossible for the moment. Scene 3: Politics and Protocol on the Floating Palace PCs present: Nemo, Corven. NPCs present: Lady Hil (Pragmatic and concerned), King Oleb XVI (Delusional, eager for battle), Captain of the Star of Torpol (Gallant, anachronistic, "space Paladin" archetype), Bri (Hawk Guard). Location: Floating Palace, Private Dining Room, Throne Room (Drinax). Ships: Star of Torpol (Mentioned). Summary: Back on Drinax, the survivors reunite with Nemo and Corven. Lady Hil informs them of the complicated diplomatic situation: the crew of the Star of Torpol expects to see a legendary Sindalite Empire, but Drinax is in ruins and the King is eccentric. Nemo and Corven intensely debate whether to launch an immediate, ill-prepared assault to rescue Yankee or play the political game. Nemo attempts to convince King Oleb and the knights of Torpol to lead a heroic assault on enemy facilities, but they refuse to act without the Regent's formal order or the arrival of the full fleet, seeing it as an unworthy or suicidal mission without proper support. Ultimately, the group decides the best option is to travel to Torpol to seek relics or experts to help stage the "imperial grandeur" needed to appease the Regent of Byrni, and to coordinate their return with the massive fleet attack.

title: 60 - PoD - Atando cabos
content: Here is the session summary following the requested pattern and in Spanish from Spain. The Hermit of Cordan and the Breaking of the Siege PCs present: Lyra, Daijiro Yuga (new addition), Corben (Nemo), Pika, Yankee (freed at the end). NPCs present: Kleiton, Karim, Margarita, Asma Ozaed, Nicolaos Rosa, Lady Hil, King Oleb XVI, Regent of the Order of Byrni. Main developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign: Incorporation of Daijiro Yuga: An old acquaintance of Kleiton joins the crew after helping them in Cordan. Intelligence on Baron Halley: Lyra discovers evidence that Halley is being blackmailed or has dealings with dangerous "friends" (possibly Aslan) that the Empire would not tolerate. Sindalite Legitimacy: A history expert is hired to help legitimize King Oleb's claim as Emperor.    End of the Drinax Siege: The Byrni fleet, along with the PCs' ships (including the Imperatrix*), breaks the Aslan blockade of Drinax. Liberation of Yankee: Yankee is rescued from captivity after the battle. Loose ends: The exact identity and nature of Baron Halley's "friends" mentioned in the decrypted files. The situation in Kteiroa, where Yatei pirate ships continue to accumulate. The pending diplomatic visit to Byrni to formalize the alliance.    Professor Yutal Mirobar Haut Belzoni remains in Dostoevsky; a message has been left for Jimmy (Sarcomond*) to try and contact him. Scene 1: Forced Landing in the Mountains PCs present: Lyra, Daijiro Yuga. NPCs present: Kleiton (Lyra's pilot, critically injured), Karim (Novice crewmember, seeks revenge for her brother), Margarita (Local healer). Location: Daijiro's cabin, Cordan Mountains (Cordan). Ships: The Ginger (Light freighter, partially crashed). Summary: Fleeing an ambush where Goran died, Karim attempts to pilot the Ginger without experience and makes a disastrous landing near an isolated cabin. The cabin belongs to Daijiro Yuga, a retired soldier who served with Kleiton years ago during pacification operations in Umemii. Lyra desperately asks for help to save Kleiton. Daijiro seeks out Margarita, a local healer, who manages to stabilize the pilot. During his convalescence, Daijiro and Lyra exchange stories about their situations and the former's "retirement." A small symbolic funeral is held for Goran. Scene 2: Encrypted Secrets and War Rumors PCs present: Lyra, Daijiro Yuga. NPCs present: Kleiton, Karim. Location: Daijiro's cabin (Cordan). Summary: While awaiting Kleiton's recovery, Lyra and Daijiro decrypt the files stolen from Josefus. They discover that Josefus was blackmailing Baron Halley with information about secret allies involved in training his guard, something the Third Empire would disapprove of. Over the radio, they hear news of rising military tension and border skirmishes between Baron Fero and Baron Halley, partly fueled by the PCs' previous actions. They decide to contact Baroness Lux to inform her and coordinate a future meeting, and Daijiro decides to join the crew, leaving his hermit life behind. Scene 3: Culture for the Crown PCs present: Corben, Pika. NPCs present: Asma Ozaed (Museum Director), Nicolaos Rosa (Expert in Sindalite military history, wargame geek archetype, heavy smoker). Location: Sindal Museum and Restaurant on Zafen Island (Torpol). Ships: Maui. Summary: Corben and Pika arrive in Torpol looking for an expert who can legitimize King Oleb's claim through history and protocol. After inviting the museum director to lunch, they manage to recruit Nicolaos Rosa, an expert on Sindalite battles and knightly orders. During the return trip, Pika devises a historical narrative based on the planet Chalchiutlicue to justify Oleb's rough manners before the Order of Byrni, drawing a parallel with an ancient warrior emperor. They also learn that a more renowned scholar, Professor Yutal Mirobar, is stranded in Dostoevsky, and they leave a message for Captain Jimmy to try and pick him up. Scene 4: The Battle for Drinax PCs present: Corben, Pika. NPCs present: Prince Harrik, Lady Hil. Location: Orbit of Drinax and surrounding space. Ships: Maui (Damaged in combat), Imperatrix (Stolen/camouflaged Imperial ship), Byrni Fleet (Led by an ancient flagship). Summary: The PCs' fleet returns to Drinax, coinciding with the arrival of reinforcements from the Order of Byrni and ships from Clarke and Blue. There is debate on whether to use the Imperatrix, risking a diplomatic incident if its stolen origin is discovered. Corben convinces the group to use it as a demonstration of full force. A week-long space battle erupts against the Aslan (Yatei) pirate blockade. The coalition manages to break the blockade and drive off the enemy ships. The Maui suffers damage during combat, but the victory temporarily secures the system. Scene 5: Encounter of Two Worlds PCs present: Corben, Pika, Yankee. NPCs present: King Oleb XVI (Gruff but warrior-like), Regent of Byrni, Lady Hil (Organizer, protector of protocol). Location: Royal Palace (Drinax). Summary: After the battle, Yankee is released from captivity (though he loses his invisibility cloak). Lady Hil organizes a diplomatic meeting between King Oleb and the Regent of Byrni, using the historical narrative prepared by Pika and decorating the palace with specific relics. Although Oleb has some protocol gaffes (including burps), his warrior spirit connects with the paladins of Byrni. No definitive treaty is signed, but Oleb is invited to visit Byrni, which is considered a diplomatic success and a step towards the recognition of his imperial title.

title: 61 - PoD - Cordan out
content: Here is the session summary following the requested format and in Spanish from Spain. Arde Cordán: Chickens, Fire, and Marquessates PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro. (At the end of the session, they join the rest of the fleet and the PC Nemo appears). NPCs present: Baroness Lux, Karim, Ramón, Alfredo, Goran (Corpse). Main developments in the PCs' lives or the campaign's objective: The PCs manage to destabilize the political situation in Cordán by inciting a border war between Baron Halley and Baron Ferro, allowing Baroness Lux to establish herself as a mediator and peacemaker. As a reward for their services, Baroness Lux names the PCs Marquises of Indus, granting them land (albeit partially in ruins) and a safe harbor in Cordán. The remains of Goran (the deceased former companion) are recovered and buried on the lands of Indus. The group reunites with the rest of the fleet in the Clarke system after several weeks of operations. Loose ends: 8 tons of weapons they have stored are yet to be sold. The PCs have recordings of "chicken fights" that turned out to be black because the camera had its lens cap on. The long-term management of the Marquessate of Indus (although it remains on its own). The GM still needs to send the "bill" for ship maintenance and the piracy profits of the other crew. Session Joke: To justify their presence in the city of Elatón and move freely, the characters invent that they are a documentary crew filming a viral report on "Cordanian Chickens" and their bloody fights. They spend days pretending to film, winning over the locals and even the guards. However, at the end of the session, when they discuss editing the footage to maintain their cover, Kleiton (Álvaro) realizes he never took the lens cap off the camera, leaving them with hours of chicken sounds and a black screen. Scene 1: The Conspiracy in the Villa PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro. NPCs present: Baroness Lux (Manipulative and calculating aristocrat, Archetype: The Machiavellian), Karim (Loyal pilot). Location: Baroness Lux's Villa (Planet Cordán). Ships: The Ginger (Cargo ship, Pilot Karim/Kleiton). Summary: After being healed and resting at Baroness Lux's villa, the PCs meet with her in the garden. Lux explains that she wishes to weaken Barons Halley and Ferro, but without either winning a total war, so that she can position herself above them. The group dismisses the idea of a direct attack (like blowing up a bridge with explosives they don't have) and decides to incite a popular revolt in the border city of Elatón. The plan consists of burning food supplies (silos and granaries) to provoke famine and discontent, blaming the poor management and oppression of Baron Halley, so that Lux can then appear as the savior with humanitarian aid. Scene 2: Chicken Reporters PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro. NPCs present: Border control guards (Generic soldiers). Location: Spaceport and roads to Elatón (Planet Cordán). Ships: The Ginger (Mentioned). Summary: The group forges documentation to pose as foreigners. Lacking a good alibi, they invent that they are a television crew making a documentary about the famous "Cordanian Chicken" fights. Kleiton acts as the cameraman, Daijiro as the local guide, and Lyra as the reporter/producer. Thanks to this lie and the group's charisma, they manage to pass the military and police checkpoints on the way to Elatón, even being welcomed by locals who want to show them their fighting cocks. Scene 3: Fire in Elatón PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro. NPCs present: Ramón (Leader of the local resistance, wounded and radical), Alfredo (Local contact). Location: City of Elatón (Planet Cordán), Grain warehouses. Summary: Once in Elatón, a fortified and tense city, the PCs split up. While Kleiton keeps watch on guard patrols, Daijiro infiltrates the agricultural facilities and burns the food warehouses using local flammable materials. The situation becomes critical. Lyra takes advantage of the chaos to meet with rebel leaders, Ramón and Alfredo, in a cockfighting arena. There, she convinces them to take up arms, promising them military supplies (weapons from The Ginger) and tactically suggesting the capture of the bridge connecting to Halley's territory. Scene 4: The War and the Marquessate PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro. NPCs present: Baroness Lux (Triumphant peacemaker), Baron Halley and Baron Ferro (Mentioned in negotiations). Location: Cordán (General) and Indus Region. Summary: The revolt in Elatón erupts violently. The rebels attempt to blow up the bridge and are brutally repressed (Ramón and Alfredo are hanged), which causes Baron Ferro's troops to cross the border, initiating a war. Just as planned, Baroness Lux intervenes with peacekeeping forces and humanitarian aid, forcing the other barons to negotiate. Elatón comes under Lux's protection. As payment, Lux grants the PCs the title of Marquises of Indus and some land. Karim manages to recover Goran's bones, which are buried in the new marquessate along with a rat he shot for being on top of the remains. Scene 5: Fleet Reunion PCs present: Lyra, Kleiton, Daijiro, Nemo's character. NPCs present: Byrni Fleet (Allies). Location: Clarke System and Drinax System. Ships: The Ginger (Cargo ship), Drinax/Byrni Fleet. Summary: The group leaves Cordán and travels to the Clarke system. There they reunite with the rest of the crew and the Byrni fleet, which has broken the blockade and cleared the area of "Yachties" pirates. They catch up, account for the weeks of training, and prepare for the next steps of the campaign, with the allied fleet partially returning to Byrni but leaving an invitation for King Oleb.
